title: Warehouse War 4
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Tyler Cox aka Rooster, and I'm a Nashville-based tournament organizer specializing in Smash Bros. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I run the Warehouse War series, which is the largest current on-going tournament series for Smash in the State of Tennessee, and roughly the second largest tournament series going in the Southeast only behind Tipped Off. content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmaRSW1Hb4kUxuD68nzcskN9fRGwJAvGRiDc926VTHJ4VN","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey, I am Kharsonist! I'm still a new player although I have certainly proved myself in this short amount of time in Street Fighter 6.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm extremely passionate and put my all into training and competing. title: Garden Brawl- A Grassroots Smash Tournament
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello! My name is Todd, although I'm better known by my tag Anchor in the Smash community, and I'm the tournament organizer (TO) for ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Garden Brawl","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://start.gg/gardenbrawl"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In 2019, when I was only 16 years old, I ran a tournament called ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Garden State Smashdown","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://start.gg/njsmashdown"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" which began my career as a TO and gave me the experience to run some of the largest Smash tournaments in the world. This includes being the Melee TO for Collision 2023 & 2024, two events that had over 1,200 in-person attendees and tens of thousands of live viewers. Five years later and with much more experience under my belt, I've now returned to my roots as the head tournament organizer of Garden Brawl, a spiritual successor to the event that started it all for me.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Garden Brawl features tournaments for Melee and Ultimate in the Super Smash Bros. series alongside other titles, and we sold over 20% of our total passes in the first two weeks and are currently sitting at 70 registered competitors, with about two months before the event on August 24th. Globally ranked players for these titles are already confirmed such as 2Saint, Bbatts, Syrup, Wally, and more. With consistent posts on our ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Twitter/X","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/GSSmash"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" account as well as livestreaming the event on ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Collision Series Twitch channel","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.twitch.tv/collisionseriestv"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" (51.7k followers), we expect to have a lot of outreach within the Smash community for people either attending in-person or watching from home, including the projected 200 in-person attendees and hundreds of concurrent viewers watching the event online.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With additional funding from Nouns, Garden Brawl would be able to provide a better in-person experience for our attendees and a better viewing experience for people watching at home by hiring more staff to run our in-person tournaments and manage our livestreams. With their contribution to the event, Nouns would also be featured on our social media pages and livestream during the event, as well as in our advertising leading up to the event.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As a longtime Smash tournament organizer and Melee competitor, I'm glad that Nouns has been supporting grassroots events and top players in our community, and I hope the trend continues by passing the proposal to help fund Garden Brawl!","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmStMdTeM8kjzNGC3UiWEq68iVeyq2MMniuBkFFRD93dgQ","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Solar Flare and Sunrise 2024 Tournament Funds Proposal
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Nikola Tan, also known as NickSF, and I am thrilled to be hosting Sunrise and Solar Flare 2024 on July 13th-14th in Ontario, Canada. This journey has been nothing short of a miracle, filled with both challenges and triumphs.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Originally, Solar Flare was planned as a two-day event at Humber College, thanks to the invaluable assistance of their esports department head. I submitted a license application to Nintendo three months before announcing the event. However, despite the passage of five months, I have yet to receive a response. A crucial requirement from the college was securing this license to host Smash Ultimate and Melee tournaments. Without it, I had to pivot.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With the college’s help, I found an alternative venue just five minutes away. While the cost was significantly higher, I decided to proceed and secure the venue, knowing that Smash is our largest draw and essential for the success of No Style Esports.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Now, with only a month to go, we have approximately 250 combined attendees for both events. Solar Flare is currently a B Tier event, and Sunrise is part of the Tekken Dojo. Everything is progressing well, except for the financial aspect. The venue expenses for both days would amount to around $5,000 CAD not including staff pay, equipment, medals, costs for bringing players out, etc. Your support of $1,000 would be instrumental in covering these expenses and ensuring that I don't face financial losses for the second year in a row (last year's Solar Flare saw me lose around $2,000-$3,000 due to a venue scam).","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This event is a pivotal moment in my career as a Tournament Organizer. Your support would mean the world to me and could make the difference between success and failure. I am committed to making Solar Flare and Sunrise 2024 an unforgettable experience for all participants and an event that elevates No Style Esports to new heights.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for considering our proposal. title: Help Get ThatMusicNerd to Supernova 2024!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, my name is Evan, aka ThatMusicNerd. I'm a 17 year old, Canadian Super Smash Bros. Melee player that has loved engaging with the community, and playing the game as a whole. In the 7 months I've been playing this game, I have taken lessons from players Zuppy and Nouns Cody Schwab to improve on neutral and punish, taken games off of players like OG Kid, and have made good rankings in online and offline tournaments like 385th in Get On My Level X, and 17th in online tournaments like Only Noobs. I would be a great player for your roster because of how fast I've learned the game, and how I love to engage with the community. Going to a supermajor was one of the biggest jumps for me as a player. I got to meet players that I've watched for years, watch sets in person that was more intense than the last, and to be part of a community that I felt I belonged in for the first time. This game can't be replicated for its gameplay, and the community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: The WFL Arcadian
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello, my name is Bill (Quadae). I have been running SSBM events since 2018 and have been involved in the Melee community since 2015. I have run locals almost weekly for several years as well as being the head Melee TO for events such as Tampa Never Sleeps 8, CEO Dreamland, CEO 2022-2024, Double Down 2022, LVL Up Expo 2023, The Florida Melee Circuit (Season 1 and 2), as well as many other events. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This July we are running the first Arcadian for our region, West Florida. West Florida (WFL) is a relatively young scene as it came about as a combination of several smaller regions on the gulf coast of Florida, and in this time we have become one of the most active regions in the state. The event will be run on July 20th at one of our local venues, Manna Tea, we have had events ranging from 20-70 people in this space and are looking to bring in at least 50 entrants for this event. The Arcadian bracket is for players who have not been ranked in our region or any similarly strong regions, we have a fairly consistent upper echelon of players and this is the first time we will get to see some of the up and coming talent in the region compete with each other. These attendees are the new players who continue to build melee's legacy 20 years after its initial release.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We will be running a Waterfall Double Elimination bracket for the event, I truly feel this format is the future of Melee tournaments. Waterfall bracket allows for many players to get more matches with players of comparable skill, players who may typically play 2-3 matches in a regular bracket would be able to play at least 4-5 matches in a waterfall format. Along with singles we are running a Pro/Amateur Doubles event, players who are barred from competing in singles can team up with one of the arcadian players, incentivizing our ranked players to show up to the event.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Currently our promotion has been over Twitter and Discord as that is where most of our local community interacts. Over the past month we have gathered 35 pre-registered attendees and expect that number to grow as we get closer to the event. We will be broadcasting this event as well, for anyone unable to attend, we have a dedicated broadcaster who has produced high quality stream assets for us to work with. Stream Example - ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sbu97ZkiKO8"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With support from Nouns we can increase our production quality for the event as well as for future events, we also can provide a higher prize pool to incentivize attendance and pay out to a larger portion of players. We also have plans for content to run at the event that would be easier to produce if chosen.","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmS5GYrh5ySFfqfos8AFEJwWTBNbgRNLH7jeyLAR8gi5GQ","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Stack Camp: A Grassroots, Grass Touching event.
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Greetings! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Jonathan Rosa, and my Tag is 2147m (People call me Stack). ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am hosting a grass roots melee event with grass touching side events! Melee Singles, Doubles, Four Square, and Cornhole brackets! Commentary by 2 of our region's top players. Good vibes, great events, all packed into a mountainside cabin getaway. Pack your bags because we’re going Stack Camping! We expect to reach an average between 50-100 average viewers on our live streams of events. Open commentary couch with 1 static PR player rotating through blocks. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are currently in the script writing process for 2 promotional videos meant for YouTube, TikTok, and Twitter + will be watched by the entire attendee list live during the event. All media will be branded with Nouns graphics.  I currently host a Melee Bi-weekly that averages 12-16 entrants. For perspective, Xanadu and BMW, the two strongest and most consistent locals in our region, average between 12-20 entrants weekly.  I am being mentored and guided by Tournament Organizers with 10+ years of experience. Along with TO’ing my own event I have assisted with the beloved and two year long running Baltimore Melee Weekly. Our region is very strong and supportive of our TOs and we always have great showings and viewership. Our target audience, though a smaller event, is actually cross country. My team is hoping to build this into a strong annual regional over the years. This will be an event similar to Smash Camp New Lands, in that it will be smaller in entrants, but more exclusive. This event is meant to be an unforgettable weekend for the attendees. Similar to Tipped Off, we hope to provide a 10/10 experience for attendees, and have that translate to more word of mouth grassroots growth. Nouns will have static graphics throughout the entire stream. We have a few plans for social media activation and Noun’s involvement. We want to host a free to enter raffle for in person attendees for Nouns merch, which will be featured on stream. I would also like to offer 3 Nouns hats to live viewers. We will put out predictions in chat during stream games, and will offer 1 winner a free Nouns hat upon the games ending. We’d also like it if Nouns could send us some Noggles for portraits from our media team. All in all… I want to create one of these beautiful, amazing, and unforgettable weekends that Nouns, and many other amazing backers and organizers have given me. Thank you for taking the time to read my 5 lines of text. I look forward to hearing from you! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ll include some media coverage I’ve done of events. These are my personal twitter posts so engagement varies but I believe these are strong showings of support from our community. You can also see with each NEW album engagement has grown. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/2147mp4/status/1804991465380057165","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/2147mp4/status/1804991465380057165"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/2147mp4/status/1798408619534295527","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/2147mp4/status/1798408619534295527"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/2147mp4/status/1795574889879138422","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/2147mp4/status/1795574889879138422"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Chord Cup - 1v1 Minesweeper Tournament
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm Kurraga and I've been running the Chord Cup series of events for the last couple years, an online tournament series started by follow minesweeper community member Jovilly and run by me after I took over organising for the last 3 iterations of the event, with out next event, Chord Cup 6, planned for September. We reached a viewership of 40+ concurrent viewers for the latest cup and have has as many as 46 participants in an event, with some of the top minesweeper players in the world staying up all night just to participate. Our regular entrants include 2 of the top 3 players on the expert rankings for ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://minesweeper.online/ranking","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://minesweeper.online/ranking"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", a popular minesweeper site with over 2 millions players on the rankings.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To promote the events we have a minesweeper community discord with over 1200 members and the actual Cord Cup server itself with over 250 and the Minesweeper News Twitter page to advertise it. As well as various Twitter and Twitch pages players in the community can use to share about the event. Community support for the event has been strong, with multiple players donating to contribute to $100+ prize pools  paid out to top 8 placing players.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The actual matches involve two players duking it out on set of predetermined no guess minesweeper boards - where both players play the exact same set of boards to make things fair, with the later rounds allowing players to counter pick their preferred board sizes and running a best of 5 format, with several games per round to ensure the better player can win, but with upset potential every round if the higher seeded player makes a mistake and misclicks under pressure, which can be disastrous especially on the large expert boards, leading to a surprise upset or a heroic comeback from a costly mistake.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The top Chord Cup player, Boru has won 3 times and won the last 2 events, but had to do it through losers both times, taking losses to a different player in each event, so the narrative through going through this next event will be about seeing if anyone will be able to take down the reigning champ. Maybe with funding from this Nouns Tournament fund we can incentivise enough players to participate and take him down.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For brand integration we can promote Nouns in our advertising for the event and in the stream itself, putting it in the stream title with Nouns logo on screen during matches and segments between rounds to advertise any nouns sponsored products. approach to doing things well is very important for us, as we not only want to create great tournaments, but also to level upwards our community, in an attempt to make our community emerge from the current slump, get out of forums, and start to grow on social media. We want straight up to not only save our community, but to also give it a long term hype and make our players known like any other esport.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmPDHsgdSC5oicZUX99YZc3rQqc9sjVHvESFkAs1r1tpeY","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The kind of infographics we produce on social media","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":2},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why we need your help","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h2"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The cashprize comes from our own pockets, from the revenues of the YouTube channel we created to cover the circuit, and from generous donators, which is enough for all tournaments except for one, which is one of the most ambitious team tournaments ever done.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The objective of this team tournament is to give a level of hype never seen before to any tournament, by having a cashprize of €2000. The reason behind a cashprize objective that big, is that we want to not only pay the winners, but also each player winning a match and each team captain, rewarding excellence and bringing a new level of importance to performance.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Currently, we are only €900 away from the €2000, which would mean that the €1000 this contest offers would not only match the amount needed to achieve it, but also make us develop other parts of our project, like developing more towards an international community (as most of our community is French-speaking) and develop more the English part of our social media platforms, livestreams and website.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also, as mentioned before, the community is split in forums, which are declining, and our efforts to develop the community on social media have had encouraging but not satisfying results for now, as players are reluctant to leave their forums. That is why we think that a boost from Nouns could help us to make players from all over the world be interested in joining us and the online competitive scene on social media, and we would gladly put nouns as an official sponsor of the tournament if we are selected to promote the Nouns brand and socials.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Coup Critique staff would like to thank Nouns for this amazing opportunity, which will surely help develop small esport communities to grow !","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: NYC High School Esports League
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"EzEsports, NYC's High School Esports League is looking for Funding for the Fall '24 League.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.ezesports.org/home","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.ezesports.org/home"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Matthew Taylor, and I serve as the Events Director and Advisor to the largest student-run, completely volunteer-based Esports program in North America. EzEsports serves over 5000 students at over 45 high schools in New York City over the last 4 years. Every year, we raise funds, without sponsorship or official recognition, to pay for small things like Pizza, StreamLabs Pro, and Cleaning Fees for the spaces that donate their time and space towards incredibly talented teens who dream of making it big in Esports.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our first Valorant All-Star Match, where our ten best athletes played, featured 10 top 250 Radiant Players. We have a wide range of Grandmaster and Challenger League of Legends and TFT athletes who would make incredible prospects for Nouns Esports. We would be happy to integrate the logo in Twitch Overlays, Instagram Posts, Interviews with Nouns Esports Staff, and I have pairs of noggles for the athletes. If any funding is left over, I would support travel to LAN for the Winners for additional content in the fall.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our students are also interested in Blockchain. Our tournament for the game Megaweapon on Avalanche, during our Valorant playoffs, saw 85 students show up and check out the game. We had a great Q&A session with one of the developers and could showcase Web3 tech to onboard the next generation. Also, the largest high school blockchain club featuring over 250 members has shown support.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The students are incredibly talented behind the camera and would make amazing content for Nouns Esports.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.twitch.tv/ezesportsnyc","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.twitch.tv/ezesportsnyc"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" - Please check out our past broadcasts on Twitch and a few photos below. As well as check us out on Instagram @E.Z.Esports","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for your time, stay Nounish!","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSiDozpTHkGQapT18RqwnZwjUTffnTdHam18k4sP34aFX","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmR89a9w4MpabvPH9G6disbYgbktd7MmL9LAThQQeNUYTY","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmZF22ZsmzJAqTL3y1fuFEng4u7FeUE3fTdQMjpTnuUBtt","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Flip/Side: Pinnacle - A bi-annual event in the MD/VA region pushing Smash to new heights
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfO2z36V1xiVPDrQWYrRD586nhb3SEEKCgWJrupwVnb_M06cVmYfQagwTU01wG4Ji1Dy0VjXdPfJGNLGoPLrjSbs4u20sPB9AQv50uo30xGbTDg8Vvto7EoyqUvTtogLYgIgTDrGUqaPQPLIZhcVo6uFMU?key=TOFOnRg3uac916N69QGqcw","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Introduction","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"What's up y'all! MJ here! Known as frames, I'm primarily a Melee player in the MD/VA region, though I also play Project+ and Ultimate!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Initially an Ultimate player I started attending locals and met some awesome people that taught me the basics and got me into Melee, and with a fun idea and a local community center as a location, my brother and I started a bi-weekly event, Flip/Side.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Filling in an area in the huge MD/VA region that previously had no local, Flip/Side has been a bi-weekly staple for more than six months. At our Tuesday events we've had top 100 players such as mvlvchi and Kevin Maples, and MD/VA PR talent Gibblez, Eve, Cbass. We’ve since started hosting Project+ at the same event, featuring top 100 talent Hyperflame and Goode, and are really excited to continue growing our local scene for such great games. Our past and upcoming events can be seen on our start.gg hub here","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://www.start.gg/hub/flipside","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.start.gg/hub/flipside"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Pinnacle Overview","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"During the 2023 MD/VA PR season we were selected for our bi-annual event Pinnacle, to receive not one, but two qualifier spots for the region’s MD/VA Summit, with over 40 attendees at our first event. Our promotion featured graphics where we highlighted past attendance and wins, an example can be seen here","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://twitter.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1741585170602336563","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://twitter.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1741585170602336563"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":". Pinnacle #2 is quickly approaching and we want to put on a better iteration of the series each time.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our stream has reached hundreds of unique viewers, though our peak is still on the smaller side at 78, our channel recently qualified for Twitch affiliate and we’re looking to grow it even more, and when we reach a larger size, request streams on BTS.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Nouns funding proposal is primarily for our next bi-annual event, 6 months from now. Pinnacle #3 will take place in January of 2025 featuring Smash Bros. Melee, Project+, and Ultimate. However the funding will bolster our tournament series as a whole.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Funding Proposal","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While we’ve had great success so far, we’re currently running Flip/Side on a bare minimum set of equipment. So far the community has pitched in tremendously, however Nouns funding would set us up in a more sustainable way so we can better host these events.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A portion of the funds would go towards adding more setups to our equipment, currently we’ve run off of 5 setups (5 crts, 5 wiis used for both Melee and P+ capacity) and the rest provided by the community when possible. Likewise with the stream we’re looking to purchase a capture card and splitter configuration so we can consistently and better stream Project+ and highlight the awesome game and community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Specific to Pinnacle #3, we’d like to sponsor carpool drivers to encourage both in and out of region attendance from greater distances and provide out-of-region top players bonuses for attending.  Additionally we’d like to provide Nouns swag to attendees through raffles and pre-registration bonuses. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Another key goal is to commission a few different pieces of promotional material including a custom Twitch overlay for our stream use going forward, a highlight reel for Pinnacle #2, and Pinnacle #3, and a hype trailer for Pinnacle #3. Our Pinnacle #1 highlight reel by an in-region editor can be found here","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nui2u43AvQk","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nui2u43AvQk"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns Representation","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns would be featured both on our start.gg and on in-person displays, as well as our stream overlay, and would see shout outs and sponsor posts on our social media. Flip/Side has a strongly recognizable brand in-region and has decent reach online, including a relatively popular post from one of our Project+ bracket streams featuring Hyperflame and Satoshi","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://x.com/Malkasaur/status/1780415491401552198","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/Malkasaur/status/1780415491401552198"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We’d also integrate Nouns into our branding and swag giveaways. Previously we’ve given Flip/Side stickers to attendees at their third time attending an event in our series, and we’d include Nouns merch in this as well","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://x.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1765537271564898650","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1765537271564898650"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Conclusion","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With funding from Nouns, we here at Flip/Side can better expand our series to highlight the peak of Smash Melee and Project+. By bolstering our equipment and outreach, enhancing our already strong name recognition, the potential for growth of our scene multiplies greatly, so we can put on better events for the local, regional, and greater Smash community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Yo what's up!! It's Just Jason. I have wins over many revered top players, such has Cody Schwab (ranked top 5 at the time), Rishi,  Llodd, Ginger, Bobby big balls, Ghatzu, Krudo, Colbol, 2saint,​ Hugs86, Morsecode, Ben, LSD, JFlex, ​foxygrandpa, Syrox in his prime and many more I cant remember, its been a long time playing.  ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I have been a NYC local player since about 2013. The peak of my game was probably 3 years ago, but when my house flooded and I was forced to put my entire life savings into my house,I had to take a step back, focusing on work full time. The NYC and melee community helped me out hugely with a donation campaign that I'm eternally in their debt for as well.​ I am now 24 years old and am putting in the time again, showing consistent results at nightclub, and would say I'm getting mojo back and results to boot.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I would absolutely love this oppurtunity as the more experience I get the better shape I could be in, I've never had strong ties in the scene or any fanbase or suppport. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I have shown the ability to keep up, but due to a lack of resources and life events, I believe I was stunted compared to my peers. title: Commencing operation get Stone to SuperNova
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello, my name is Stone and I got good at Melee after the pandemic.  During 2024, I have been grinding hard in order to get ranked in the Top 100, but due to a skin cancer diagnoses, my bank account has been drained and it has been difficult to work up the funds to travel to tournaments.  While I am blessed to have a wealth of regionals near me here in Austin, Texas, I haven't been able to really show what I'm capable of on a bigger stage.  At LTC here in Austin, I was able to get two top 100 wins, Frenzy and Prof, and I've also been able to have a winning record on DarkHero here in Texas, and even collect a few wins on Salt. title: Jamie Character Specific DP Punish
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am a BIG Jamie fan from the East Coast of the US, and I spend pretty much all of my time in SF in training mode trying to find the coolest things I can. This is my first time REALLY playing a Street Fighter game, and I knew Jamie was going to be my main the moment I saw the gameplay reveal trailer. This combo is only possible against Luke and Ken, due to how high up their DP's end and the speed that they fall. Even then, the 2.HP at the start of the combo is frame-perfect, manually timed, and timed differently between characters. Hit it too early, and you can't cancel into heavy DP. Too late, and they won't be hit high enough. After SA3, which can't be delayed by even a single frame, the drive rush has to be perfect, otherwise you'll spend too much drive gauge to do the combo properly. Following the drive rush 2.HP, you have to cancel with light palm, which leaves the opponent airborne just long enough to microwalk for 1-3 frames and 5.HP. This builds a tiny amount of drive gauge, keeping JUST enough drive gauge to not burn yourself out. After you DR cancel into tensei kick, you can only do j.Mp, as j.Hk no longer connects, followed by OD divekick, and finishing with light DP. If you do the light DP as soon as possible, you're left with 42 frames of advantage. The execution for this combo is very tight, requiring knowledge of the opponent, a frame-perfect starter, and a 3 frame microwalk in between. At 6.4k damage, it's only about 500 damage short (not including CA) of his max, while being WAY more stylish, and actually leaves you with drive gauge to spare.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also, since you're plus 42 directly in their face, if they DON'T die, they have to hold that safejump mix.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://youtu.be/RpwSYxYbvQk","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://youtu.be/RpwSYxYbvQk"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Execution: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While this combo may look easy on the surface, you actually need to start by throwing Ed and jumping over him in order to be on the opposite side of the Level 2 super. Then after setting it up, you need to punish counter Ed with Ken's Crouching Heavy Punch and specifically delay cancel the Run follow up Step Kick. This delay ensures Ken runs far enough for him to hit both Ed and the Projectile with his Step Kick follow up. If done correctly, you're plus 9 on hit allowing for Ken to link another Crouching Heavy Punch which allows him to subsequently loop this sequence from one side of the stage to the other. You get six trade hits with the projectile as the seventh hit will knock Ken down, and each trade hit you must let Ken run far enough for the step kick to reach the projectile. You may have heard of me from being one of the renowned \"JSheiks,\" or from my notoriety for entering (and mostly winning) just about every netplay tournament series you've ever heard of. I started out in competitive Smash with Brawl in 2009, ran Smash and FGC tourneys from 2010-2020, and started to actively compete in Melee in 2014. I debuted on the Louisiana's Melee Power Rankings that same year, maintained a top 4 spot since late 2016, and have held the #2 spot since 2021.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With the shutdown that COVID brought and the advent of Slippi and rollback netplay, the ability to enter netplay tourneys and compete against the best of the best from the comfort of my own room stoked the flames of my competitive fire, became an excellent form of practice as a simulation of tournament nerves/pressure/environment, and gave me the chance to play against people I would have never played otherwise to see how well I stacked against them. Here's the list of wins I've claimed on players from the latest SSBMRank Top 100: Aklo, Salt, Magi, SDJ, Ben, Krudo, Bbatts, Faust, CPU0, Khryke, Gahtzu, Drephen, Eddy Mexico, Lunar Dusk, JFlex, Kevin Maples, JOJI/MilkMan, TheSWOOPER, prof, Wevans, Slowking, Preeminent, Dawson, lowercase hero, Akir, 404Cray, nut, and Justus. Also, I have an undefeated or dominant record on the fellow players that have sent in proposals (of the ones that I have played). As of writing this on 7/16/24, I am currently 10th on the Slippi Leaderboards globally and the highest ranking solo Sheik, ranking in the top 30 the previous two seasons, and have peaked as high as 5th. One look at my resume ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.pgstats.com/melee/player/JSalt?id=S7277","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.pgstats.com/melee/player/JSalt?id=S7277"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", and you'll see that I have an immaculate record against players/characters that have upset your favorite top players recently, and an Armada/Hanky Panky-esque win rate.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As you might've guessed, a vast majority of those wins I listed were netplay wins, so they don't count at all to a lot of people, and I get that. I also haven't gotten the chance to travel much outside of attending a major or two each year, so I haven't given myself enough chances to turn those online wins into offline wins. However, with there being no guarantee on how long any tourney series will last (RIP Big House and Shine) and not knowing how long I'll be able to continue playing Melee (I'm THIRTY-three!), I decided last year to venture out and make the effort to attend more big tourneys that I hadn't attended before and were outside of my local region, including Off-Season 2, Luminosity Makes Moves Miami, Santa Paws, and Combo Breaker 2024, made the top cut at every single one, and even won a couple \"Arcadian\" events along the way. I'm already attending Warehouse War 4 later this month, and being able to attend Supernova would cross another big name series off my \"bucket list\" of remaining tourneys I've yet to attend and attempt to make a big run at. Major success at any one of these could also propel me to attend even more tourneys later in the year and beyond, such as Riptide and other big regionals/majors, so the more I get to attend, the better chance that'll happen, and maybe even obtain a coveted Top 100 rank!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns already has one Salt, so why not add another one to the team ;)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"You can find me on Twitter/X: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://twitter.com/JSalt_","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://twitter.com/JSalt_"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Twitch (soonTM): ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.twitch.tv/jsalt","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.twitch.tv/jsalt"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Empower the Donkey Kong Renaissance - ckyulmiqnudaetr for Supernova
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmdx8qenX56SxzUu9i2c5PQTrjFKupWAVHvXMFkZ3X9vkg","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Photo credit: @bluerosetori","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am ckyulmiqnudaetr, currently a top 2 Melee Donkey Kong player in the world, and ranked 77th on the SSBMrank 2023. I have been competing since 2014 maining a plethora of characters including Falco, Ice Climbers, Fox and Yoshi, but I've found DK has been the character I have had the most fun with. Fun fact, I am the only player to make top 64 at Big House in different years with 3 different solo mains, being Ice Climbers, Fox and DK, and I did it while taking on a heavy responsibility each year as an operations lead for the event.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Over the last 2 years, I have significantly developed and showcased DK's potential in the Melee metagame, achieving results that would've have been unthinkable for the character prior to 2023 when he was considered a low tier character. I only wish to continue showing off DK's strength as a character by continuing to compete. Supernova would be an opportunity for me to add to my incredible results so far this year.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"So far this year, I have won Bodied 7 over multiple top 30 players, considered to be either the most or 2nd most impressive tournament win a DK player has ever won, and have had strong showings at the supermajors GOML 2024 and Tipped Off 15, placing 13th and 25th respectively. With my stellar results this year, I am in contention for being the best DK player and am on the ballot for the SSBMrank Summer 2024 top 50 rankings, for which I have a strong chance of placing higher than any DK main has been ranked before.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"Image","src":"https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GM2zWkjWkAAnMwK?format=jpg&name=large","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I have the utmost confidence that I will rep Nouns to the similar success I've had at previous tournaments this year, and this will be a chance to boost my year end ranking to the highest ranking for a solo Donkey Kong player ever. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Besides, wouldn't it be hilarious for Cody Schwab's sponsor to send DK to a supermajor?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1158554290919575583/1262993222439796816/unknown-1.png?ex=66989d99&is=66974c19&hm=14cf632ff277a748fb85463550753407b55c9f35e758ff7d9f01629d3995d11d&","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Why you should let me go to TI and root for NOUNS
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"HALLO","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Who am I: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am a passionate 22 year-old member of the USAF, currently serving as a 2nd Lieutenant and current in training for Cyberspace Warfare. Beyond my military duties, Dota 2 has been an integral part of my life since the  age of 9. Over the years, I've accumulated over 14,000 hours in this game that I live, love, and breathe. For me, Dota 2 isn't just a hobby but  a profound passion that has shaped my understanding of strategy, teamwork, and dedication.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why Choose Me?","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Voting for me means supporting a dedicated Dota 2 enthusiast who embodies the spirit of perseverance and commitment. Despite the financial challenges that come with military service, I am determined to seize the opportunity to attend The International this year. My MMR of 9.8k reflects not only my skill but also the countless hours I've invested in mastering this game. If chosen, I am prepared to proudly display my dedication by getting a tattoo of Nouns Esports' logo... a permanent mark of gratitude for this incredible opportunity!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Who you are Supporting: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Behold the strength of Nouns #1 fan! ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://imgur.com/a/W17dIpU","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://imgur.com/a/W17dIpU"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", this is a picture of me two years ago while I was attending VMI (Virginia Military Institute). For more information of what VMI is like here is a link: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xQFQxwPhtHE&ab_channel=BusinessInsider","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xQFQxwPhtHE&ab_channel=BusinessInsider"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":". I have been an avid watcher of Dota 2 Esports since I was around 11 years old. My favorite team/roster of my dota 2 lifespan has been the TI 5 roster of Fear, Sumail, Universe, AUI_2000, and of course PPD. This roster inspired me to great lengths to improve myself to compete with the best. Over the years as I watched EG slowly deteriorate, I still watch the scene to not only improve myself and keep up with the meta, but to also keep up with the scene. So not only am I up to date with the current scene, I would love to watch Nouns dominate and secure TI13 and bring NA to glory!!!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Why you should let me make Nouns content
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi my name is Benjamin Kopilow I am a Dota 2 caster and I am looking to make content at TI for and with nouns. I've been a Dota 2 caster for almost a decade I've been playing the game for more so than that and I'm an average Dota player just like you. I am looking to make the best content possible and know my way around events like this to do so. I've spent a majority of my life surrounded by the game of Dota and want to continue to do my best to surround my life with it even more. I believe that choosing me is a great choice because I have experience making content inside of the Dota scene. Hopefully I'll be able to make content with fans with players and talent. TI is a time to be celebrated by the Dota community and also to show off that celebration in content in the future to come. Thank you for your time.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Rank 25 NA midlaner ready to embrace the memes and create content
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am Ray \"AlienManaBanana\" M currently ranked 25th in North America (NA) in Dota 2 playing midlane. With a deep passion for the game and a keen understanding of its nuances, I have spent countless hours not only honing my skills but also engaging with the Dota 2 community (have a reputation I understand but I'm ready to embrace the memes). ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As a top-ranked player in the NA region, I have a lot of knowledge of the game that goes beyond basic gameplay. I understand team strategy and can provide insights into each game while also embracing the uniqueness of Dota and the memes of Dota. The current meta is invaluable for creating content that resonates with both seasoned players and newcomers.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Dota 2 community in NA has seen a decline in recent years, and there is a pressing need to revive interest and engagement. My goal is to reignite this passion by creating content that not only entertains but also educates and inspires. By embracing the memes and humor that are an integral part of the Dota 2 culture, I aim to create a relatable and enjoyable experience for fans.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My position as a high-ranked player gives me access to some of the best players in the world. I plan to conduct exclusive interviews with these players, providing insights into their thought processes, strategies, and personal stories. These interviews will not only shed light on the personalities behind the game but also offer valuable lessons for aspiring players.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I have a particular interest in promoting Team Nouns, a team that I hope has the potential to make a significant impact in the tournament. Through detailed analysis and supportive content, I will highlight their strengths, strategies, and journey in the championship. This will help build a stronger fan base for the team and showcase the talent that exists within the NA region.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Consider voting for me! You guys won't regret it and it'll be a fun ride!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Frog Technology Explained in Copenhagen
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmW1i7TBZdnsftgvLFk15TH8TuYxrtruAD11qKF987h1Uy","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am Frog Technology Explained.  Contrary to the initial impressions of the unwashed masses, my purpose is not to explain frogs or their technology. My purpose is to make content within the Dota 2 esports space. I was not born. I was forged beneath the Earth's mantle by unbelievable heat and immense pressure, hammered by shifting tectonic plates and carved by magma rivers into a machine that creates high quality Dota 2 content.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To prove my ability to make great content with the Nouns team, I teamed up with Fly and Gunnar to make a video! If you're going to keep reading this proposal, please watch the video below as it's the most important part. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Interviewing Fly and Gunnar in my attic (youtube.com)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PpY-c9WUbDk"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've had success on YouTube, garnering over 150,000 lifetime views and tens of fans. I've also hit the top spot on the Dota 2 Reddit several times with my videos, while being a relatively unknown entity in the scene. Here are some of my favorites: ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Gabe Addresses no Soundproof Booths at TI (youtube.com)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tl1xkGM6uh4"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The problem with this Battle Pass (youtube.com)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cpghkmL4DJk"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I was also the video editor for Arkosh gaming, and helped make some content that did really well for them. I've also worked with Team Liquid and Tundra in the past. I've dabbled with in-person interviews/on scene reporting for TI, and made some things that I'm proud of and looking forward to improving upon. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y5F0pZtgp4A","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=y5F0pZtgp4A"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Quizzing TI on the sounds of Dota : r/DotA2 (reddit.com)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.reddit.com/r/DotA2/comments/17ko2nz/quizzing_ti_on_the_sounds_of_dota/"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My goal when making videos is simply to create something that I would enjoy watching. I take lots of inspiration from the 'Slime on the Scene' series of videos made for Melee, as well as Beyond the Summit skits. Really exceptional esports content is evergreen - viewers will come back to revisit it years later and don't need to remember the specifics of the patch, the groupstage draw, or the tournament meta to understand and appreciate it.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Most esports content is formulaic, forgettable horse piss. They ask their players paint by the numbers interview questions that have been asked a trillion times, and we get the same answers. No one cares what Fly's top 5 supports of the patch are. No one cares how much the fanbase means to Lelis. No one wants to rewatch nouns' best plays of the tournament but with EDM music over it. Even the most hardcore nouns fans won't care to revisit this type of content in 3 months, much less in a year. Slapping the kekw guy laughing over your video won't help either. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The content needs to showcase the players, but you need to give them something interesting or unique to bounce off of, otherwise it comes across as completely inauthentic, corporate, and devoid of personality. It isn't Copy's job to have a personality that's interesting for the camera, so you need to put him in interesting or funny situations to bring out aspects of his personality that normally can't be accessed.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Most of the content would be interview stuff like the videos I've made in the past: people into novel situations and asking unexpected questions to bring out their personality. I will also read up on Matcha and shill it nasty-like if I win. I'll shill it big for you. I'll be your prize hog, just for you! 'Serious traders need serious pricing' is a very powerful message! ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Please watch my videos to get a sense of my comedic style and previous work! Glory to the Nouns. Death to Fungability.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Channel:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Frog Technology Explained - YouTube","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/@FrogTechnologyExplained/videos"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"X the everything app:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Phillip (@FrogTechs) / X","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/FrogTechs"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: JESSJENIUS x NOUNS - the matcha made in heaven
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns doesn’t need any random content creator for TI. Nouns needs an entertainer who loves the game. As a partnered twitch streamer known for her passionate raging in DOTA 2, I, JessJenius, am your answer.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmR3EwcyhraJwcVTDoibhkysAieaeSBFzPWLCReJ9tX4n8","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I have been in an almost toxic relationship with DOTA2 since its release, and made my first video about my love for the game 10 years ago (","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-IsmhcGqxpQ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-IsmhcGqxpQ"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":").","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My DOTA 2 content on TikTok has over 30,000 combined views. I’m engaging, funny, super charismatic, but most importantly, I have been a nouns supporter from DAY 1!!!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmVCQ9uRF1iZX8RbiWpd42wXqLYGzgTQAKhhqTbHMVLCo8","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUyP7wR9qZ2TPdoKgCgcgWKkA4VD6STx1pGmb2U6g8nFG","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUeUpu8v9UXqwKs1RCiVmbUKwpiXZjwg9fFEeSfDtm8d9","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I also have some connections in the DOTA 2 community – so I think I am well-placed to get juicy interviews from everyone’s favourite DOTA 2 players and personalities.
