title: BUDSTER the "Content King"
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am BUDSTER, a fan of DotA since I was 12! Back when I was younger, I wanted to be a professional DotA player because I love the game and the esports side even more. I'm 23 now and although I don't have anywhere near the skill of the pros, I never let that get me down and continued on the path to forging a career in DotA esports! Back in season 4 of NADCL hosted by Nouns' own PPD, I made connections where I could and eventually in season 6, I became the Manager of Astronaut Esports, run by Nouns' own Boosh! Since then I've been a panelist on NADCL, casted games for Chompix Turbomaniacs, and also managed the Astronaut Esports roster in the Chompix Shop Championship so I'm definitely not camera shy and I'm dedicated to the sport! I joined the Nouns community not too long ago after an invite from PPD and many many recommendations from Boosh who believed my energy and dedication were a perfect match for Nouns!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Once upon a time, even PPD called me the content king.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmR9613XGpRdezji8f4HRDYfdwQZqFmaNvbQGvjDTnYLKi","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"^ PPD","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"If I were to go to TI with Nouns, I have no trouble speaking on or being on camera. I am an extremely socially outgoing person in my day to day life. I find it easy to approach people and start conversations. I believe my skillset would be a perfect fit for Nouns at TI given my deep knowledge of the game and tournaments as well as my high-energy and uncontrollably optimistic personality!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmXsNuZnVtXcHWRhoe4Q2A4nzwJpfFxrjCUeYMoQjeZkCU","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"^ Turbo Maniacs Liquipedia page","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmbpK485W5RYkgzLUogemZmfDrdeKvxZEUdroXskkF41fw","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"^ Me in the NADCL Player Draft","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmXaYPF73XAxq4QexetRhUi712J96howJ9eM8CVWzrAbvQ","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"^ Me drenched after going out in a storm because I was too excited to wait to get my team gear","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: DarkGenex presents The "NINTENDO HATES ME T-Shirt"
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmfHtuk6NU7KhQMbDt5BGmVemaPe3nPyqhhi3H3b2tXkMG","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"BREAKING NEWS!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My tag is DarkGenex, I've played various roles in community over the last few years, including national commentator, Icies/Giant Melee/Giga Bowser player, major TO, PR Banner designer and short video creator (including the now retired \"This Week in Melee\" series featuring the Spongebob fish head). At one point of time I was the head TO of The Nightclub, once Magi's video editor, etc. I'm currently involved with SSBMRank, as a blurb writer, a balloter, and a team member. title: TI Partnership - Apex Genesis Owner. Fostering revitalization of the NA Dota Scene
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi everyone - I'm eagle2120, the current owner of Apex Genesis. ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://liquipedia.net/dota2/Apex_Genesis"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As a passionate Dota player whose deep-rooted NA  deeply rooted love for the NA scene led him to create/sponsor a T3 NA team, I'm thrilled to submit my proposal for your TI13 content creation opportunity. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My journey with Dota began over a decade ago, and I've witnessed firsthand the ups and downs of our beloved NA Dota community. I was there when EG won TI5, and I've been to every NA-based TI since. Now, I believe we're on the cusp of a renaissance in the NA scene, and I want to be at the forefront, documenting this pivotal moment in our region's history.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Deep Understanding of the NA Scene","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":": As a team owner and longtime community member, I have unique insights into the challenges and triumphs of NA Dota from a unique perspective. My content will not just showcase TI13, but contextualize it within our region's narrative and relate it to the history of the region, looking back at historical NA Dota moments.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Established Network","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":": My connections with players, casters, and behind-the-scenes staff will provide exclusive access, resulting in intimate interviews and behind-the-scenes content that fans crave.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community Focus","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":": My content will bridge the gap between fans and pros, showcasing the passion of the Dota community and inspiring the next generation of NA talent, while giving them a unique perspective of an Esports team owner. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The International isn't just a tournament; it's a celebration of Dota's global community. By sending me to Copenhagen, we can:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Showcase NA talent and storylines on the world stage","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Connect our regional narratives to the global Dota ecosystem","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Inspire young NA players by highlighting paths to pro (I have a few different plans for the T2/T3 scene revitalization in NA...)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Strengthen ties between NA organizations, fostering a more collaborative competitive environment","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":4}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"number","start":1,"tag":"ol"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Here are some of my Innovative Content Ideas: ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\"Day in the Life\" Vlogs","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":": Following NA players on different teams from wake-up call to post-match analysis, talking about how their NA experience has shaped them, and what they had to adapt to coming from the NA region. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\"NA Dota: Past, Present, Future\"  Series","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":": Featuring NA Legends (e.g. Fear) alongside rising NA stars","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Interactive Fan Challenges","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":": Bringing the energy of Copenhagen back to NA viewers","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\"Unsung Heroes\" Features","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":": Spotlighting the coaches, managers, and support staff behind NA's resurgence","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":4},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"NA Dota Archaeology: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Deep-dive documentary series exploring the evolution of Dota strategies, and NA's role in the burgeoning Coaching scene over time. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":5},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"NA Dota Bufferly Effect:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Creating \"What-if\" scenarios based on critical moments in Dota 2 History, using a mix of pro player insights and AI simulations to explore alternate timelines. As soon as a big play occurs (e.g., game-winning teamfight, incredible save), mint it as an NFT. Fans can instantly buy, sell, and trade these moments using Matcha. Integrate with live streams to allow instant purchasing during hype moments, and usage of them as chat emotes. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":5},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Matcha Draft Simulator: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Create a Dota draft simulator based on the TI meta that predicts team compositions. Fans can compete against AI and each other in drafting contests, as well as integration into Fantasy League drafts (centered around Heroes, rather than players). ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":6},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Matcha-Powered Crowd Quests: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Similar to Geocaching, create a series of daily quests for attendees (e.g., visit all team booths, attend signing sessions). Completion rewards include Matcha tokens and exclusive digital collectibles. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":7}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"number","start":1,"tag":"ol"},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I have plenty of other ideas about content and integrations with Matcha, but I'll cut it short for now. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To summarize - Sending me to TI13 isn't just about creating content; it's about catalyzing a movement. Through compelling storytelling, community engagement, and innovative Web3 integrations, we can use this opportunity to fan the flames of NA Dota's resurgence.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Let's show the world that NA Dota is back, stronger and more united than ever. Together, we can turn TI13 into a launching pad for our region's bright future.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for considering my proposal. I'm ready to pour my heart and soul into making TI13 an unforgettable experience for Nouns, Matcha, and the entire NA Dota community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Let's make history in Copenhagen!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Eagle2120","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Charlie Franks","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Apex Genesis Owner + NA Dota Enthusiast","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: EU Regional Finals 2024
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello! I'm Serac, a 26 years old woman from Mexico, I'm a baker on a small bakery and in my free time I really like to spend time trying to be creative, specially in writing but I'm constantly practicing my drawing. Pokemon has been a big part of my life, and even though I don't play Pokemon Unite on competitions, I have been following Nouns journey a couple years now and watching all their competitions, I enjoy a lot watching their rapport and the way they play! I wish them all the best in Hawai!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To be honest, I just wanted to show some appreciation for the guys on the team, that's why I decided to replicate their team in the last match against Conoisseurs on the EU regional finale and them dressing like the pokemon they choose on that match, I really hope they are identifiable enough! Some of them were definitely a challenge!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'll put the process I use while drawing, first making a rough sketch, then cleaning it a bit and after that doing the linework. Some small fixes here and there, some colors and that's it!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcKPJFiYhCX5dH7vrko9nz3E7RzTE34b5JjeXjjS5RY1p","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmPGrn7kUfm33oq2XStjH9W1N4Gyi8WtjmZjMtfE47Kffc","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcBAxam959beYR5uGaTnZTpYHpNDc4Df2pWr4kWJKdyeL","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmY1Ec8CnFQzUhaPkaG9FtK6amTxsKx5vjEm9qxAAQeEzg","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Monty Makes Esports Fashionable
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"HOWDY! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmQS79QtLbYot6FWnSUsuKRyXqv8tm8iUFshsKN2MUSQdF","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It’s me, Monty! Graphic design has always been a hobby of mine and I'm a huge fan of Melee! While following the scene, I've always been quick to make an edit or meme","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmS1C1dt7jEcxyPEGYnEPc95fNJ3n3umL5rqSgkwbHYAQy","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"but recently I have been wanting to branch out into more serious designs. I have made a couple of graphics commonly used by the community to display Tournament Results and Power Rankings","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmZdtmdnyEodTefD1XCBpmvcdd25Qeun7b4FHpeEqicFJc","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This, however, is the first time I have ever worked with creating a graphic for clothing, so I hope you all enjoy it! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"DESIGN INSPIRATION ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I have been a fan of video games and the culture since I was wee lad. Video game merch has always been pretty basic and required a lot of dressing up to present a stylish look. My aim was to bring to life pieces that can stand strong on their own. With the y2k renaissance in full swing, the tote bags design is heavily inspired by the internet’s romanticization. The Nouns Esports design is a take on the “Retro Revival” that saw more love in 2022 but is still very charming. And last, but maybe my favorite, is our (melee) player representation. This piece is heavily inspired by brutalism and is perfect for layering or just wearing on its own. We as a community deserve more cute and appealing melee merch and I am hoping this can be the first step towards that!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Here is a closer look at each design. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmVwzVvECjhEVQHwYf2Sua1L3hTVxaR237F6NECRVxEJDP","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for taking the time to read through all this! I love what Nouns Esports is doing for the Melee community. Sponsoring our events, our players, hosting invitationals... It feels great knowing Nouns has our back, which makes me even more excited to contribute. Even if you don’t vote for me, I hope you leave this post inspired to try some new elements :) ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: It's a me, Nouns-rio!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmdDQe19gizvooUVc2WvbRMJUqpASfx6WGuR45Nic65YF8","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Heya everybody! The name's Crispy, your average freelance digital artist and avid gamer from the Philippines. I've been creating digital art and graphic designs since 2017. When I heard about this contest, I quickly whipped out my drawing pen and tablet to begin my creative and simple idea. This is my first time designing merchandise but I couldn't be happier with how it turned out.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"DESIGN IDEA","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For the Nounsvitational Merchandise Art Contest, my design is inspired by Mario from the Mario Bros. Series who is a well-loved and featured character in Super Smash Bros. This design not only tastefully captures the essence of Mario but also inherits the Nouns Esports brand, resulting in a fascinating piece of merchandise in its shopping bag.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmRrsrEgtxjRzWR2qv2VJA9kX4Xub8ckd7hc2V3FWvzMou","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"DESIGN DETAILS","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Logo Integration: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Nouns logo is the showpiece of this new original, making sure that it will be observed to all customers who come in contact with it as well.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Mario Hat: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In respect to Mario, the Nouns logo is designed with Mario's little iconic red hat. His immediately recognizable cap adds a playful air to the piece.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Text: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also, you can find one of Mario's famous lines: \"Wahoo!\" I bet you heard it in his voice when you read it. This lively expression goes well with the design's vivid feel.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Merchandise Applications: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It could be used to adapt different products such as bags or caps; this design is very versatile so no matter what the format for different product interfaces should never be a problem.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"FINAL THOUGHTS","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am very pleased to be taking part in the Nounsvitational Merchandise Art Contest and to make a substantial contribution to its success. I am hoping that my design combining elements from Mario and Nouns will almost certainly win some tenders from fans as well as the wider gaming community. Thank you for giving me this opportunity and thank you for reading this far. Buh-bye!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Loafer, the Kazuya GOAT
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ve been playing competitive smash since the release of ultimate. During the early years of the game I showed prowess but lacked direction, making top 15 in Indiana while making my way through school and work. I went through a character crisis for a long time but after squad strike of riptide 2023 decided that I was going to completely dedicate myself to kazuya. since then I hit the lab religiously and improved my results tremendously. I went from the guy who made top 8s at locals to the guy who wins most of them, and recently made Indiana state PR at #7 as well as placing top 8 in the Indiana regional South Bend Fight Club, with wins on the number 3 and 5 players in the state. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I believe that the most important part of improvement is having an improvement mindset. While rankings are good for data, on an individual level, improving your gameplay should come first. I’m a religious follower of coaches corner, and am currently trying to find a coach that can help me find the weaknesses in my own gameplay I cannot identify. I am the type of player to vod review my tournament wins and losses the night of or day after to see what I need to take into consideration. I have extensive notes over every player in my region, and am part of a greater network of Indiana kazuyas that take notes over all players in Indiana. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The one weakness I feel i have right now is the inability to go to as many large scale tournaments as I would like due to funding. I currently work a full time job and a seasonal job that is nearing its end for the year, which is when I’ll kick it into high gear. I am attending supernova and riptide as well as all Indiana regionals, hopefully I can enter more. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"If you want someone with a true passion for learning and improving, and for smash ultimate as a whole then I am your guy. Ask anyone in my life and they will tell you they have never seen anyone more dedicated to a game than I am. With the right team of likeminded people alongside me I feel like i would be a great addition to your lineup.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Twitter: @peebusgriffin","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for reading!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: malk, MDVA's Platform Fighter Entheusiast
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Heya! I'm malk, I've been a diehard platform fighter player since early 2014, originally starting with Melee but eventually playing various platform fighters over the years, including all of the official Smash games, mods like Brawl Minus and Project M/+, fan games like Super Smash Flash 2 and Super Smash Bros Crusade (including having spent time on the dev team), and other games like Rivals of Aether, Rivals 2, and Slap City. Nowadays, my main focus is P+, where I am one of the strongest players in my region with wins over Hyperflame, Junebug, Shadowhawke, and many other high level players, but I'm looking to make a splash in Rivals 2 once it drops! I've already had a strong start during the beta period, where I've won every event in my region (we'll see how I do at Hitfall 3!) without dropping a set and had a strong 5th place performance at Creed 3, where I gained wins over the likes of MSB and Jut as well as tied for highest placing Kragg of the event! Due to various circumstances over the years, I've rarely had the opportunity to travel outside of my home region of MDVA. I would kill for the chance to be able to rep Nouns at Riptide for Rivals 2 and P+ and finally get a chance to leave/compete outside of the east coast for the first time in my life! It's been a dream of mine to be able to compete at a huge out of region major like this for as long as I've been playing, so I would be forever grateful if you voted for me!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Seesaw, Incineroar Gaming
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello! I'm Jake \"Seesaw\" West, one of the best Incineroar players in the United States, hailing from Washington, with wins on players such as Kaninabe, Bassmage, Ouch, JDV, Moxi, Captain L, Peckham, and Doorstop. I'm ranked in both Washington and BC due to my heavy participation in both regions. I'm also a huge doubles enthusiast with several top 50 wins and top 8 placements at majors in the format, including a top 3 placing at GOML 2023 with wins over players like MKLeo, Big Boss, Lemmon, and Machu. I believe I would be a good pick for this opportunity for a couple of reasons. Firstly, I turn up at majors. In the last couple years I've gotten 33rd at GOML 2024, 25th at Battle of BC 6, 49th at Port Priority 8, and 49th at GOML 2023. I've gotten better every single year I've played this game and have full confidence in myself to be able to keep it going and turn up the jets at big events when given the opportunity to show what I can do. Secondly, I play an underrepresented character that most people would like to see more of. Scroll through Ultimate Twitter for 5 minutes during a major and you'll see hundreds of complaints about having to watch the same Steve, Sonic, and Game & Watch games play out over and over again. Right now Skyjay is the only Incin contributing on an international stage, and people love watching him (myself included), but I'd like to show that top level Incin play isn't a 1 man show. Finally, I'd like to bring more exposure to the PNW. I believe we are one of the most underrated regions in the world, and even though recently players like Big D and Ouch have been bringing a little more attention to us I want to show that there's leagues of threatening players residing here. I love repping my character, I love repping my region, and I think if you let me represent Nouns I'll love that too. Thank you!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: KUNOAH REGIONAL EXPLORER (Lucas Main)
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey, my name is Noah. I have been playing Smash Ultimate since the game came out grinding the crap out of quickplay and playing amongst friends almost in any situation I can get. My first introduction to the franchise is when I got Smash Brawl for the Wii. Playing through Subspace Emissary and having it as a fun party game at gatherings so much more special. I played Smash 4, but I did not really understand the competitive scene or even what labbing is. Like for many others who recently started this game, I started competing in the online era because COVID made it hard for there to even be a scene. Some notable placements include placing 257th at the SWT NA Northeast Ultimate Online Qualifier and 9th at Smash Ultimate Online East Coast. When offline locals became a thing, I found myself unsure if I would do well other that just my school brackets. My first official experience of the offline smash scene was actually in Singapore in Fall 2023. I found myself not only doing well getting 7th at APC 31 and 17th/62 at Asia esports Festival 2023, but I was able to develop community with people that also want to get better at the game as well. I evidently was only there from Aug to Dec because my exchange program was over. That new perspective and experience helped me be able to get 9th on the Dayton Ohio PR in the following Spring Season. Unfortunately, I am not present there anymore because I graduated from my college and started competing back home. As of this middle of this May, I started being a part of the North Carolina scene placing 193rd at Patchwork 2024 which was my first major to ever attend. I know I have not competed at the offline scene nearly as much, but I know that with the right motivation and drive I will strive to become the best player I can be. For me personally, this game had allowed me to meet people I never would have met otherwise as well as make some pretty close friends that helped me reach potential in grinding the game I would have never deemed possible. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"So thank you to Singapore Smash, Ohio Smash, NC Smash, C&H Smash (SCS Crew) for everything and I hope that if I get this opportunity, I can make you guys proud and show the same love you guys have shown me through my gameplay. Also to anyone reading this, thank you for reading my story and what this game means to me! title: Nouns SSBM Merchandise Proposal by Cresty
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmXE9TMkXin3Wp4Dbgjymk2XSAv2sVZdzSA7hjkeWvBTbu","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey, I'm Liam, also known as Cresty or Mackeni Arts! I’m an artist/graphic designer from London, Ontario who currently works in the graphic design industry. I’ve been playing melee competitively for about a year, but I’ve been watching melee since 2014. A big shoutout to the London and Windsor communities for being awesome, supporting me in my journey in melee and for hosting awesome events. I’m happy to have a chance to create merchandise concepts for Nouns.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSzTJsyEUWkbtUr2kifzSD9Uui2UTQCWNJbxfDQxvJaF4","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A picture of me ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'd love for my work to be featured in such a cool event. I love melee and being a part of an event such as this would be awesome.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I created two separate pieces with a couple variations each.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Concept 1","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The first piece that I created was more focused on the spacies, as I feel like fox and falco are synonymous with melee and two of Nouns players play fox and Salt has a falco secondary. As well, I wanted to make a simple pun that I personally find funny, I hope you do as well. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSNw6XhwKtK59naYknVpuX7o5CUopnSo35bQ4H5LW8NDs","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSdpD2GqurAmZjGRmcpihFkzmnKFX644eudUDJjv8VaEM","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I also created variations of the shirt that are just one of the characters without words.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmdPAp7w5wFkTkRkrtY5MwxkdSj3eZJ3bddExQJJUWLuaP","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmR4jAgb6jZfCYpd8qm99X9AtVQ5qJqyH4ghkNwtmyw3jn","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Concept 2","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For my second Concept I really wanted to make a design that covers the whole cast, as I know people joke that melee only has a couple viable characters, the reality is at this point every character is played to some degree of a high level. I decided to make a design that shows off every character as a silhouette with the words \"Choose Your Character\".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmWvkUFo5bSCnCXsGf32MJfyxx1eLdie9Q3McXneXpy2Jh","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmPeF9is5oSN5FjDFML1YpFFUemcYtcK4ZDXELUnjmGufw","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmRkUzeKTw6cxK7YDJpX9m9mbRk7FVL4XArP1YeHQxpBSL","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I title: Melee Battlefield Doodle by Jakob "Neqzn" Annel
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello!","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" My name is ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Jakob Annel","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" aka ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Neqzn","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", and I am an artist and fox main from Tennessee. A lot of my art/doodles focuses on the flow state, which is the mental state in which a person performing some activity is fully focused and at peak performance. For Melee, this mental state is super important to be able to tap into when competing. For my piece, I wanted to create something that represents the game I love and the flow state. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmP9PA1TYu9raqutuHmtekAprJALXc73ksonrKCAysKTBq","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmepHBsit9fBkUfMpdTLftGBT5JnwiSorHfqg4ok6DkKuH","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This piece is made with acrylic paint and pen on a 16x20 canvas","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"and took about 9 hours in total to complete!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSgHcp5XBHYcfhReT8aSeV3qCxrnsp6QrJvpWutRn2XG6","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My goal with my doodle paintings are to create something that not only captures the viewers attention, but keeps it by having something elaborate and with lots of detail presented. This doodle painting feature unique easter eggs that can't be seen at first glance, so be sure to look at it closely! ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Website: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.jakobannel.com","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.jakobannel.com"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"@jakobannel on Twitter and Instagram!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: "OUTLAST" by Schmeez for the NOUNSVITATIONAL!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUcv8yL3JUeZVG9B8EFds1k6VNV7rC6Gw6yqRLRLgjRfQ","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmP4FssNxjZtz3RK3A9kDpVg6314NVo3cWtgAuqK5RWa6v","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmTWUcDnztfZ9ou2HeAyCCPMUQax9yEGBKZrZ3Ky1Nqewk","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Introduction","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey Everyone, ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Schmeez ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"here! I'd like to present my entry for the NOUNSVITATIONAL Merch Art Contest. I've been in the smash scene for a little over 7 years now, where I've donned many hats from a simple volunteer working my way up to running the biggest SSBM local Toronto has seen post-pandemic. Along the way, I have always felt the urge to contribute beyond just attending. I've always had friends encouraging me to branch into the smash community with my graphic design experience and boom, here we are, essentially the tl;dr of how I got into making merch!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUfWjfFeXgQYhqRFhMFDLN4wYwshj9AqRcd48x2JGF8Qe","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"(@atheen_art 📸)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Goals for Merch in Smash","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've always wanted to support the scene through purchasing event merch but often in the past I felt there was a large gap to be filled for designs specifically made to be printed and worn out and about. That's the gap I've been trying to fill for several years now. Thankfully, my talents have been recognized by several groups, which allowed for my successful merch runs at GOML, BOBC, and Galint Melee Open for multiple years in a row!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm always making designs for my friends because it's a creative outlet, whether its merch, stream overlays, emotes, PR graphics, or just random shitposts. I've done it all and I want to keep getting better at it, so any support during this campaign would be much appreciated. My philosophy has not changed when it comes to designing and I want YOU to be able to support the scene wearing some awesome merch!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This Design","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've recently been inspired by the brutalistic streetwear art style and I've tried to incorporate a tame version of it into this design, but I also wanted to remain true to the scene and Nouns themselves. Unfortunately, I was made aware of this contest less than 48 hours ago, hence the quite literal last minute entry but I'm really thankful for my friends that encouraged me to submit!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"However, I'm not limited to this design, and am open to feedback before it hits the Nounsvitational shop. I truly believe in an iterative process when it comes to wearable designs, hence why I'm always bugging my friends for feedback whenever I get commissioned to design for an event 😅. Additionally, I'm also very open to making more for the shop if the community takes a liking to my style and abilities!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Every Vote Matters!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I want to thank anyone that votes for me in advance and I'm grateful for all the opportunities this scene has provided for me. Please feel free to reach out to me over discord (schmeez) or twitter (","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/Schmeez__"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":") if you have any feedback, more merch ideas, or just wanna say hi :)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'll leave you with a few more designs I've recently made and a collection of some merch I've done in the past that you may recognize ;) - ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1E8qkxu4P48sMrdhCxxHg8zg3u79sYJd-","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer noopener","target":"_blank","title":"https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1E8qkxu4P48sMrdhCxxHg8zg3u79sYJd-","url":"https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1E8qkxu4P48sMrdhCxxHg8zg3u79sYJd-"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmRi7PX9BheMCeRyKNxjDr3DiXWpWHFqFXfTi91HjAdc2z","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmfNCcbjC9t1JQd1bXBhtA6RB4KSy7BC652MbJUKQvzq81","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmPyVRMw2nhHM5AQrB1VdFHciNB6yCfBCqHwFNTPGZsyYw","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmQjayLM4cV3GsB9je1ct8jAaJb6WPczqM2RYvyZ5J1ZD3","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: 52 hit Juri combo
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey there👋 I'm kina. I really love fighting games and combos, so whenever I get a chance, I will learn one. This combo took me 4 hours to land (it's not that hard) mainly because of its 2 rejump​s. I have never seen a Juri land a combo like this online but it's not too difficult once you learn it. This combo is only possible in the corner with 3 fuha stocks. If there is any delay in the combo, you wont be able to do the enders because the full combo does take up the whole Feng Shui Engine meter. With that being said, you will have to hit confirm with a medium or a heavy attack into Feng Shui Engine to start the combo. After you hit confirm into level 2, you must start the combo with forward heavy punch in order to get more plus frames for the loops. After the first loop, you have to add in an extra crouching medium punch in order to keep the combo going. After the jump cancel, you need to delay the jumping medium punch and heavy kick just a little in order to get the first rejump. Anyways here it is😁 ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://youtube.com/shorts/dQWpg9P5n0Y?si=1PGK0Shc-VU_CRCB","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://youtube.com/shorts/dQWpg9P5n0Y?si=1PGK0Shc-VU_CRCB"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Let's engrave the name Nouns into the hearts of Dota fans together
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Nikola Babić. In the Dota community I am better known as ''hairy_freak'' or just ''hairy''. I am currently a Dota caster, with a background in competitive Dota as well. I stopped playing seriously around the time when DPC was introduced. In my not so amazing career I played with a couple of players that are well known in the Dota world, or used to be well known. Davai Lama, Nande, Ar1se are some notable players I had teams with, and have coached a team with Lama and Exotic_Deer. And of course have played some qualifiers with stacks that include some other top tier players.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"There are a couple of reasons I think I would be a great fit for the role at TI:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-I have worked as a TV host/caster/stage host and even as a news reader. So it's not only my Dota casting that I am bringing, I have the knowledge of how to position myself and someone I am talking to so that it looks good on camera. Which is a great asset to have. Even though we want the clips to be casual we also don't want the viewers thinking amateurs made them","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-I have played competitively, been in the coach role, I know the game on a competitive level inside and out. Asking questions to the players themselves about the game and their results is something that I can deliver on a higher level than most.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-I have somewhat of a personal connection with the team. Or rather with the coach Milan. Before he took on a role in Nouns as a coach, we were a casting duo and did a couple of tournaments. That personal connection can sometimes be transferred to the viewers and increase the quality of the product. Of course we know each other even before our casting days.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Some of the Nouns players are into fitness and weightlifting. Even though I am not at my peak strength at the moment I am a gym rat, we could film some interesting training videos, which will attract the audience even outside of Dota. Showing that Dota players aren't just these neerdy guys, but actually pretty devoted and focused individuals.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Some of the big Dota personalities have recently become parents. I am one of those people. And having a family man deliver the product is of huge help for the brand. If Dota, if Nouns want a future we need to start thinking about the next generation, that's how esports in general or anything for that matter becomes really huge. I can understand the struggles and will know how to ask questions to visitors with kids, and their feedback could help the industry in the long run, and will make our videos more viewed.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-When it comes to Matcha as a sponsor one thing that came to mind to promote the brand would be giveaways. Something along the lines me and one player are going and giving stuff out to fans. We are exchanging hands and add a sentence like: ''What a great trade of hands, if You like trading without losing anything in the transfer check out Matcha''. But there could be millions of ways to introduce it in a spontaneous way like this. It's my job to find ways to sell the sponsor to the people through streams all the time so getting more ideas like this one should not be a problem.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Here are some of my social media links.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"X(twitter)     - ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/hairy_freak","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/hairy_freak"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"twitch           - ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.twitch.tv/hairy_freak","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.twitch.tv/hairy_freak"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Liquipedia   - ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://liquipedia.net/dota2/Hairy_freak","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://liquipedia.net/dota2/Hairy_freak"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"And I recently did something similar to what You are asking. content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Greetings Everyone,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Matthew, known online as Midgeworth. Attending The International (TI) has always been a dream of mine, and I’m excited to throw my hat into the ring and explain why I believe I deserve your vote.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've been a passionate fan of Dota 2 for 13 years, initially getting hooked thanks to Purge. I fondly remember those early days, playing support as Witch Doctor and Ogre Magi with friends. My love for the game quickly deepened, leading me to discover Ability Draft, which became my primary game mode.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Through Ability Draft, I’ve developed a unique perspective on how Dota 2 can be played. Whether it's envisioning Ogre Magi as a carry or utilizing Zeus as a nuking support, Ability Draft has broadened my understanding of the game’s limitless possibilities.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Given the chance to attend TI in Copenhagen, I’m eager to meet the Nouns Players and connect with fellow members of the Dota 2 community. I spend around 60 hours a week watching Dota 2 on Twitch, following tournaments and events with a deep appreciation for the distinct playstyles of every region—from the aggressive WEU to the methodical pace of SEA.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"You should vote for me not only for my passion for the Nouns team but also for my unwavering love for TI and its prestige. I am committed to immersing myself in every aspect of TI, from meeting players to witnessing epic team fights. I will ensure that every moment is captured and shared with the same enthusiasm and passion I have for Dota 2.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for considering my candidacy. Together, let’s make this TI unforgettable.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Best regards,  ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Matthew (Midgeworth)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"---","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: MGMG + Zaza: A Match Made in Heaven
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With this slick 2 for 1 campaign you can vote to get the LEGENDARY, TALL, and HANDSOME Michael \"MGMG\" Gracey to Riptide. The number 3 ONPR player is coming off a hot performance at GOML taking HungryBox to Game 5 and taking locals off of Faust and Maher; it seems there's nothing this tower of power can't do when he sets his mind to it. Most importantly, he has won the longest set of his life: his battle with the passport office, maintaining a strong record of 1-0. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"But wait, there's more! You ever go to a melee tournament and find yourself in need of a doubles partner? Well with this deal, MG will be bringing along the rank 8 ONPR player, the STUNNING, COMPOSED, and LOVABLE Zoey \"Zaza\" Marra. With recent sets on Faust and Chang0, she's been on the grind and looking to make a splash at a major event this year. With these two on a doubles team, the competition better be ready to hit the slides early! We recommend you bring a bathing suit. title: Vacation Postcard From Snorlax
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi! I’m Parker, a 25-year-old graphic and game designer from Atlanta, Georgia. Although I’ve only been aware of Nouns for a couple of years, I’m a huge fan of Nouns Esports and everything you all do. I really appreciate how the organization truly prioritizes community involvement, and it shows! ❤️","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In my submission, I aimed to incorporate all elements of the theme. I included references to past games, the tropical setting of the Pokémon World Championship, Nouns, and Pokémon Unite specifically.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmWPuvysU2u4nHZS1YvMka9inNKJ2EqPveSHEBmNorJUfW","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The thought of the Championship happening in Hawaii immediately reminded me of vintage postcards, so I aimed to recreate their composition and style. Since this is the \"Pokemon World,\" Alola, the tropical island region inspired by Hawaii, seemed like a fitting reference. Snorlax, my favorite Pokemon, fit perfectly with his Unite beach skin. Additionally, the Aeos Exchange beach ball added another thematic connection.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmS5NGiHzhzuRt57RPX8SiqyVypx1dL7fQot8EF1CJhVe2","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmNwhtctewFmYh2chL1LPK96xQc4vFyAss8cEikXRtmt37","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I created this piece using Adobe Illustrator and have been experimenting a lot with its 3D tool. While the tool is fun to use, it does have its limitations, requiring a lot of perspective trickery to achieve the desired effects.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"There's another version without the vintage grain and postcard look so I'll include that below.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qma7N1iedpU6aoTjQjKyGwPVmW4CUqE5aFGTx7n5Qj5u1Y","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My work in progress screen shots will be posted below.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmPiygScUNhBBRZBdpZRjs5b82k9dpbFpBEeZ7D3HJfby2","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"One last thing. There's a subtle reference I included that might not be immediately noticeable: the beach umbrella, chair, and table are actually the ones from the opening cut scene of \"Pokemon Puzzle League\" on the N64.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmeDfXXW3m4irGKt2DLwrGzhT5KeuYDqj2vP8qcS4rKfMR","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Serious shout out to any real ones who noticed.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you to anyone who took the time to read all this. I hope you enjoyed my little post card.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Help Fragadelphia Help North American Counter Strike
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are excited to bring to you an opportunity to partner with us for our upcoming Counter-Strike tournament, Fragicago 24. Our organization is seeking support from Nouns DAO to help us provide a better experience for our core demographic: NA aspiring Counter Strike players.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Scope of Work: We are organizing a Counter-Strike tournament featuring 32 teams, divided into 8 groups of 4. The format includes Best of 3 (BO3) matches, with the top 2 teams from each group advancing to the playoffs. We are seeking support to execute this event. While our event seems large we operate as a non-profit generating group. title: Return of The Spitoon
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“Best local I’ve ever been to”","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“The spiritual successor to Last Stock”","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“Immaculate vibes”","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“I will go to every tournament you run”","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"These are just a few examples of the feedback I’ve received since I started running Super Smash Bros Melee tournaments in 2022. The Salty Spitoon started off modestly, but quickly grew to be one of the hottest locals in San Diego, attracting all of the top players in the region. After taking a hiatus from TOing, I recently started hosting tournaments again, with much of the local community ecstatic at the return of The Spitoon. It is my hope that with a Nouns partnership, I will be able to take my tournament to the next level.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Let’s get the bad news out of the way. The melee locals scene is very grassroots, and while we may be adored by our local communities, our personal twitch channels aren’t putting up huge numbers. However, with the support of some of the best in the game, news will spread quickly across social media. And with the ability to stream on the Nouns Esports twitch channel, word will reach wherever there is a melee fan to be found.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am very experienced in running tournaments. With upwards of 60 under my belt, and overwhelmingly positive feedback from the attendees, I have no doubt in my ability to put on an excellent tournament. I am less experienced working with brands. I streamed a few tournaments on the twitch channel of Flyquest’s KoDoRiN, but outside of that I have not worked with any sponsors. I will be giving out Spitoon stickers at this event, if selected for a partnership, Nouns stickers will be given out, too. In addition, there will be a pair of noggles for every player.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our top priority at The Spitoon is to keep melee alive forever.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I like to make little trinkets to give to my favorite people at events and can make some sick Nouns Kandi bracelets to give to fans who agree to help make content for Nouns at TI! Below are some bracelets I have made for past events","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUH9SyBsekxf1NGwwMecsvDq6XhsvrotKZt1KQ11HuvWk","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmQYPr4GiDHBfR2fNs4wXkRZvbPsNNhuFYvWsFuc1dkMZH","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Special bracelet reserved for my favorite Dota person ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":2},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Because I am so used to guesting at and attending events, I can live off of black coffee and energy drinks and still keep my energy up to make content if it comes to that (hopefully it doesn't).","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"So ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"why Dota? ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I started watching Dota during TI 6. My housemates all left to go underway (they were all in the Navy) and I was alone with my PC in an empty house. I'm honestly not even sure HOW I got there, but I watched EVERY SINGLE GAME and loved it and started playing shortly after. I remember being like \"Oh it's in Seattle, cool I'm also living in America, I'll save up for a year (broke college kid problems) and go irl in 2 years\" HOWEVER the year I wanted to go that I was saving up for, TI was NOT in America... There is a happy ending however, I was finally about to attend TI for the first time last year for TI12 with it being back in Seattle which meant low plane ticket prices. Although I had attended, and even cosplayed at ESL events, TI hit different. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This game means a lot to me.
