content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm Kurraga and I've been running the Chord Cup series of events for the last couple years, an online tournament series started by follow minesweeper community member Jovilly and run by me after I took over organising for the last 3 iterations of the event, with out next event, Chord Cup 6, planned for September. We reached a viewership of 40+ concurrent viewers for the latest cup and have has as many as 46 participants in an event, with some of the top minesweeper players in the world staying up all night just to participate. Our regular entrants include 2 of the top 3 players on the expert rankings for ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://minesweeper.online/ranking","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://minesweeper.online/ranking"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", a popular minesweeper site with over 2 millions players on the rankings.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To promote the events we have a minesweeper community discord with over 1200 members and the actual Cord Cup server itself with over 250 and the Minesweeper News Twitter page to advertise it. title: Return to Vacationland 5
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"WELCOME TO VACATIONLAND! Return to Vacationland is a monthly Super Smash Brothers Melee tournament in Winslow, Maine on 8/10. Maine Melee is a small, yet rapidly growing scene, with one of the most active regional Melee discord servers in the world. The previous Vacationland entry was a wildly successful arcadian event with 12 entrants in the singles bracket and a very fun doubles bracket.","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmYmPSZ17cc9uD2sSygJQtaeTnLsbZtkyGpt84MyQiDwFz","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Our arcadian event was the first event we've streamed yet it peaked at more than 20 concurrent viewers during the finals. A Nouns sponsorship in relation to the events advertising would mean plugging Nouns on the Startgg page, any official posts about the event, and stream overlay assets. Considering the size of our state relative to our New England neighbors the drive to even the closest local for many players is upwards of 2+ hours, we believe a prize pot bonus would make a huge difference in numbers giving our players a much larger opportunity to make such an arduous trip without breaking the bank, as well as possibly enticing players from adjacent regions (New Hampshire, Vermont, Massachusetts, etc.) to come and compete in our beautiful state for possibly the first time. Maine is a beautiful state with an underrated Melee scene and the opportunity to show off our players, both high-level and low, would be so epic for us B)","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmZCyeJGzS36rc4EEom66H3yosWK6d99TQKs6H1woU6xZm","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

Now, we would like to go one step further. By winning the Nouns Funds Tournament #2 prize, we could offer several cashprize options for our team tournament. We have not yet decided how the cashprize will be distributed but we already have models. With the $1500 prize, we could reward players who win their matches, captains who lead their team to the victory, outstanding individual performances and, of course, the winning team. To sum up, we could reward both team and individual champions. On the competitive scene, no structure has managed to do this before us.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We could also paid the artists who works on illustrations, news articles’ covers, videos and logos of the several tournaments. Here, I would like to thanks Gbasire, Brumirage, bentleys and Stellar Flares for their intense work.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also, as mentioned before, the community is split in forums, which are declining, and our efforts to develop the community on social media have had encouraging but not satisfying results for now, as players are reluctant to leave their forums. That is why we think that a boost from Nouns could help us to make players from all over the world be interested in joining us and the online competitive scene on social media, and we would gladly put nouns as an official sponsor of the tournament if we are selected to promote the Nouns brand and socials.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Coup Critique staff would like to thank Nouns for this amazing opportunity, which will surely help develop small esport communities to grow !","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

my first organized LAN last year, the events in and surrounding The International 2023 were the Fade Bolt to the evergreen Cinder Brew, and the passion for community work in Dota 2 was ignited. I volunteered with the Crimson Witnesses to help run and set up the Side Shop Event at a separate venue. This gave fans the chance to connect with artists, Dota personalities, players, and organizations for FREE! We had hundreds of fans through the doors and had an amazing time. ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.reddit.com/r/DotA2/comments/17lmty2/the_side_shop_2023_rdota2_helped_make_this_a/"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"r/DotA2 - The Side Shop 2023, r/Dota2 helped make this a reality so thank you all so much!","src":"https://preview.redd.it/the-side-shop-2023-r-dota2-helped-make-this-a-reality-so-v0-qt4407f21txb1.jpg?width=640&crop=smart&auto=webp&s=3d8fc5dd5a858afae83e15aca90e4df5e554e979","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Following the side shop, my involvement with the Crimson Witnesses and the NADCL put me in a position to help set up, run, and do my first LAN cast at the partnered Turbo Mode at TI event. The environment was electric, attendees, talent, and volunteers had their needs met, appetites sated (ask me about the behind the scenes beans story), and thirst for Dota quenched. Our tricast of Sneeze, Benj!, and myself crowned the Speeed squad as the FIRST Turbo Mode at TI champions! We're still working on that Aegis...","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcSBDHGpgZYGvcsoTOyFxd3XaLOs2-o8sjpSm4B8NVYsZXKoBz7vE5mgyF0EMv-Cf3-QmWK_a3-_JaxZh0y0OU60EB8K46dwrHkGm3SR8b9aExPFh4jc9vZwuKtG_1IbjwKpEiMp2B5VHLo-JwknQqiizw?key=PhGwk17a24FKVeM9GGsE7A","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe_Hv5X9Pq_GdGhtC21FBE2r4H687uIrFVNEbeDEfjUEReFtgOH7Kmwyhn1CSXnHz4B_91rnLO-85Il3ULgoYqQ-ayOPcTksTgN4W1rRSi-8a6JL02LSCSbRJBkuYnL847li5kHg8ArgfK8oyxEc6dBbIo?key=PhGwk17a24FKVeM9GGsE7A","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Ever since, I've been growing my skillset, following, and aspirations. Below, you can find some links to recent solocasts that can give you a look into my personality, casting and Dota knowledge, and aura. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.twitch.tv/mal1bujesus/videos","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.twitch.tv/mal1bujesus/videos"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.youtube.com/@malibucasts/videos","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/@malibucasts/videos"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Reach out to me on discord (malibujesus - DM or nouns server) if you ever want to chat!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":8},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":8},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Matchamaking","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This year, TI is an abbreviated event for guests. Asking fans for a moment of their valuable time focused on Dota could be a struggle - creating something that is easily distributed widely desired is key to spreading information about the most efficient trading engine - Matcha.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It's simple - we create stickers (people love stickers and they're cheap!) with a QR code that goes to a linktree where Matcha socials, apps, and weblinks are listed with the same information for nouns is an easy ace in the hole. Event attendees see a sick pair of ⌐◨-◨  on a water bottle, scan the QR code, and BOOM! Easy access for all.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Reality and nouns ⌐◨-◨","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Travel is tough, especially when you're planning a wedding! The love of my life (the OTHER love of my life, sorry Dota) and I are focusing our funds into our celebration of, well, us. The sponsorship provided by nouns would make this trip a reality for me, and you can bet I'll get some snaps in a clean pair of ⌐◨-◨ at the ceremony.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":9,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why should you vote for me?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":9},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm not a one-trick pony. I've touched grass. I'm multilingual (e ai meu gente, vamo pra TI???), I'm a teacher (so I know how to herd cats - also Dota players), and a gym rat (so you'll be able to get some primo footage of Fly and I having a lift off). With nouns, I will give viewers at home a look into the experience of attending a dream tournament: pictures, interviews, laughs, and insight! At the end of the day, I aim to be somebody that can share a meal with anybody, even if it's too salty. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":8},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":8},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcnuXrEqzWKRoV7Ba8NdfrxMMMjhNQKMVqH8lqhEZ5Pzd3sAxjTGGezogo1JE2YK50aw5RxG8-nETzfmSAeG9O9u_rNemDdeZmn_5uiYJnhWwchFxaa6xcx69ike8GyG-A-Znkz7i82EqmyP1JaLpeORFFW?key=gNYEf4PjFBELuVuXv1ITPQ","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":8}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Let's Eat The Grass needs funding to connect UK Smash globally!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/634192592870965275/1269106848787595327/banner4.jpg?ex=66aedb5b&is=66ad89db&hm=0fa2544c6677a94d01ac5936c37565b1b680e127d8ea02d0dff879f11cd496e9&","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"What is Let's Eat The Grass?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Let's Eat The Grass was a project started to connect the UK Super Smash Brothers Melee community with the global scene. In order to achieve our goal we've partnered with North American major tournament series Don't Park On The Grass (DPOTG)! We'll be running a 128 cap Melee Singles bracket on August 31st where our two grand finalists will be rewarded with a free trip to DPOTG later this year in November. In order to raise funding for these prizes our current plan is to collect as much revenue as possible from ticket and merchandise sales but we need a third revenue stream to comfortably fund all our expenses. Its the hope of the team that we're considered to receive this support from Nouns to make our event come a reality!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Expected Reach","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As of writing this post Let's Eat The Grass promotional material has received over 15,000 views on X.com and we have sold over 1/3rd of our total tickets in one day for the event later this month. There are current plans to continue snowballing this engagement primarily via X with advertising campaigns pushing event tickets and our merchandise. In regards to broadcasting the event itself we are currently in the process of reaching out to the team behind the running of twitch channel BTSSmash. With over 500,000 twitch followers at the channels disposal its our hope that we'll be able to secure a deal and use those numbers to push what we'd like to the channels audience. If we fail to secure a broadcast on BTSSmash we have a backup option of Level1_TV (30.6k followers).","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/ssbmmax/status/1816831936989475022","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/ssbmmax/status/1816831936989475022"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmdGJ5Hzw9askgEKnvA53JwReF8PRi39xHC4bePKB5DNYU","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our first marketing idea was establishing a key link between UK and Global smash. We did so by paying homage to the DPOTG series with our name. Once we had our name we wanted to create an aesthetic to match it, I'm extremely proud of our work we've put into branding our event just right. We've created multiple designs using memorable characters from the Smash Brothers which will play key roles in our social media releases, broad cast branding and merchandise. Its our hope with repeated exposure to these designs our events identity will be carved out in a potential supporters mind. In addition to this our event page ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.start.gg/tournament/letg","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer noopener","target":"_blank","title":"https://www.start.gg/tournament/letg","url":"https://www.start.gg/tournament/letg"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" showcases all our designs in one neat package, we encourage you to take a look for yourself.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmNp7VPy2CiYv1kJmXUigY1Nwm6pQiE4R9W9kP1jL3fm7d","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Over the month long buildup from now to the event itself there are plans for various content pieces to try and encourage attendees to support the event and shirts we are selling. I'm confident our design is good enough to sell without any additional draws but if you needed one there is a direct link between flying UK Smash players out to American events by supporting us. On the day of show itself we expect a big bump in shirt sales from stream viewers getting exposed to us for the first time. In addition to this there would be space to allow other brands to shine as well, its our assumption that Nouns would want to take advantage of the stream time as well. By inviting 17 of the UK's Top 25 and multiple high level out of UK European players we've committed enough big names to draw in a sizeable stream audience. If we secure the funding from Nouns we'd like to potentially use the budget for more marketing ideas which could be discussed with the team.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Operational Experience","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmPo2DD5mQrH5HiU6X8qxW3mkF4ArvdaygZ7ZkhW4Y4izb","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In terms of experience working with brands I was recently fortunate enough to get to work directly with Nouns! Last May I won their prop house competition which allowed to me to partake in the life changing experience of attending GOML 2024. During my time with the team I had chances to get to know multiple members and from the time we had together I could tell they would be a right fit to aid the development of my event as well. Whilst I was competing for Nouns as a player previously I believe this gives me a unique insight on how to market and event and more so what a player might want when looking to come to one.In addition to me im working with multiple experienced community members who have worked previously on the biggest tournament series for our respective game in Europe. Using their experience and my unique insights its our hope that we can deliver an excellent event experience and meet the needs of a brand like Nouns in the process.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Brand Integration","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcNquH2urfjy1D9dis6KkWvX4NGXaqvCCbWqjkJxTESgw","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We would want to integrate the Nouns branding on our event signup page, social media campaigns and during the broadcast itself. On the day of show I think we will be broadcasting to thousands of unique viewers with consistent advertisement throughout the stream. Graphics would be created and shared to establish a clear partnership between our event and Nouns, a discussion could take place to further explore how Nouns would like to work with us in showcasing themselves to our audience.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Target Audience","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Its of my opinion that Nouns have made a clear investment into the Smash Melee scene over the last few years and for that reason I get the impression our event would be a perfect fit to work alongside your goals and ideals. Since Nouns have already made this investment I think my audience would be more receptive to the Nouns brand than the average consumer. Alongside this our plans to stream the event gives us a chance to reach a worldwide audience which Nouns will also be able to target. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Its my hope that we are considered, thank you for your time,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Max <3","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcnoFZxwPtyp3gxTafp5FA7Z6GYRALbu5A9mE89cU3grG","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: A call to action, a return to form.
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey, I'm ET. Yknow, this guy. ","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmYK3wyA25U5V8efAVFNTqBRDY9DyGMBo4J7UDPmPshFbY","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For the better part of four years I dedicated myself wholeheartedly into something we all love Dota 2. During which I had the honor of representing and working for BeyondTheSummit, an organization we all as NA fans deeply miss. Those were the best years of my life, working, studying, playing, the game I loved. While I grew as a commentator and player, Nouns was right there alongside me. The countless BO5's, the heart breaking results  in qualifiers, Nouns finally breaking through their barriers to reach the International level, every beat I've followed this team's path. For many people TI 12 was their first exposure to Nouns, most will never know the struggles this team faced. I can assure you, I do. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In addition to my NA Dota tenure, you pick up a thing or two being a caster for as long as I've been. Camera gear,audio gear, streaming, production setups, the swap to entirely remote work. All factors resulting in me becoming a savvy person in the realm of production. The thought of pumping out my own content under such strict time constraints independently, it'll be a challenge. Thankfully that's all I've ever known.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My time as a Dota Analyst also gives me what I deem as, \"The Dota Brain\". Something that you could say about my broadcasts for BeyondTheSummit was that I was always skeptical of the scenarios I'd see play out in the game to games. I would constantly strive to figure out the \"Why\" of every situation I'd come across, and this mentality pushed me to constantly think as if I were one of the players. Allowing me to peer slightly deeper than your average analyst, and this almost interrogative approach to analyzing games has given me a mind prepared to approach players. Broach their ideas, get to the root of what they're actually thinking. There has always been almost an heir of mysticism about how our Pros nowadays seem almost untouchable to the average player. I firmly believe that as an Interview/Reporter, it would be my job to bridge that gap. Make the pro's ideas digestible, even fun for the average player. My experience as an Analyst has given me the tools to fulfill this role as well.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Back to the stories. Many of my colleagues and friends can tell you that \"Free to Play\" has mattered immensely to me. The film making, the production, the way each players POV affects each other. It's close to a perfect story in my book. As an independent reporter, I want to highlight these stories more. The way I see TI each year, it's our Olympics. Each player,coach,organizer, support staff, media manager sacrifices so much each and every year for the shot at greatness I know we can do better. Not every team gets a True Sight, even less get their stories heard before it's time to fly back home. If I am allowed the honor of representing Nouns as a reporter, I vow to not let these stories be forgotten. To give the lime light to the hidden heroes of the Dota community, as well as the families who give so much for their brothers, sisters, sons, daughters. It's easily one of the most compelling aspects of any sport and I'd make sure it happens.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In short, I'm ET. I'm young, capable, experienced, enthusiastic, and filled with respect and admiration for the people in our game. And that is why I think you should let me represent us come TI this year. Thank you.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Socials:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.twitch.tv/etpog","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.twitch.tv/etpog"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://twitter.com/etdota","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://twitter.com/etdota"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Discord : et._","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

This tournament re-exposes them to Nouns and showcases Nouns as more than just a Dota team.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community Appreciation","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":": Given the lack of support and content for DAC, the community will likely be highly appreciative of Nouns' involvement and support, which can enhance brand loyalty and visibility.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Conclusion","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" This tournament not only brings value to DAC players but also offers Nouns a unique branding opportunity. DAC, despite being niche, provides an incredible gaming experience deserving of more support and content creation. This partnership can help both DAC and Nouns grow, fostering a positive and supportive gaming community. I hope you see the potential in this collaboration. Please reach out with any questions.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you, Oliver","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello, my name is Landon Frank, aka ScrubbedOut. I'm a 19 year old esports event organizer in Fort Wayne, Indiana under Odyssey Esports. Over the last two years, I have been hosting events to revitalize the Indiana Smash ecosystem and make my city into a hub for large scale events in the Midwest. ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":9,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are trying to make Afterburner 2025 a major and need your help!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Fort Wayne has went from a city with dying locals in 2022 to 7 total 100 entrant events or higher between April 2023 - June 2024. Our flagstaff event, ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Afterburner 2024","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", was a cut above the rest of our events in March with over ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"350 attendees ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"and many other crazy things to make the event stand out from anything else. The venue was also a cut above the rest with planes hanging throughout the venue and ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"even an antique car on stage that we were able to interview the winner in","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" - ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://youtu.be/RjPNjd-8zog?si=HFD62dAcUaC9CrEb"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are now on the horizon for the next Afterburner in 2025, already announced with registration live and we are looking to make the event much bigger and better than before! This already includes $2500 in pot bonuses for all events (previously $1000 for Afterburner 2024) including a $1000 pot bonus for Smash Ultimate and Melee Singles brackets! Alongside this, we plan to fundraise and fly out many top players in both Smash Ultimate and Melee to make the event as big as possible and hopefully reach major status!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The previous Afterburner event had our largest viewership for an event yet with 13240 unique views on our main stream alone with a peak concurrent of 654 viewers and average of 205 viewers just on the main Smash Ultimate stream alone. That's without our Hbox restream and any other streams going on too. But that was just for a large regional alongside another competing event in Cirque 3 streaming the same weekend as us with many more recognizable names. For Afterburner 2025, we are expecting viewership numbers much higher due to a bigger event and bigger names at the event which brings more opportunity for Nouns to advertise at the event.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Speaking of Nouns ⌐◨-◨, our last event in June was actually sponsored by them! We are excited to hopefully work with them again on this event and feature more of their stacked Melee roster at the event. The Works was a smaller 200 player regional for Ultimate and Melee, streamed on Cody Schwab's channel with 200-400 concurrent viewers through out the day. We were able to promote the initial funding rounds to different organizers and I even told the 3rd place finisher about the rounds for him to apply!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are excited for this upcoming Afterburner to hopefully continue working with Nouns as they were a great help in making The Works 2024 happen. We plan to stream the Melee side of the event on Cody and Nouns's channels alongside run ad slides, promo videos, and more sponsor deliverables with the event to help Nouns promote in the FGC scene! Thank you for the noggles Peter!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmV99BaURoCwddvpZjUGcvoAfmQ3fo3GwfyGhPcTKdFT2B","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmTNhBEZaM8QTk6CBrK9aXZ49LKHB7he25mviZSAmsio2e","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are excited to continue helping connect Nouns with our grassroots Ultimate and Melee scene and hope for their continued support! Please consider voting for our campaign to help make this event as big as possible and continue building something special for the Indiana and Midwest FGC scene! 🛩🔥","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"See you at Afterburner! title: JSalt's Trip to Riptide!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmbhWYNnddXwnC5u7QTLodqFeDgEMZeuTvqbKMrYZF2Nvm","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello! My name is Justin, and I go by the tag JSalt. You may have heard of me from being one of the renowned \"JSheiks,\" or from my notoriety for entering (and mostly winning) just about every netplay tournament series you've ever heard of. I started out in competitive Smash with Brawl in 2009, ran Smash and FGC tourneys from 2010-2020, and started to actively compete in Melee in 2014. I debuted on the Louisiana's Melee Power Rankings that same year, maintained a top 4 spot since late 2016, and have held the #2 spot since 2021.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In my Supernova proposal, I listed many of my notable wins/accomplishments over the past couple of years, but most of those were online tournaments, so I didn't have much to show for it offline. Last year, I attempted to get ranked top 100, so I made sure to attend enough tournaments outside of my region. However, I didn't quite punch up and get any notable wins, just decent placings and consistently didn't get upset. If you want to take a look at those stats, click here: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.pgstats.com/melee/player/JSalt?id=S7277","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.pgstats.com/melee/player/JSalt?id=S7277"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":". Since that proposal, I went to Warehouse War 4 in July, and went on a successful run to 9th place out of about 250 entrants, collecting 3-0 wins on KJH (ranked 40th on this Summer's SSBMRank) and Wally (ranked 32nd). Finally, I have the in-person wins to show that I belong amongst these ranked players, which has lit my competitive fire to go all-out in attending the few remaining big tournaments this year. In doing so, I hope to acquire even more of those big wins and receive a top-100 ranking for 2024, and I can't do that without your (and Nouns) help!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I also failed to mention in my previous proposal that I was sponsored in 2019 by Crescent Esports, a local team based out of Louisiana that had representatives of many different fighting games and popular esports, so I have experience in representing an organization: interacting with other members on the team, supporting their communities along with my own, and participating in the growth and support through in-person events and on social medias. So I'm not just here to propose to be given $1500, a congratulations, and a trip to Sandusky, OH. I'm here to try to create an impact beyond this one event: to represent and grow my local community, the Melee scene at large, and to further my potential on what I can accomplish through these experiences, whether that be with a Nouns jersey for Riptide (and beyond?), or with any other org/group/person that's willing to give me the opportunity.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"You can find me on Twitter/X: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://twitter.com/JSalt_","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://twitter.com/JSalt_"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Twitch: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.twitch.tv/jsalt","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.twitch.tv/jsalt"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: SNSGirly’s Plea
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Aria. I am a trans woman and I play a multitude of Smash games. While I’m not too good, I am dedicated. I play Doctor Mario in Melee, King Dedede in P+, Luigi in 64, and Wii Fit Trainer in Ultimate. My record is atrocious unfortunately with it being 1-183 in Ultimate, but I put my all into every set I play. I will go 0-2, but I have fun doing it. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The reason I am pitching to go to Riptide with Nouns is for a multitude of reasons. I have had many tournament dreams dashed because of a lack of funding and most of my friends bailing on me. I haven't been outside the state of Texas in about three years, and I would like to go to a tournament out of state once in my life. That is a dream of mine. I’m probably not as good as everyone else signing up, but I have heart. I am DFW’s most prolific 0-2er and I will keep fighting if I get knocked down. I am resilient and I will keep supporting my friends if I get knocked out.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am looking to Nouns to sponsor me for both Melee and Ultimate. It comes with determination and hard work and a LOT OF LOSS.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While my record is extremely shoddy, I am extremely dedicated to what I do, and I will represent the brand better than any person can. content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, I'm WARDOGZ, a melee spacies/falcon/marth player from PA mostly known for my combo videos. I love this game, and competing at majors has always been a dream I've had since I began this journey when I was 14, and it would mean the world if anyone reading this would consider dropping a vote my way. title: COPA BAGUAL!!!!
content:
{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Olá, tudo bem? Prazer meu nome é Jonathan mais conhecido como Jon, sou dono e fundador da COPA BAGUAL aonde já tivemos várias equipes inclusivas participando e um campeonato inclusivo já estava em nossos planos.

As equipes inclusivas que já participaram do nosso campeonato: Grow Inclusiva, Unity Inclusiva, Saideira FEM, Blue Rabbits FEM, VLA Fox Inclusiva e entre outros.

O que a gente pensou para essa parceria? 

Pensamos em realizar um campeonato com fase de formato suíço com 16 times cada grupo, dependendo do total de equipes participando que seria a fase aonde as equipes irão somar pontos e seguir em busca da classificação. Com a classificação de 8 times por grupo iríamos para os playoffs até chegar na grande final que poderíamos tentar trazer um nome forte do inclusivo para participar da live e também dar mais visibilidade.

Pensamos em colocar uma taxa de inscrição de R$20, para aumentar também a premiação somando metade do valor que será para premiação e mais a inscrição das equipes.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmds7nfizgpfjZZ3AoBeXneJRFSnpGX14mREumsfuKVz36","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmc9Z3BoQ2urHT9sESoMFMQe6ddNX6oDFtdyXHTdq3cFH3","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmds7nfizgpfjZZ3AoBeXneJRFSnpGX14mREumsfuKVz36","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Dad Luigi (G L O V E), never been to a major
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Yo! My name is Gage, I've been playing smash my whole life, melee being the main one. I've always wanted to go to a major even if I lose I'm happy because I feel like I can learn a lot more about the game and how I should play better by going to a major. I also don't have a lot of money for it as I'm a dad and I would love to be able to tell my daughter that I met some of the greats when I start teaching her melee when she's a little older. I want to inspire people to watch/play the game, I feel like my personality can help bring more eyes because I can be eccentric or laid back. I come from a really small scene in Canada (usually around 8 people) I don't rank high but I want to try to represent New Brunswick somehow as it's usually one of the forgotten parts of Canada. I'd also just like to go and talk about anything melee I would love to talk to the custom vendors to learn from them so I can fix and mod controllers, I wanna talk to people in the community, and I want to learn what I can do against a larger group of people.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Proposta - Patorneio & Quackers
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Bom, não sei se ja ouviram falar do Patorneio ou Quackers, mas vou fazer uma breve apresentação de ambos, para começar os dois são parte de uma comunidade chamada de Pataquada, para pessoas que gostam de patos e afins, girando em torno desse tema, surge o Patorneio que desde 2022 Vem fazendo torneios com apoio oficial da Riot Games, assim como outras marcas que já confiaram em nós. Já a Quackers veio do mesmo grupo e tem seu foco na produção de conteúdo e gameplay, como um atrativo bacana para a produção de eventos a Quackers tem uma gama interessante de criadores de conteúdos, narradores e comentarias assim como produção de audiovisual para transmissões.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Histórico de torneios:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Nesses 2 anos de Patorneios, já produzimos mais de 300 torneios para a Comunidade da Riot.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Criamos o primeiro torneio rotativo semanal para o cenário inclusivo com premiação fornecida pela Riot","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Organizamos torneios bi-semanais para a HeroBase trabalhar o desenvolvimento competitivo da sua comunidade","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Organizamos torneios semanais para a ExitLag com ênfase no inclusivo, o CampDelas.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Já organizamos dezenas de torneios pagos com transmissão, narração e focados em times inclusivos.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Proposta para esse torneio:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Como um evento único inclusivo, podemos fazer um evento invitational e aberto, dividido em 3 etapas.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Etapa 1 (aberto/qualificatória): para o público aberto podemos realizar uma qualificatória com 8 vagas, sendo disputada em 2 torneios MD1 de execução rápida (com prêmios em VP, que a Riot pode apoiar), durante essa Etapa teremos WatchParty com nossos criadores ou criadores externos, os 4 principais times passariam para a etapa fechada.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Etapa 2 (Fase de grupos): com 8 times convidados, sendo a preferencia de equipes mais influentes no cenário, assim como 8 equipes que conseguiram garantir sua classificação, realizaremos um sorteio de 4 grupos de 4 times, com uma agenda pré-definida para execução das partidas, assim como disponibilização de Transmissão nossa e externa, para streamers e criadores. Cada fase terá 2 times vencedores, sendo 8 times que avançarão para a rodada eliminatória","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Rodada Final(eliminatória): Com cada time em sua respectiva chave (baseado no desempenho da fase de grupos), todo dia haverá 2 partidas MD3, com transmissão e narração profissional da nossa equipe. A rodada final, pode ou não pode ter chave dos perdedores, todo o percurso será MD3, até a Final que será MD5","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"O time vencedor será ovacionado com glorias e a premiação","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Agora falando sobre a parte financeira, não queremos retorno financeiro, usaremos tudo para execução do evento, já temos equipe capacitada para a maior parte de produção de conteúdo e execução do torneio","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"como: Narrador, Comentarista, Câmeras, Produção visual e técnica, assim como equipe capacitada para moderação.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Ainda oferecemos a possibilidade de adicional nas premiações, como somos parceiros da Riot podemos oferecer premiação em VP para as equipes que se classificarem para o evento, assim como um adicional na premiação, pois temos o patrocínio da ExitLag e mais outros brindes para os vencedores.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmeNVBKTyg9H2Rf8wFwMzwAUi178kT4as7JR7oMWVnxzBY","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: PROPOSTA PARA STREAMER/WP/CASTER com uma ideia de planejamento para o BUDGET
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Fala galera, sou um streamer que está na correria por mais reconhecimento, e acho que participar desse evento seria uma grande oportunidade pra isso. Além de jogar e curtir Valorant, eu apoio com tudo as causas que buscam tornar o jogo mais inclusivo. Não importa sua etnia ou sexualidade, todo mundo merece ter seu espaço e reconhecimento nesse cenário. Caso eu seja aprovado como um dos streamers do evento, já tenho confirmado a participação de um caster/comentarista_ (@dayzvlr) que entrará junto comigo no projeto. Além disso, a streamer soy taki (@soy takii), que faz parte da organização Nouns, também vai me ajudar diretamente nas transmissões e nas watch parties. Ah, e meu Twitter é @dntsvlr, caso queiram me seguir por lá. Sobre o orçamento de $500, acho que o melhor seria destinar $350 pra premiação, o que deixaria o torneio ainda mais competitivo e atraente. Com os outros $150, dá pra cobrir os custos internos, como aluguel de servidores, infraestrutura de streaming, e também algum marketing pra divulgar o evento e atrair mais gente. Por isso, acredito que posso ser uma ótima escolha como um dos streamers do evento, trazendo não só uma boa transmissão, mas também ajudando a reforçar os valores de inclusão e diversidade que o evento representa","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Lucius the fantastic fursuiter for Rivals 2
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I know this is a smash roster submission. But imagine me on stream in fursuit at Riptide in a nouns jersey repping the team for Rivals 2! The game is hot right now and I am currently the best Ranno player in the world. With single digit placements 7th at Genesis, 7th at GOML, 2nd at CB, 2nd at DTN and 9th at SuperNova I am looking to grind and take Rivals 2 by storm. I have heard top players say that they always look at the opponent’s character in a 1v1 match. It is like when you are first starting soccer and you keep looking down at the ball, but you are told to look up. You need to think about what would your teammate want to do, be in an area where you could help continue their combo or help finish the combo with a strong move. Once you have a lot of experience, you can use telepathy with your teammate. Even if it is your first game with them and you both searched EC to play with some random doubles players. title: My Cool Dr. Mario Combo
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My tag is Bubbles and I am a New Jersey Dr. Mario player! I am known for my tech skill and fast movement with Dr. Mario. I am submitting this combo as I believe it is one of the most creative and difficult Doc combos I've done! Particularly, I think I did a great job using movement to bait out sub-optimal defensive options from my opponent and constantly put him in bad situations. I also did a great job using all of Dr. Mario's tools, which are not particularly combo friendly. After getting the Falco off-stage, he recovers back and I respond by doing an invincible ledge dash up smash, into an Up-B cancel! He gets to top platform and lands by the edge of the platform, which ends up ledge-canceling his recovery frames on wakeup. He uses this to fullhop Dair as I approach, but I double jump waveland back to fall off the platform to bait this, and I double jump dair which shield pokes him, get the late uptilt hitbox to send him up, and end it with a fair. I think it looks great and is also a very difficult combo to perform with Dr. Mario! I hope you agree after you see it!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Skill Requirement:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" I would personally give it an 9/10. Doctor Mario's punish game is very solid, but it's very straight forward and simple, and is generally considered to be a much more neutral based character. Most of his moves either send the opponent too far away for a follow up or have very low hitstun and don't send the opponent in a tumble state, meaning that all of his combos need to be done often with the fastest possible movement and fast follow-ups. He is not very fast and lacks range, meaning that the use of moves like his late hit nair like the one in the combo, need a read on the knockdown + wakeup option. Getting the drill to shield poke, and then hitting the late hit uptilt (Doc's uptilt initially sends away, unlike Mario's) is a very rare and difficult thing to setup, requiring both precise timing and spacing for it to work!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Creativity:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" 9/10. Doctor Mario is a relatively uncommon character, and even then, the use of his up-b cancel, dair as a shield poke, and landing his late hit uptilt for the fair finisher are uncommon and creative! I think for the combo to work, having to read every option my opponent went for defensively was also a unique and difficult aspect!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Damage:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" The Falco went from 27% all the way to 115, so a total of 88%!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Style:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" I think my combo was quite stylish and fast! the last hits of dair shieldpoking into uptilt pop-up in particular look extremely satisfying!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":4}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://imgur.com/a/NhkEht8","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmPpi6TN5UbhLoVgaNKEroHECLeBYgnkozCz5ptaKdpJ6N","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmPpi6TN5UbhLoVgaNKEroHECLeBYgnkozCz5ptaKdpJ6N","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I don't use social media much, but you can reach out to me on my Insta or Discord! title: Cute Jump Steal With Disable
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://twitter.com/VVonders292/status/1826316517622923301","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://twitter.com/VVonders292/status/1826316517622923301"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" - interesting use of disable where it forces em into tumble if it doesn't hit them while in tumble or in a grounded state, so the falco got like 1 or 2f of dj out before the first hit which forced him to pretty much have no control over the rest. Learning that TP angle to top plat took a long time but honestly the skill factor in that is a lot less cool now that most people run with notches or boxx (i'm still on a un-notched controller for what it's worth). It's definitely not the most technical combo I've ever hit but I think it makes up for it with how it flows much better than a lot of other stuff, plus I kinda just delete most of my clips as soon as I use them in a combo vid, so my choice was between this and only like 4 others. Using disable to force tumble rather than as a finisher or something to stun them on ground is pretty rare for m2 combo's so I'd like to think it's decently creative, along with using upsmash after knowing that i took his jump and that it beats dair. I don't use twitter other than to just shoot out a message when I finish combo vids, been in a rut of not hitting the most original stuff recently though, so hopefully this one is decent enough.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Nice marth combo ending with a flashy confirm
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Combo found here: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://streamable.com/upl02w","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://streamable.com/upl02w"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My twitter is at ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/_gaming_moment","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/_gaming_moment"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey, my tag is Chibe! I am a high level player in the Australian melee scene. This combo was from a friendlies session played against Yoshzzz, another high level player in the region.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I would say that most of the style and creativity comes from the end of the combo. Landing on the side platform with an up air to techchase the top platform serves as an effective situational DI callout, reading the opponent's DI to the right side of the stage with my landing position to open up the maximum number of combo routes I can continue with. From here, I choose to kill by landing weak reverse down air, edgecancelling it with drift towards Fox and converting with strong down air to kill. This is a flashy combo route with fluid movement and fast execution, as well as being a creative route that I don't see a huge amount of people go for. It also has practical merit, being an effective callout on DI in while likely still sending far enough offstage had the opponent DI'ed away to convert into an edgeguard.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The difficulty of this combo is mostly from playing around slideoff, maintaining clean execution for the duration of the combo and reacting fast to the opponents DI. Any of these 3 things being unclean would have allowed the opponent to escape and return to neutral. Landing the strong down air at the end also requires quite a fast down air to prevent the fox from falling too far to be hit with the down air.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As for damage, this combo deals 113% and kills. Not too bad!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for having a watch of my clip, and to Nouns for putting up this contest! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://twitter.com/BadPlay_Melee/status/1826607709518696459","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://twitter.com/BadPlay_Melee/status/1826607709518696459"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This isn't the most flashiest or technical, but a 9-month 0-2 bracket noob like me feels good for hitting stuff like this. % goes high and I do two reads.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This isn't the best offering a Dorf can give, but it is something for me, so I will enter.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Skill Requirement:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Requires two reads(Downsmash DI(tho someone could react, not my old brain) and get up option) and timing of upsmash after hopping on top platform.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Stomps to upsmash isn't the most technical combo, but hopping to top-plat to charge minimal upsmash for Ganon's toes to barely hit is timing based. To me it feels like some skill is required.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Creativity:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Sane person would go for something else than getup attack read, but I'm not sane.I felt like dair, and I go for dair. I'm very simple-minded person in the end, and do what I need to finish the KO.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Damage:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A lot. 96% to be exact. 17% to 113% and KO. Pummel+dthrow = 10%. Dsmash 21%. Both dairs 42%. And Upsmash 23%. I think this is the strongest attribute of this clip.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Style:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While not being that stylish or technical, when that upsmash strong hit connects for spacie KO, it feels ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"GOOD. ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I know I can charge just for a millisecond for the upsmash, so I do to time it proper.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Playing Ganon is fun.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}
