title: Ice Climbers Alley-Oop into Double Dunk
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/shieldgrabber/status/1778927296071516487?t=3I1r-707zftgIPJX0Uniaw&s=19","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/shieldgrabber/status/1778927296071516487?t=3I1r-707zftgIPJX0Uniaw&s=19"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I usually prefer my combos speak for themselves but I'll try to explain why this is a combo that's extremely satisfying anyone from a veteran Ice Climbers player to a casual spectator.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This combo showcases multiple of my favorite Ice Climbers combo tools at an breakneck pace, with fast and creative decision-making to finish the game with a 0 to death. I forgo the standard, guaranteed handoff kill in favor of a flashy and unique combo route. One of Melee's most beautiful aspects is the free-flowing punish game, which requires players to constantly innovate in response to changes in their opponent's DI and positioning. Ice Climbers double the variables in this equation as the player has to anticipate and respond to both the opponent and Nana's AI decisions. Most Ice Climbers wil try to keep their movement and combos simple and guaranteed to minimize the uncertainty, but I react to both Nana and the opponent to construct a one-of-a-kind sequence from  unsteady, ever-shifting building blocks. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Key moments in this combo:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Dashdance blizzard desync ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Popo is CONSTANTLY moving during each step of the combo, immediately dashing out of his lag to cover any response from Fox or Nana. Maintaining this speed while simultaneously inputting moves for Nana requires A LOT of precision ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- I correctly react to RNG handoff situation where I need to react to Nana's randomly fthrow, putting myself in position for a guaranteed handoff kill combo that we've all seen a million times","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Instead, I throw Fox and have Nana hit him with the Ice Pop, a tightly spaced neutral-b that hits Fox with the hammer hitbox while avoiding the Ice Block hitbox which would free him and end the combo. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Instead of using any of the standard regrab mixups after the techchase, I have Nana dash forward-> Backair Fox out of Popo's downthrow, perfectly setting up Popo for an offstage forward air. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Popo successfully dunks Fox out of Nana's alley-oop, but the Fox player is quick on their feet and meteor cancels and begins to recover- but Fox can't escape!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Popo lands onstage with the forward air, which would have allowed him to follow up on a variety of DIs and defensive options from Fox. I IMMEDIATELY react to the meteor cancel by using ledge invincibility to dodge Fox's recovery hitbox and smash him into the blast zone to win the game.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- This second forward air is especially hard to defend against because Fox's up-b likely locked him out of being able to meteor cancel the forward air like he did on the first hit","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Nicest combo i hit Yesterday
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This is the nicest combo i hit yesterday on Ranked and i'm not gonna search for more because this is actually a really cool combo. DK main from spain and top 4 player in the country:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Skill Requirement: The combo has 2 bairs in no time + a misstech roll read with down b, that should be pretty decent even DK combos aren't usually the most Skill combos out there. 7/10","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Creativity: Really creative, there with the punch i could up air string into punch and i actually just did 2 up airs 9/10","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/iuguns1998/status/1826636435233144943","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/iuguns1998/status/1826636435233144943"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Damage: 0 to 113 death","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Style: Pretty stylish for a dk combo, not up air chain and a down b use 7/10","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In general i liked this combo a lot because is not the typical up air string into punch or into edgeguar and i loved how i actually read his misstech roll and react to his techroll afterwords. Pretty decent ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: This is what labbing punish looks like
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" The combo - ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zc4bDpTB5J8","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zc4bDpTB5J8"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I read he's going to shine my shield (because obviously) and I realise if I do an up-smash or grab it'll be too slow and I'll get hit by the shine, and f-tilt would likely clank, so I choose shorthop D-air > I read tech in place so I do an up-tilt and time it so that the second hitbox hits > f-tilt > read another tech in place with dashattack,  I use that here because the side plat is a perfect set up to get the only good hitbox of dashattack > run off falling up-air to catch him > weak hit up-air > I know he's going to do another tech in place, and I also know that the front of his shine hitbox is too small and if I position myself correctly then even if I miss it, his wake up shine won't hit me, jab > f-tilt > fair.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Damage 75%: 29% - 104%","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Skill 8 / 10: A chunk of the difficulty in sheiks punish is the knowledge checks. The biggest ones here being timing the up-tilt to have only the second hit hit to cover tech in place, and changing where I land due to his falco's shine being extremely small in front of him. The jab > f-tilt is a tight window for me to get out the f-tilt before he actionable or grounded.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Creativity 9 / 10: The falling up-air, weak hit up-air, were both less used juggling options. I came up with dair right as I realised that I didn't have any other options to hit him, surprised myself with that one. I could've grabbed him after the first knockdown, but I wasn't sure how I going to continue hitting him at all if he just DI'd behind, ambiguous DI would've sucked to deal with on the edge on a platform as well, so I went for the up-tilt timing. When I landed the on right plat, I could've just done a shorthop instant nair and it would've been fine but I would still have to deal with the edgeuard. So instead I went for the extra damage with the jab > f-tilt > fair to make sure he would just die.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Style 7/10: Weak hit up-airs are usually considered one of the most stylish thing sheiks can do in their punish, so weak hit up-air felt nice. Easily could've gone with a simple nair or fair for the final hit after landing, but I think jabs in combos are always sick. The fact that the combo was extended across all 3 platforms was also really fun.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I don't have any social media, other than Discord I guess. So, uh, here's the song I listening to when I did this ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://youtu.be/NMg0e0rAvO0?si=qt9aSmxCBP6y6g6X","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://youtu.be/NMg0e0rAvO0?si=qt9aSmxCBP6y6g6X"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://open.spotify.com/track/0zcLWWb5OLTd56sYR7bmY8?si=b93a49d17e474e9d","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://open.spotify.com/track/0zcLWWb5OLTd56sYR7bmY8?si=b93a49d17e474e9d"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Insanely Long Falcon Ditto Combo
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/raptorboost/status/1826762032609403030","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/raptorboost/status/1826762032609403030"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Skill Requirement: This one is pretty hard because of some subtle tech skill, like the smash turn back air and the intentional weak hits of nair and knee. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Creativity: Some of the options in this combo are really interesting and require a lot of knowledge to even go for. The initial knee jab to smash turn bair I especially like, followed by the run cancel double jab into a stomp jab reset. It's hard to see where the combo is going, which is always exciting!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Damage: This combo went from 7% to 162%, being one of my longest ones ever!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Style: There are a lot of stylish moments in this combo, but some of my favorites are the reads in the beginning. The jump read with stomp into jab reset is beautiful, then using the extra hitstun time to dash dance just adds more swag. Ending with a perfect mid-air stomp knee, I think it is super satisfying to watch!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Ultra Instinct Ganondorf
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/sashassbm/status/1826470557409493200?s=46","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/sashassbm/status/1826470557409493200?s=46"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, SashaEstradiol, your favorite Ganon player's favorite Ganon player here. This was a combo I got on a really great player. I was down a couple games and I really needed a win, so I decided the next game I had to go off and prove that I'm not just some unranked scrub who uses Ganondorf.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I think this combo is really difficult to pull off because of how weird Ganon's side-b gets, How I was gonna recover after the up-air, and the fact that throughout this combo i couldn't take damage at all, hence the \"Ultra Instinct\" Title.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My combo here seemed pretty unique unlike all of the other Ganons here because mine is a lot more smooth and well thought out instead of just ripping out a down-b, especially since i wasn't in range to get one without missing horribly. I also find it unique because of my usage of side-b here. It went under the bomb, and it felt like I was using falcon in that moment.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This Combo racks up A LOT of damage, considering Ganondorf is one of the hardest hitting characters in all of melee. from 0% it can get you to 80%, and if you want to continue it will just take the opponent all the way to their death. Really great for damage and looks really stylish in the process","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This combo might not be the most stylish, but I believe it is the most smoothest and the best for damage. However, there are pretty cool moments like me side-b'ing under the bomb, jumping over Link's down-smash, and the cool waveland into f-air to get the Link offstage and secure the kill. Again, very smooth, very optimal, and very good for damage. Might be visual appealing to some though.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Really 'Bout that Doraki Lifestyle
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/GooseKizzle/status/1826867114348527741","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/GooseKizzle/status/1826867114348527741"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"When we enter tournies, we don't just aim to win, we aim to style. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A core memory of mine is Scar saying on commentary \"Even in tournament, even when there's thousands of dollars on the line, we love swaggin'\". That's a mantra to live by, think of your favourite melee moments on stream, jmook's insane di shmixups vs moky at genesis? Moky's nuts offstage up air vs Chango at big house? Or maybe s2j's offstage stomp vs westballz at Evo 2016? The most live moments don't always have to be in a large stadium or crowd, but goddamn if it doesn't amplify the energy in the combo by a ton; it truly is a thrill to behold, and it's why many of us play or watch melee. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It's a hard thing to quantify or even judge skill, but making it far in bracket is a pretty good barometer, and in winners semi's of Ontario's biggest monthly at the time - Durham Dojo - vs my homie Erik, there will be no shortage of booty-clenching moments in our sets. The difficulty in here comes not from just the precision of my spacing to intentionally get a soft reverse knee, or the wherewithal to go for a low up air tech trap off a raptor boost, or even executing a dash attack doraki wall jump (which you input by holding into the stage and pressing away as your dash attack animation ends and you hug the wall... use this tech more falcon mains!!!) into soft knee stomp. The real highlight is doing it all with the pressure of a tournament match against a really good player, especially a fierce rival you've been with playing for years, traded sets with, improved along side with.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Most falcons when trying to go for DI mixups will opt for hard hitting moves that reverse but I really think the beauty of the character comes from the fact that even the most unassuming moves can still make magic happen. Everyone comes to expect the classic stomp knee, and some more keen viewers will be ready for a reverse back-air or up air knee. But I guarantee you, no one is actively thinking about the prospect a reverse soft knee dash-attack doraki. That kind of mixup is what turns a lil' 43% stomp knee combo into an 80%, certified kodak moment that gets the commentators out of their seats and the spectators popping off (and my favourite, getting the opponent to smile). Even if it takes one of my stocks to close out a hype kill and send a message, I stay swaggin'.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"#STAYSWAGGIN","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also I ended up winning this tournament :3 ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Around the world on the legendary sheik main Amsah
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/Nuckels/status/1822373495608946922","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/Nuckels/status/1822373495608946922"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Link to the combo ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"First and foremost this combo was Marth on Sheik vs the legendary green sheik Amsah. To land something like this one needs to DI mixup for days and condition for months if not years. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The combo shows us taking Sheik around the world of Dreamland while subjecting him to a whopping 127% of damage before sending him down to the depths of hell. We have all seen the combos of edgecancels but this combo brings you back to a simpler time, before edgecancels and pivots, where abusing hitbox's and mixing up people's DI was all that Marth had. To accomodate this feeling of nostalgia we have included a classic euro hardstyle track that we all know and love from combo video's from way back.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The combo starts after Amsah was conditioned to doublejump, once this occurs I knew anything was possible. My man assumed I would tipper on the left, but no we aren't doing that cause edgeguarding is boring, we need to dunk.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Because that's why we all picked Marth no? To dunk on people.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As for the rest? I'll let the video tell the rest of the story, spoilers suck no? Enjoy judges.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Lots of love, Nuckels","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Around the world
content: {"children":[{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/JaysonMoistRice/status/1827018052086669339","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/JaysonMoistRice/status/1827018052086669339"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Alternatively titles \"7 Aerials in 7 Seconds\", this combo uses all three platforms, two ledge cancels and one strong knee to kill Puff early on Dreamland. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It is skillful because having the awareness to combo back and forth across the stage will be a stronger combo than doing a bunch of up airs into knee at mid percent, and won't guarantee a kill on Dreamland.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This combo is creative by using every aerial but Stomp, each used in multiple ways with weak hits, reverse hits and ledge cancels.You never knew when the strong knee was coming!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It only does 74%, but in Jigglypuff percent that's like two hundred at least.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This combo is very stylish like a swan performing ballet through the sky, with Whispy Woods and Bronto Burt being his only audience, Captain Falcon delivers the perfect show of strength to defeat his foe. And it was a four stock but don't worry about that part.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The combo: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/cliche4000/status/1827174559872905519","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/cliche4000/status/1827174559872905519"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Skill Requirement:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" There's a lot of fast and precise components to this combo. title: Roy is way cooler than you think
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This clip highlights a lot of Roy's strengths that are underappreciated by most. My background in Street Fighter 4 comes out here when poking with Roy's safe on shield options that can all lead to an opening. I try to avoid opening my combos with grabs because it's just too easy. The perfect usage of weak hits and strong hits allows Roy to get long combos with several hits and if done right you can link any hits into a kill. The initial up air to start the combo was to shield poke or catch the shield drop so either way it's an opening. I need to fast fall the next two up airs or else I wont be fast enough to continue the combo. The reverse jab is to throw off my opponent and begin a tech chase situation. Weak hit dair is strong enough to get falco back onto the platform and at this point I know exactly where my opponent wants to go. Chasing him down as quickly as I can let's me set up for my signature finisher that took me a really long time to get good at. First hit of nair pops people up perfectly for the 6F down smash that I have to turn around for and hit as quickly as possible. Idk what it is but there is something about Roy's first hit of nair into down smash that gives me so much dopamine. I've always played this character since the game first came out and i'll play him until my hands don't let me. title: fun marth combo!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/aquamelen/status/1827834879327027333","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/aquamelen/status/1827834879327027333"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Hi everyone! I personally really like this clip as it incorporates old and new tech with Marth in a simple but efficient way. While it isn't the most technical combo out there, tech trapping Moky isn't the easiest thing to do and I managed to set up a unique mix up with a forward tilt on the missed tech afterwards. This spot is a little unusual and I catch Moky's side-b with an up air and string it to a soft up air into a rising nair (the nair here definitely gave me pewpewu vibes, one of my fav players). I have many options after this, but I choose to teeter cancel fair which would  guarantee a Ken combo, but instead I chose to get a max range regrab to incorporate a newly popularized forward throw mix up into tipper downsmash for the kill! This entire combo started at 27 percent and ended at 122 percent; its a massive 95 percent combo and I think its a really clean combo :3 Hope you enjoyed it!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Afterburner 2025 - An Indiana Major
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Odyssey Esports presents Afterburner 2025, an Indiana FGC major in Northeast Indiana!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Afterburner will feature a large, spacious 30,000 sq. ft of venue space, alongside antique planes and cars all around the venue! We hope to bring together everything Indiana and the Midwest has to offer for Smash Ultimate & Melee! We are currently anticipating 600-800 in-person competitors and attendees total for the event and are in talks with many top-ranked players to get them to the event. This Nouns grant would be of great help towards making this happen!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmci13Z9TZVZnyp1yCcPa2Tycujre5jRvpxRF2xawr2zhy","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUvDuvzoGbVnhnze8nUGvAmjUNEriRgtjmm8A9XASwnb8","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The previous Afterburner event had our largest viewership for an event yet with 13240 unique views on our mainstream alone with a peak concurrent of 654 viewers and an average of 205 viewers just on the main Smash Ultimate stream alone. That's without our Hbox restream and any other streams going on too. But that was just for a large regional alongside another competing event in Cirque 3 streaming the same weekend as us with many more recognizable names. For Afterburner 2025, we are expecting viewership numbers akin to a major, anywhere from 2-10K concurrent viewers on stream which brings more opportunity for Nouns to advertise at the event.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our last regional, The Works 2024 at the end of June boasted 200 attendees alongside similar viewership statistics. This event was also sponsored by Nouns Esports and featured Cody Schwab and Nouns presence at the event. We were able to help advertise the original funding rounds to raise awareness for other tournament organizers and had multiple organizers apply for Nouns funding through this. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our other stats include our X account with 500 followers and 200,000 impressions during the marketing period of our last event. We also market in our local community Discord, Odyssey Esports with 400 current members.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our typical event marketing strategy includes between different Indiana and regional Discords, our contact sheet of attendees that have previously attended our events (over 700 players), through tweets, and in-person networking at other Indiana and Midwest events. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Cards handed out at Full Bloom 2024 before Afterburner 2024","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSc73FyYzPQ1uUp33fzkMNxirCJ6YMwdQM9g3oBm9UPQE","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/realChaseDeWitt/status/1761207019099357547","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/realChaseDeWitt/status/1761207019099357547"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Landon Frank, aka ScrubbedOut and I am the head event organizer and co-owner of Odyssey Esports. Over the last two years, I have been hosting events to revitalize the Indiana Smash ecosystem and make my city into a hub for large-scale events in the Midwest. We are making Afterburner the culmination of two years of effort and hard work towards making this happen!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Fort Wayne, Indiana (population of 267,000, small international airport) went from a city with dying locals in 2022 to 7 total 100 entrant events or higher between April 2023 - June 2024.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Previous other sponsors we have worked with include 5 different local Indiana and Ohio universities, that use the event for recruiting. We raised $1,750 towards last Afterburner through 4 college sponsorships like this. We gave the universities a presence at the event to find talent and recruit, advertise on our streams, and support the event.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For Afterburner 2025, we hope to bring out multiple Nouns-sponsored players and also plan to have the main Melee stream on Cody Schwab's Twitch channel. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For our last event, The Works 2024 which was sponsored by Nouns, we advertised the tournament rounds on our streams. We also had logo placement on live streams, start gg page, and the post-event graphic which garnered 13K impressions and 100 likes. We also had Nouns representation in-person at the event with a few Noggles provided by Peter which were featured on our Melee stream  ⌐◨-◨","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmTYeJ7Ve3GBbzCtheZwyZQXdBffhaAGqhhng3gXg77eLS","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSzYYoG8jx6KsvKSeASQKnr9g7AeHrsjEThgZ2UNwgUZ4","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are excited for the opportunity to make this event a great culmination of Indiana and Midwest Smash while having Nouns involved! Thank you!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Bustered Out - A Tennessee Regional
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello all!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Tyler Cox, aka Rooster. You may know me as the head TO and organizer for Warehouse War, the TN Major/Not Major/National/Gigaregional that happened back in July. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm putting together a new event in the mean time called Bustered Out that I'm holding at the local Dave & Buster's arcade in the Opryland Mall in Nashville. The intent behind this tournament is to be a celebration for our scene and have a little fun in between the rush of larger events that are happening all over and that we're traveling to. This will be taking place on October 19th and will be a one day event running both Melee and Project+.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We've had a number of positive experiences with Nouns and would love to continue working with you all and would greatly appreciate the opportunity to have your continued support for our events. If selected, this money will help us cover costs for booking the space as well as provide catering for all of the players taking part in the event. Also, we are considering flying out a possible top player to come down for the event to be a \"final boss\" for the local TN players to compete against and try and defend our turf. This money would also go a long way towards assisting with that as well.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As for what we can do for you, we'll be continuing the recognition and brand power for Nouns in the Tennessee and Southeast Melee scene, as well as continuing that reach to the Project+ community, who I know was incredibly grateful for the help you all gave us with Warehouse War and will continue to be involved. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We'll be livestreaming both Melee and Project+ on a to-be-determined channel as this event is technically not public yet, but we'll be sure to include Nouns branding and logos on our streams provided we receive this help. We also have our high-quality Noggles that we'll of course provide to casters to be seen on stream and can give some extras out to anyone who wants them in person.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As this will be in a public area (A very busy mall Arcade), this will also give some recognition to the branding to people who are passing by in public who might not be directly involved with Nouns as an eSports brand or otherwise.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Again, we've had nothing but good things in working with you all in the past and would love to continue to do so with this event as well.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.start.gg/tournament/bustered-out/details","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.start.gg/tournament/bustered-out/details"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmdJ3NEK4eauvP5xLtEK1UfTjSxPUR1EpJBu9cCELXHtno","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmdQjVrnyxdDmSHYPjrwACiR1647fcosbaLmj4q3yLfkzC","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

a snapshot of our future website design to host and promote our circuit. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With a future patch, our website will be able to host the entire circuit, promote all the coverage on it, show the ranking of each player and work with our Discord server to manage registrations.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This approach to doing things well is very important for us, as we not only want to create great tournaments, but also to level upwards our community, in an attempt to make our community emerge from the current slump, get out of forums, and start to grow on social media. We want straight up to not only save our community, but to also give it a long-term hype and make our players known like any other esport.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmceWRQLnbUUBsK4XtiABsTM4GSWuKtETRYwiFzKqhxeLS","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Articles on competitive scenes. Our goal is to promote Smogon and VGC format and bring several communities together.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why we need your help","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h2"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The cashprize comes from our own pockets, from the revenues of the YouTube channel we created to cover the circuit, and from generous donators, which is enough for all tournaments except for one, which is one of the most ambitious team tournaments ever done.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With your help during the Nouns Funds Tournaments #1, we managed to reach the €2000 goal. Now, we would like to go one step further. By winning the Nouns Funds Tournament #3 prize, we could offer several cashprize options for our team tournament. We have not yet decided how the cashprize will be distributed but we already have models. With the $500 prize, we could reward players who win their matches, captains who lead their team to the victory, outstanding individual performances and, of course, the winning team. To sum up, we could reward both team and individual champions. On the competitive scene, no structure has managed to do this before us.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmdDPa3GavXCVYRFscsLPnfodVRcuZjZBC9YTVRYA4a7cJ","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Critical League, a team tournament we are organizing, with 2000€ cashprize","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We could also pay the artists who work on illustrations, news articles’ covers, videos and logos of the several tournaments. Here, I would like to thank Brumirage, bentleys, SM and Stellar Flares for their intense work.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also, as mentioned before, the community is split in forums, which are declining, and our efforts to develop the community on social media have had encouraging but not satisfying results for now, as players are reluctant to leave their forums. That is why we think that a boost from Nouns could help us to make players from all over the world be interested in joining us and the online competitive scene on social media, and we would gladly put nouns as an official sponsor of the tournament if we are selected to promote the Nouns brand and socials.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Coup Critique staff would like to thank Nouns for this amazing opportunity, which will surely help develop small esport communities to grow !","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Flip/Side Pinnacle - A bi-annual MD/VA regional
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUY2PhtRmWVfNa21aYmcqw6eKpmB6vtnePnoFQESJFqbK","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Introduction","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"What's up y'all! MJ here! Known as frames, I'm primarily a Melee player in the MD/VA region, though I also play Project+ and Ultimate! I have experience not only from running my own tournament, but assisting in stream running at the MD/VA 2024 Arcadian, and side-stream at The Cave - Fairfax Finale, which as of writing has 120+ registered participants.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Filling in an area in the huge MD/VA region that previously had no local, Flip/Side has been a bi-weekly staple for almost a year, with a classic SSBM bracket format. At our Tuesday events we've had top 100 players such as mvlvchi and Kevin Maples, and MD/VA PR talent Gibblez, Eve, Cbass. We’ve since started hosting Project+ at the same event, featuring top 100 talent Hyperflame and Goode, and are really excited to continue growing our local scene for such great games. Our past and upcoming events can be seen on our start.gg hub here","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://www.start.gg/hub/flipside","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.start.gg/hub/flipside"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Pinnacle Overview","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"During the 2023 MD/VA PR season we were selected for our bi-annual event Pinnacle, to receive not one, but two qualifier spots for the region’s MD/VA Summit, with 30+ attendees at our first event. Our promotion featured graphics where we highlighted past attendance and wins, an example can be seen here","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://twitter.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1741585170602336563","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://twitter.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1741585170602336563"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":". Pinnacle #2 on July 20th meanwhile doubled our attendance and featured additional region PR talent Nav, Egg, RapM, Gibblez, Eve, Seven, SypherPhoenix, Bob-omb, and Satoshi, and top 100 competitors ZODD-01, Kevin Maples, and mvlvchi.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Nouns funding proposal is primarily for our next bi-annual event, a few months from now. Pinnacle #3 will take place in January of 2025 featuring Smash Bros. Melee, Project+, and more. However the funding will bolster our tournament series as a whole.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Funding Proposal","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While we’ve had great success so far, we’re currently running Flip/Side on a bare minimum set of equipment. So far the community has pitched in tremendously, however Nouns funding would set us up in a more sustainable way so we can better host these events.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A portion of the funds would go towards adding more setups to our equipment, currently we’ve run off of 5 setups (5 crts, 5 wiis used for both Melee and P+ capacity) and the rest provided by the community when possible. Likewise with the stream we’re looking to purchase a capture card and splitter configuration so we can consistently and better stream Project+ and highlight the awesome game and community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Specific to Pinnacle #3, we’d like to sponsor carpool drivers to encourage both in and out of region attendance from greater distances and provide out-of-region top players bonuses for attending.  Additionally we’d like to provide Nouns swag to attendees through raffles and pre-registration bonuses. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Another key goal is to commission a few different pieces of promotional material including a custom Twitch overlay for our stream use going forward, a highlight reel for Pinnacle #2, and Pinnacle #3, and a hype trailer for Pinnacle #3. Our Pinnacle #1 highlight reel by an in-region editor can be found here","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nui2u43AvQk","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nui2u43AvQk"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns Representation","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns would be featured both on our start.gg and on in-person displays, as well as our stream overlay, and would see shout outs and sponsor posts on our social media. Flip/Side has a strongly recognizable brand in-region and has decent reach online, including a relatively popular post from one of our Project+ bracket streams featuring Hyperflame and Satoshi","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://x.com/Malkasaur/status/1780415491401552198","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/Malkasaur/status/1780415491401552198"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"If sponsored, Pinnacle #3 would feature its main stream on Nouns esports Twitch channel, with our own channel as a side stream. We’d also integrate Nouns into our branding and swag giveaways. Previously we’ve given Flip/Side stickers to attendees at their third time attending an event in our series, and we’d include Nouns merch in this as well","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://x.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1765537271564898650","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1765537271564898650"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Expected Reach","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our first event just a few months in to hosting had 30+ attendees, and acted as an MD/VA Melee Summit qualifier, just six months later through grassroots work we doubled that to 60, with more top level entrants and 15 teams in Melee doubles, one of the largest doubles events in our region. Our relatively new Twitch channel had 150 unique viewers during the course of the event, so with Nouns backing and promotion to the Nouns Twitch channel there’s huge potential for viewership due to the quality of the event and gameplay.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Promotion Strategy","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our first step is a highlight reel from Pinnacle #2, as a quick visual summary of the amazing gameplay and experience that the event was. Next, we will be inviting top level players in our region, as well as neighboring regions to Pinnacle #3. As top players RSVP we’ll post player cards on our social media pages that detail their previous Flip/Side series wins and build hype for the Pinnacle #3 attendance. Between word of mouth and frequent reminders as we approach the event, turnout is estimated to be 60-70+ attendees for our third event with capabilities for even more. And lastly we’d close out promotion with a hype trailer for the event.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Conclusion","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With funding from Nouns, we here at Flip/Side can better expand our series to highlight  Smash Melee and Project+. By bolstering our equipment and outreach, enhancing our already strong name recognition, the potential for growth of our scene multiplies greatly, so we can put on better events for the local, regional, and greater Smash community. With potential for better and larger regionals in the future.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}
