title: HI I am vexoskeleton and this is my proposal to join nouns at wavelength <3
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"HI,","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm Vexoskeleton, I am a long time SSBM competitor local to the boston melee scene (right next to where wavelength will be hosted wow!) ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I Have been a part of the Boston melee community for almost 8 years now, with Shine 2016 being my first major and Shine being the only major I have been able to attend until this year where I will be traveling to riptide next week (yippee!) I have helped TO within the local community on and off for years including running a small tournament in Worcester for a summer in 2017 and partially running boston's premier local New Game Plus in 2019. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Since coming back to boston after covid in 2022 I have been attending many tournaments in the local scene, including most recently attending final warning in Maine and The Sauna 2 in Mass.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"And honestly I'm just a guy who enjoys being a part of the community. I havent really had any significant results but I know how to put on a smile and write 150 words about myself for a chance at getting sponsored. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've been a long time member of this community and I think it'd just be a blast to be able to represent my local scene and with the money I'd get from this sponsorship it would also allow me to travel to more major tournaments (possibly Dont Park on the Grass or Genesis!)","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"So you should sponsor me because as a life long lover of Esports, it would be a dream come true to be sponsored by a cool organization like Nouns for a tournament and be able to brag to my friends that I was once a sponsored player for Melee :^)","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Heres my socials","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.start.gg/user/89ee8c25","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.start.gg/user/89ee8c25"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://twitter.com/vexoskeleton","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://twitter.com/vexoskeleton"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Why Launders Should Have Noun 754
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, I’m launders. I am a full-time Counter-strike 2 commentator, content creator and enthusiast of community building. I’m a lifelong gamer, dedicating my adult life to esports, I love Nouns and I want to participate in proposal governance. That is why I am proposing for Noun 754.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmQXwAmEacyECc9Z9u2Tkqv8wNtDJQ3WmFucgPDujpPRug","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Here are the reasons why I will be a productive contributor to the DAO as a Noun holder.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I will vote on the vast majority of proposals; they are the most intriguing part of the organization for me and I would love to assist with the Nouncil eventually.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I will provide feedback as a builder, proposer and someone who has run my own businesses as well as been full time and a contractor for many others. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I post on warpcast regularly and naturally as an esports person, about Nouns esports as a vertical.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I played melee and broodwar on CRTs as a young competitive gamer.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":4}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why 754?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmS2QfeuVnhYGmjsw6UyBYxc8BUvVhahtVKye8bPxGW2eb","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Although the accessories on both 895 and 754 are dubious in their impressiveness, Nouns 754 is the superior colorway with braver complimentary shades of blue and purple. 754’s shirt is also giving maze puzzle which is nostalgic. For these reasons I hope you can see that I have given the thought of writing a proposal to secure one of these Nouns a lot of thought and consideration.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmet3bT9Uhoie2C8r5ZoJoNesJiF2MJ6BoB9mFTVeGYds8","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for taking the time to read to my proposal. I have a strong social media following of 155k followers on X, 13.8k on Instagram and 164,000 on YouTube. I believe I can be an excellent ambassador for the DAO if you give me a shot to provide governance in Nouns and I vow to do my best to make the DAO proud as a new and ambitious builder with a keen eye for talent.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-launders","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Minted Chompix: New to Crypto, Ready to Build Together ⌐◨-◨
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Background:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Carlos '","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Chompix","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://liquipedia.net/dota2/User:Chompix"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"' O. Huaricapcha. I possess a unique combination of experience as a professional esports content creator and graduate student at the University of Minnesota. This has given me a versatile skill set, making me a strong candidate for the Nouns delegate position. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmbMDHAa9A7KV53a43FxwtuGW7bW8BUaezdY86wjNVviip","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am an experienced tournament organizer, esports commentator, and ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"streamer","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://twitch.tv/ChompixGaming"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" with four years of involvement in the Dota 2 community. I've spent four years in the Dota 2 community, organizing tournaments, commentating, and streaming. This journey began with my involvement in soccer events in San Francisco, where I honed teamwork, strategy, and community-building skills—qualities I've brought into the Dota 2 ecosystem to create leagues and events that unite players.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmXgLzYkU1nYZg1CVmzrphTPFG5SW9UTdMgsJzre482zyW","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Offline, I am a Ph.D. Mathematics student at the University of Minnesota (Go Gophers!). I have taught at community colleges and universities and the San Quentin Prison University Project, where I've worked with students aged 18 to 65+. My teaching philosophy centers on the belief that every individual defines their own goals uniquely, and my mission has been to support them in achieving those goals. As president of the Math Alliance Student Chapter at UMN, I lead initiatives to increase the representation of underrepresented groups in the quantitative sciences, promoting diversity and fostering research collaborations.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSJSn7VmPgU46jKzKozXvFaCRp1ysXGfkKV3wyWExahZn","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While I have extensive experience in academia, I am relatively new to the industry, especially the Nouns DAO ecosystem, which I'm eager to explore further as I transition into this field after completing my degree. I knew Crypto back in San Francisco, but my real introduction came through esports, which led me to discover the broader Nouns ecosystem.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why I'm Applying:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I first encountered Nouns Esports during the NA DPC in May 2022, but through direct engagement with PPD and the NADCL, I gained a deeper understanding of the Nouns DAO community and their contributions. This experience inspired me to dive into the Nouns ecosystem and apply for the Let's Play Nouns Delegate Program.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In my online work, I created Tier 4 events in the Americas, some now featuring players who compete in The International (TI). I also initiated GEMS, a Gender Minorities initiative, to promote Dota 2 when very few tournaments existed for these groups. At Majors, I've led \"La Barra,\" a Dota 2 crowd in Lima, using drums and chants to enhance the atmosphere and show our support for all teams.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmdMT5sZiWtY4xQetg33ZGwEmQJERGqCoXBpQFhDHKKgLB","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As a delegate, I am committed to actively participating in the NounsDAO. I pledge to vote on more than 66% of NounsDAO proposals, providing clear reasons for my votes. I will also actively seek and incorporate feedback from other delegates. Additionally, I will share biweekly updates on the ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Warpcast","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://warpcast.com/chompix"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" channel, reflecting on how NounsDAO impacts my journey and the community.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I envision Nouns continuing its legacy of inclusivity and a supportive community where individuals from diverse backgrounds can make valuable contributions, irrespective of their familiarity with cryptocurrency. My aim is to enhance awareness and understanding of the Nouns ecosystem online and offline.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With my extensive experience in esports, community organizing, and academic leadership, I am confident in my ability to contribute to NounsDAO. I am committed to fostering a community that values diversity, participation, and innovation. I look forward to the opportunity to help make Nouns a more welcoming and inclusive community. Thank you for considering my application.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmTYzp2GGj2cMEe4knzXQoNARqa3q6DUeno6pzzrYXceVR","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"P.S. 🎉 Happy Birthday Nephsensei 🎂","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: MattTaylorLoL - Web3 Native, Esports Advocate
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am MattTaylorLoL, and I am here to earn your vote to become the first Let's Play Nouns Delegate.  My journey within the Nouns Ecosystem including NounsDAO, NounsEsports, Nouncil, and Gnars has been one of the most impactful in my career, and I would honored for the opportunity to contribute on a higher level.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've had the privilege of collaborating on impactful projects at Consensus and NFT NYC, where we've showcased the spirit of the Nouns community.","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcZioMns6bZZezn4nYtnhHZKjbUHqpvsPNDonpdiFm8Jt","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My experience advising the NYC Mayor's Office on Game Development and Esports, running the NYC High School Esports League, and partnering with Microsoft for Scholastic Minecraft Events, has equipped me with a strong understanding of how to build and nurture communities.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As your delegate, I pledge to vote in favor of all Nouns Esports proposals and to carefully review all propositions to identify those that will have the greatest impact on our community. I will actively participate in Weekly Nouns Esports meetings, bringing my knowledge of the Web3 ecosystem to provide educated and thoughtful opinions.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am committed to sharing our collective journey with the wider world. With my experience in promoting Web3 communities and leveraging Web2 social media, I will work tirelessly to bring new eyes to Nouns, builders, and communities on Farcaster and beyond. I have travelled the country to spread the love I have for Blockchain tech and the Nouns community, and will continue to do so behind my Noggles. I believe in the power of our community, and I am ready to amplify our voice. Together, we can make Nouns an even more welcoming and impactful space for everyone.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for your consideration and support. Let's play Nouns, and let's make history together!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

My name is Landon Frank and my tag is ScrubbedOut! ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm an esports organizer and competitor currently working on building the smash ecosystem in the Midwest and my state of Indiana. (Afterburner 2024 - 342 attendees, The Works 2024 - 197 attendees)","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am also a content creator with about 1,000 subscribers and 1,100 Twitter followers, very active in the SSBU community. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmV3htwcpiEGY4uco9joczcHLiRpCiFGoAEjFVKvgT4nSY","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmTYeJ7Ve3GBbzCtheZwyZQXdBffhaAGqhhng3gXg77eLS","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmQuZn2c8u9DyH8MkFRpBxWjFEM2NtTLxxse2sfzg3dpiP","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I was introduced to Nouns through their esports sponsorships and rounds, as I know many other organizers are for the first time as well. Esports desperately needs help with funding, especially in grassroots scenes that live off of community support. What Nouns is doing for esports is so huge for organizers like myself that allows us to pursue our goals of making the best event we possibly can and build up both of these amazing communities. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Unlike some of the other proposals, I have virtually 0 experience in crypto. That being said, I've just made a Warpcast account (you can follow me @scrubbedout) and first wallet! title: ~ JULZZ ~  ⌐◨-◨
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmXAjwmP68fH2zw3kVUFey4hsQL2zaaL8MNNnPJSnHjmQE","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello there! I'm Julzzzzzzzzz, a 5' Yoshi main and an esports photographer (as well as some videography). In my region of New England, I participate in organizing tournaments and provide production for local events. Esports is a newer adventure for me, but going from a fan of games like Counter-Strike, Melee, and RuneScape in my teens to like, actually working on behind-the-scenes of esports events has been a dream come true. Along with my media work, I’ve spent nearly a decade in IT, the last 3 years focusing on Cybersecurity, and I hold degrees in Web Development and Computer Networking & Security. I've always been interested in technology and became familiar with decentralized currencies in my teens.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmWqx5gffiAJq7uDGwnipNmpj6Te7fzbzJKubjzggoqgQr","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I currently do my best to be actively involved with Nouns in ways I can including contributing my votes in Nouns Esports Rounds [where I’ve reached 'Champion' status]. I also actively participate in the Nouns Warpcast space and hope to continue to do so. Owning a Noun would allow me the opportunity to get more involved with the NounsDAO and allow me to continue contributing on a larger scale.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmT65M5QKnMGKBMLzmPXniFjSGbAT2rjn1QG4EJTrrXAt6","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"If given the opportunity, I’ll:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Actively vote on NounsDAO proposals, providing clear reasoning and sources for my decisions.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Stay engaged in the Nouns Warpcast channel & post biweekly updates about my Nouns community experiences.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Also I'm a huge fan of CRTs","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for reading my proposal! (and experiencing my amazing writing skills lmaoo)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Julzz~","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: I'm Goosekhan, Looking to Rep Nouns and Canada at Wavelength 2024!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It's ya boy Goosekhan, looking to represent Nouns at Wavelength 2024 with my Captain Falcon. I had my big breakout performance earlier this year at GOML 2024, where I placed 33rd out of 770 entrants and beat notable top 50 players in Khalid and MOF. I've been steadily improving ever since, as well, and I'm confident I could have another amazing performance at Wavelength, and potentially make the SSBMRank top 100.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've been an active member of the Ontario Melee Scene for 9 years now, doing my best to attend as much as possible, whether it be at a LAN cafe at Weekly Wave / Revenge of the 6ix, in the basement of a vape shop with Da Greenhouse, or - more recently - the upstairs bar of Monarch Tavern for The Local. I love hanging out with my friends at the locals, and interacting with the bright minds and hearts of the Toronto Melee scene. I rarely get to travel out of region often, and this would be a great opportunity for me to do so and show you what Toronto Melee is all about!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am also active on X / Twitter: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/GooseKizzle","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/GooseKizzle"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It's where I post my latest and flashiest combos, many of which I hit in tourney (another highlight of my GOML run was falcon punching jmook on stream). title: The Nouns Pokemon Unite team wants to become delegates!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello fellow Nounish Nexus Voters ⌐◨-◨ ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"ADESu writing from the Pokemon Unite team from Nouns Esports bringing the whole team for this round!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Who are we?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We’ve been in Nouns since June 2022! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks to a favorable vote from proposal 91 of Nouns Dao we began to play under the name of the organization that funds dreams. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks to that we managed to achieve a second place at Worlds 2022!","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeMDQmZPfqG3LWf3OQtoqRfdPVByNNyXmsBkwKK-mRBeLhIkmiozzTx285Lh0cntZPgf0pgcsdqGmBOe4AsDJrkKi8XfI6wyhfR9ffNdY92t9wFW3feCJz6bIoX8psP6p-hU8BG5I60hLEotTdPhznTE46_?key=NoDGsUQ9KfOgSdaSEsloKA","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We’ve been trying to pursue our dream of winning worlds since then under the Nouns name, and being ambassadors for Nouns for our communities and the Pokemon community as a whole.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The roster has had changes over time, but we still pursue the same goal! ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our team currently has 20000 followers on X and Youtube respectively, and 40000 total on Twitch.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why do we propose ourselves?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We decided that this year we were going to dedicate ourselves much more to not only the Nouns Esports community but also the DAO. Therefore, becoming a delegate and participating actively in the DAOs decision making process via votes and feedback will be a great way to begin to have a more active role in Noun’s future.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We primate.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Members title: Community Gaming Delegate Proposal
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community Gaming","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.communitygaming.io/"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" has established itself as the world's most advanced competitive gaming platform, powering payments for over 50,000 web2 & web3 tournament matches each month for games like League of Legends, Valorant, Mobile Legends, Free Fire, and web3 games like Axie Infinity, Parallel, and Apeiron. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Since 2021, we have onboard over 500k users, generating wallets for them and enabling them to earn their first crypto (usually USDC) as rewards for competing in tournaments and completing quests.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our platform supports automated payments of any EVM or Solana crypto token or NFT including stablecoins like USDC. We support Base, Ronin, Polygon, Solana and abstract away the complexities of wallet creation and gas fees as we cover all onchain trabsaction fees platform-wide in the background to provide traditional gamers with a seamless tournament experience.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We have been huge fans of Nouns since we worked together at our 3XP Gaming Expo in 2023 working together then with Nouns leadership as speakers at our expo and consistently thereafter with Nouns Esports players and creators in our online streamed tournaments.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are a global company of 35+ people in NA, Latin America, and Southeast Asia who have raised over $20M from investors like SoftBank, Binance, BITKRAFT, Multicoin, and Griffin Gaming. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We would be honored to be a delegate who can meaningfully participate in voting but also educate our large audience of over 50k MAU on the Nouns ecosystem through our online and in-person events, driving awareness around the Nouns brand and utiltiy of owning Nouns to participate in the community and DAO.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Why Solo Should Be the Next Let’s Play Nouns Delegate
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmNbfouoAnMge3dBPH9PfDFVuMZMEJ1E7zuYkxGTSKPHDY","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello all! My name is Solo. I am a product designer by trade, however I’ve a lot of experience in content creation + strategy as well as event production through my prior work experience as well as through the gaming media and events production company I founded called People Like Games.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ve been part of the Nouns ecosystem for over six months now, and my passion for the project and community has only deepened. This is why I am submitting my proposal for Noun 754, as I’m eager to become involved in the governance aspects of Nouns.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Over the past six months, I’ve had a chance to learn a lot about not only Nouns Esports, but about the entire Nouns DAO as well. I’ve attended multiple Nouns events and connected with a bunch of Nouns people, all of who share the same vision of doing cool and positive things while helped to expand Nouns’ reach and impact. Beyond my familiarity with Nouns Esports, I’ve also contributed to IRL Nouns activations, specifically a set of event activations and merchandise retail shop at EdCon 2024 in Tokyo, Japan. A direct hands-on experience in being part of a successfully executed proposal from its inception stage to end, with a mission throughout of onboarding newcomers into Nouns.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We even did an Esports activation with AMSA in front of a massive Noggles floatie.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSfD4mGY4bVqPZq461UW8ker3wxTkZcTyDuZ4ij7ZFX2u","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why I Should Be Selected:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As a delegate, I would bring a fresh, informed perspective, grounded in my active involvement in Nouns Esports and the broader ecosystem. Here’s what I offer:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"· ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Commitment to Informed Decisions:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" I will make thoughtful decisions that prioritize the best interests of the community, ensuring that Nouns remains inclusive and welcoming for everyone, regardless of their background in crypto.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"· ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Active Participation:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" My dedication to Nouns is evident in my ongoing contributions—whether it’s attending calls, helping with events, or working on proposals.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"·  ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Vote on over 66% of NounsDAO proposals","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" during my time with Nouns. I’ve regularly attended weekly Nouncil calls – an experience which has provided me with valuable insights into the governance process and the importance of thoughtful, informed voting.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmWx7CStW2K6SHw7JsozpKLyM6nmkyYNY1CYsAqCP6MeyK","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Conclusion:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Having been actively involved across various parts of the Nouns DAO, It's made me realize what a special place the Nouns Community is. It's a place that I'd love to see continue to grow and bring in new people, and I'd like to do my own part in helping it do so. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I believe my track record of active participation and my commitment to the community make me an ideal candidate for the ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Let’s Play Nouns Delegate Program","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: GET SALAMI'S ASS TO WAVELENGTH!!!!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmVxAxmLFnNmNsE8JShKg3WWQh3rvo7tr5iytZJCDtQua5","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello everybody, I am salami :) I am a fox player from Southern California and I am looking for support to get to Wavelength 2024. I always wanted to go to Shine but I was never able to make it work, and I missed my opportunity. Now that Wavelength, Shine's spiritual successor, is being run, I feel an obligation to make it out to this series. I have only been able to go to the east coast one time for tipped off, so an opportunity to play at an East Coast major would be a huge honor. As far as my qualifications go, I have been incredibly active this year, getting several top level wins, and only a few losses to people seeded below me. So far this year I have beaten Panko, Panda, Lucky, Blue, Khalid, Koopatroopa, Zeo, Nut, Fknsilver, Fitzy, Omar, CPU0, Snap, Monotheon, Casper, Franz, Steech, Cliche, OGkid, Htwa, Vavez, (you get the picture I can beat A LOT of good players). My worst losses have only been to Simmons, Casper, Abel, Gooms, and CAUP. These are the only 5 non top 100 players I have lost to since 01/02/2024 (including locals and prelocals). If I can make it to this tournament, I will be forever grateful. I love you all and I wish you all the best. title: I'm MarxistxAthena, A Pennsylvanian Jigglypuff Looking to Go to Wavelenght and Beyond Repping Nouns
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello, ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am MarxistxAthena, a Smash Melee Jigglypuff player who got back into Melee in late 2022 after taking a break from it in January of 2021, which happened one year after my journey with Melee began when I was a Marth main. When I came back to play in 2022, I became a Jigglypuff main, and since then, I have made numerous accomplishments online and offline. Competing in Smash Melee and getting to know the people in the community means a lot to me as it helped me improve on the things I needed to work on, such as self-confidence, which competing in Melee was a big help in and through the offline tourneys I have entered, which are Collision, Creed 3, and Supernova, I have made valuable friendships I otherwise would not have made if not for being part of the community. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"At Supernova this past weekend, from August 8th to the 11th, I managed to place above my seed of 100 by about 35, making it to 65th out of 905, and took an upset off an MDVA Sheik named Egg, who is ranked number 8 in the most recent MDVA rankings. At Matcha Cup: Combined Coasts on June 25th, 2024, I placed 7th out of 90 at the tournament, placing above my seed of 20 and winning against the player Gahtzu, who was ranked 50 in the Smash Melee 2023 rankings. At Matcha Cup: East Coast on June 6th, 2024, I managed a placement of 9th out of 113, with a win on Wevans, a top 100 player in 2023 who was ranked 86. I won Waddle Wednesday 137, beating players like JChu twice in winner's finals, set 2 of grand finals, and beat Salt's Donkey Kong 3-1 in winners semis. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I would be a great representative for Nouns because I am a Melee player, with potential achieve better results and more wins on top players in offline tourneys when given the opportunity and chance to be sponsored by Nouns Esports. This opportunity would make me more involved in the offline Melee scene, especially with majors such as Riptide and Genesis, where I could prove the improvements I have made as a player and the skills title: Bring Akir and the DK Renaissance to Wavedash 2024
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey everyone! I'm Akir and I'm looking to represent Nouns and Donkey Kong at Wavedash 2024. I've been competing in Melee for 9 years now, and I was ranked #90 in the world on the 2023 SSBMRank last year. However, my ability to attend tournaments outside of Florida has been extremely limited. Instead, you may know me for terrorizing the Slippi ranked leaderboard and many 2023 online tournaments. Thankfully, Fizzi and the community at large helped get me to GENESIS and Tipped Off earlier in the year, and I've done my best to make as much of these opportunities as I can, gathering wins on top 100 players Soonsay, Krudo, Gahtzu, Wevans, and Fishbait in the first half of the year and earning #37 on the 2024 Summer SSBMRank.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This brings me to here: I am looking to continue pushing Donkey Kong at any tournaments I'm able to attend. Nouns has been doing some incredible work supporting the Melee community through their community sponsorships, and I would love to represent both them and the Florida Melee community at Wavelength. For a long time and for a variety of reasons, I have not had the opportunity to participate at major Melee events, and it would mean the world to me to be able to represent an organization charitable enough to offer me the opportunity to continue playing Melee at a high content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey guys, you probably have 0 clue who I am but my name is Den (not the Fox player from Tennessee). title: Rooster Is Feeling Nounish
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello friends!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As you might know, my name is Tyler \"Rooster\" Cox, and I'm a Smash Bros Tournament Organizer from Nashville, Tennessee. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A bit more about me: I'm a Healthcare IT specialist by day and an event organizer by night as a passion project. I've been around competitive gaming since I was in my teens while being way too competitive at Mario Kart when I was a kid to getting into Counterstrike 1.6/Source and Heroes of Newerth into my teens and 20s. I rediscovered my love of competitive Smash in college and it's been a wild ride since. I've been organizing smash events in November of 2014. Check out my first event back when Facebook Events were where we ran these things ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.facebook.com/events/702677646447979/"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":". I've been doing this off and on now for almost a decade and the passion for engaging with the community and my friends has not waned since.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I first came into contact with Nouns last year when you all began your involvement with the Smash Bros scene and I've been incredibly impressed and happy from your collective presence in the scene. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Since then, I've been more involved in the Nouns ecosystem within the Discord, Warpcast, and participating in and voting on a handful of Rounds on the Nexus. Nouns has been especially beneficial with helping out two of my events personally that I've run (Warehouse War 4, and the upcoming Bustered Out). ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'll be the first to admit that I and a lot of members of the Smash community were skeptical at first of a Crypto/NFT collective becoming such a force for good in the Smash Community, but after having a long call with Peter about the goals and mission statement on what it means to be Nounish, I can firmly say I'm on board with what you all have put together and want to be a part of it.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmdQjVrnyxdDmSHYPjrwACiR1647fcosbaLmj4q3yLfkzC","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Peter gave me the rundown on how to get involved with Nouns at a more deep level, and having my very own Noun feels like a great place to continue my journey with you all to immerse myself in a project for good for the eSports scene, which honestly feels like a rarity these days.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Again, being involved in the DAO to help guide the ship seems like an awesome opportunity, and I hope you all consider me.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Skerzo - Rank #44 in the World from Japan for Lil Nouns!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi guys, its Skerzo here! You can find my Twitter here:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/skerzo_","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/skerzo_"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmbm63vm2TC1RwXR7RtdsYXv4qMg4ruVc1nG7k39Bq339B","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Proposal for Lil Nouns Esports - Don’t Park on the Grass","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Dear Lil Nouns Esports Team","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Adrian Chavez (better known as Skerzo), a \"semi-pro\" Super Smash Bros. Melee player maining Fox, currently residing in Tokyo, Japan. A decade in the scene as I was originally from Chicago, I was finally first ranked in 2022 but only after much sacrifice, spending basically all my spare cash going to majors to try to interact and play and learn from the best. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Unfortunately my love and passion for living and moving to Japan now makes it extremely difficult to justify and travel to the states. Regardless, I am excited about the opportunity to represent Japan and Lil Nouns Esports at Don't Park on the Grass. I believe I would be an excellent representative for several reasons, as I will go into down below.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Competitive Background & Achievements","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ve consistently competed in international and regional tournaments, and the year before, traveled all over the USA in >20 states. Obviously that is no longer easy for me to do, but here are some of my accomplishments:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Ranked 44th in SSBMRank Summer 2024 my peak was rank 32nd last summer.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In Japan: 1st place at Battle GateWay 45 (May 2024) and Shuuten Tokyo #8 (April 2024).","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Internationally: 2nd place at Phantom 2024 (AUS) and 7th place at SmashCon 2022 + Fete 2022","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Wins against top-ranked players like Joshman, Krudo, and JMook","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":4}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"These wins and placements were not easy to come by. I have been competing for basically a decade now, and tournament mentality has been a constant struggle along with trying to work full-time (which is obviously always a meme struggle for many top 50 level players trying to break through). I always end up losing a game 5 to Magi like 3 times, etc. playing and not being full-time Melee and try to beat a full-timer can just be demoralizing but also a fun challenge.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why Lil Nouns Esports?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I resonate with Lil Nouns’ vision of community-building (through tournaments like the invitational and content creation), and pushing boundaries with tech within the esports space (after all, I am a iOS developer). I am also going to work with Nicolet (Japan TO) to create an app that allows Slippi vods from majors to upload instantly at a mass scale (I do need to build my portfolio now lol).","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am also a massive fan of Aklo and Cody Schwab as they are big influences on my play and I always love hanging out with them at tournaments. I also really love the brand and style direction within Nouns because my name is \"Skerzo\" which comes from the Italian word for \"joke\", and people already about my goofy playstyle with Fox (which I would say is unorthodox for such a serious character). I believe Lil Nouns and I share a common goal of advancing esports culture in new and exciting ways.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmY75gyxidusmvKULc32kouTBaUFvHsAZovikEL6sdr5SG","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Me with Japan TO Babycat at Genesis. I help him set up the acclaimed Tokyo local \"Shuuten Melee\". In the future I want to do even more tournament organization tasks within the Japan scene, but so far him (and Nicolet) do a ton for the Tokyo melee scene so shoutouts to them!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Small shoutout as I was a co-founder and TO for the Knox College Smash Club and it was the first ever esports-oriented club created in campus. Nowadays, they get funding for equipment and travel to collegiate events. I TO'd in that college for about 2 years.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Obviously I love my Chicago scene and I always love tuning into the Midlane Melee weekly stream and seeing how my old community grows from there. Tenacity is doing a great job with building the scene and with the Out of the Blue series becoming bigger than ever and I am so proud of CLM (Chicagoland Melee) always and I will continue wearing that tag..","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Now here in Japan, I help set up the Shuuten Tournament local here in Tokyo and other assistance, splitting costs with Babycat since we have to pay for the venue and storage space for the CRTs and so we do not make a profit from the tournament but obviously we just love the game. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We have been really successfully recently, completely capping a 32-person tournament getting Amsa, Colbol, Inngenn, Shunsuke and others to come out! I didn't even make top 4 lol (no more clubbing before a tournament...).","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Closing","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My contract with my current company in Japan is actually ending next month, so it would be an incredible help to get this sponsorship, as I have no income currently. Therefore, between looking for new jobs, I would love the opportunity to represent Lil Nouns Esports at Don’t Park on the Grass. Thank you for considering my application, and I look forward to potentially joining the gamer fam.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Skerz out","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Bonus video of Joshman beating me last stock in Grands. I hope to pop off like that one day!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://youtu.be/-whX-oy8LPI?t=2012","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://youtu.be/-whX-oy8LPI?t=2012"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: FKNSILVER NEEDS YOUR HELP!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmY1cuJXmCyJtZruws4GvtL9GYizUNJtX9ytFPhvtjtRJ8","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Howdy, my tag is fknsilver! If you don't know me, I am a (pink) Samus player in super smash brothers melee. I have been playing the game for 10 years, since I was 15. In the past two years, because of a big move and financial strife, I have been unable to attend events at NEARLY the frequency that I would like, despite streaming 4+ times a week to grind and racking up a bunch of wins (including a few top 100 ones).","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"If I am voted in, I will not only put my all into the experience, but I will also showcase the fast and unorthodox playstyle that has helped me build a humble following. I am determined to not only prove that Samus can be very fast and super fun to watch, but also that by playing this way, she is still relevant in the meta and is still capable of placing well at large events. I have spent almost half my life working toward this goal and it is my dream to find the opportunities to prove myself and represent my character.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In the past year I have beaten Skerzo (Big House 2023), MOF (Dreamhack Atlanta 2024), and Zasa (Tipped Off 2024) as well as gone game 5 with n0ne on the big stage (Big House 2023). I hope that anyone who wants to see more of me, more of Samus, or just wants to hear the commentators say \"fuckin\", will consider voting for me. I appreciate your time, thank you for reading :)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/FuckinSilver","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/FuckinSilver"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: JMiSSF2 - Up and coming
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Wassup y'all! you can find my twitter over at:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/jmidoesstuff","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/jmidoesstuff"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSmRPK5g1Qm4Zxhbpsr4LNhidm1FUPFyCpEqyyTmGtQHk","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Who is this guy???","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Jeremiah \"JMi\" Wesley and I've had a love for smash that's extended about my entire life. I am originally from Dallas Texas, however I currently reside in Okinawa Japan. I've wanted to compete in all smash titles but ive never had the opportunity do to the expense of travel, that being amplified once I came to Japan. I believe I would be an incredible representative for Nouns at the event! I would like to compete in not only SSBM but SSBU as well :)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Background","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Even though I have not had the greatest success in SSBM, I have also played the other smash titles as well, such as SSBU, P+ and SSF2. SSF2 being the one I've had the most success in as I was ranked Top 10 in the world. (Yes, i mean super smash flash 2)","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1040024656750575717/1152797335353561160/45_8_2.png?ex=66f0d62e&is=66ef84ae&hm=8e2d21f463384acb007d60e0ac2c235bac002118225ff6438cddb2eeebbad9c3&","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1040024656750575717/1258107344269738085/10.png?ex=66f04f45&is=66eefdc5&hm=7bffa17ca6bc6e67085e555a1fa3f2cbbc4ab3f4f31795d219806a2cce12e447&","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"There are other great smash players who have came from SSF2 such as LunarySSF2 who has excelled in Europe, and Dany2Theny from Tennessee who has succeeded in SSBU. I strive to be like both of them and break into a bigger title and soon make a name for myself.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I started playing SSBM at the release of slippi and it was one of the most impactful things to happen to me. I had always been a spectator of the game, i just never had been able to invest time into it due to not having a controller and not having access to my local scene. Slippi, of course, was able to change that and ever since then i've been heavily invested into the game and have had the goal of ONE DAY being a top player (i know the journey will be long)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also I started playing slippi on keyboard so when it was time to eventually play the game in person, I started on a custom made box-style controller that a friend (VerminKnight) made for me. It is the same layout of controls I used for SSF2 and made the transition significantly easier","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"a clip of what it looks like can be seen here:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/jmidoesstuff/status/1827915582097997905","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/jmidoesstuff/status/1827915582097997905"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"and Impact","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community has always been big thing for me. No matter where I am and what i'm doing i like to leave an impact on whoever is there. Seeing nouns and extended and reach out to the broader areas of the community like us here in Asia is inspiring as its the level of outreach i strive to have one day.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Why Launders Should Have a Noun
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUeJ9ytmR4WHkMZ1sXgAugRN9eqNLqmi15F69942svdq2","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Launders LAN 2 concludes.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The returning champ invite to Launders LAN 3 is awarded to Nouns fe  as they sweep the grand final before 8pm Sunday. Hangover Noggles are worn on the flight home. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Destiny was realized. The echo of their conquest reverberates throughout the 3rd web from the ether.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It becomes February 2025. Proposal 743 “Launders Land” is passed and the DAO offers its returning support after seeing the overwhelmingly positive reception from an impassioned esports audience. The gaming market saturation reaches a critical mass. The Nouncil becomes an Apple TV+ exclusive series. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"July 1st, Launders Land is a smash success and begins making headlines of top Canadian publications with Nouns cited as the reason for its incubation. The sentiment and education surrounding the impact of communities like Nouns drastically improves.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"July 24th is Launders 35th birthday. He reflects on his ephemeral, Nounless existence.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"2028. Your nonna asks you what a Noun is. You see a tiktok of a dashund wearing noggles. Ethereum’s market cap is 30 trillion.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"2077. Launders is still Nounless. He’s been dead for 19 years. Launders Land 16 boasts near earth orbit rocket tour giveaways for attendees. The prize pool is $6M dollars. Nouns fe wins again. A life size hologram of prime Launders powered by AI awards them medals on stage.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Launders children have been left nothing because every round of funding raised was reinvested into creating the ultimate gaming experience for future generations. They grow up not fully understanding the  DAO because he spent 100% of their childhood(s) governanceless, just working on gaming events. If only he had a Noun to delegate to them so they could have participated in governance on his behalf.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Delegate a Noun to Launders so that this future happens with none of the bad parts. He will be a top contributor and participate in many important proposals and Nouncils.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks for reading, I appreciate your support and votes.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Launders ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}
