title: JMR Luna  FTW! ⌐◨-◨
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Howdy! ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is JMR Luna! OG Esport ex-ceo! (well the only CEO they ever had) and big nouns fanboi.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Love what you guys are doing at Nouns, and Nouns Esports, and when I saw this cool opportunity I decided to apply and see if I can be of help! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmbVXWp5pL33B41Ar3aTy2bxDWHVRtq8kvHCSRqBkBasAr","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A little about me: ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Born in Spain. Moved to LA to do my master's and stayed for 16 years... Worked in Hollywood making films for 14 years (Netflix, studios, and such), and I am part of the Prestigious Producer Guild of America (PGA)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- I have always been a hardcore gamer. Ultima Online, WOW... and Specially Dota. The one game to rule them all.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My adventure in Esports ...","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"...started when I joined PPD during this time as the CEO of Evil Geniuses to help him create content. (I was the Head of Content). Still one of the highlights of my life... the first time I went to the Alameda EG House and saw the boyz.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"... then I joined Immortals (LA Valiant Overwatch, and MIBR CSGO) as the Vice President. Cool experience. Especially with Fallen and the Brazilians. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"... And then I ended up being the CEO of OG Esports for 3 years. Where we became Dota's biggest organization, and media presence in the space.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- As the CEO of OG I played, in my opinion, a key role in helping shape the landscape of Dota Esport, and to help to unite the teams and help them articulate what they wanted better when talking to Tournament Organizers and Valve. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Also - in CSGO, I was part of the Blast Premiere Council member, representing the interests of all the teams.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"representing","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"------","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also in Esports -","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" I think I made some of the coolest Esport content out there. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"But I am especially proud of the show I Created and Hosted: The Monkey Business Show.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A weekly show that became the biggest show in Dota, bringing together players, casters, personalities together in a fun and friendly environment. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We did weekly episodes every week, and then we took the show on the road for the majors and TI.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qme6rgjcYggpRf3oUoGFu1DQE9M6aKv7SPdwAjogMB2PzQ","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmT5Z6nz41PKE7HpcFmhV3c5wCkZ9Gnq4zdUGLWHR6JjLv","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"------","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"So why do I want to be part of Nouns?","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Well to be fair, one of the coolest things about Nouns is that you don't need to have one to participate.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"So I have been advising and helping the Nouns Esport guys whenever they needed. I got into a lot of calls with Pat and offered assistance numerous times. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I also participated in Nouns events.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" I spoke at Ed Con in Tokyo a month ago with Pat on a Pannel about Nouns Esports ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmRtTSAiN2uDBfYCfXemjo4bLy4QCDWWnJkjMVDR7Jt6bW","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Also moderated a web 3 Gaming panel in Eth Denver 2023 (Photo: Erik Anderson (Faze Clan), me (OG), Pat (Nouns))","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":2},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmefbUN9YHfNcZqa4QjWEuAaHbrztJeiCBi2pv8Aq86YU7","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"and at Eth Denver I was even a Mentor on the hackathon - yes repping Nouns hahaha","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmf5V4XhrqTm6EYAgYpQDuRvAy9iEdjjqioSHwKSnvcXDV","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Ok ... it think this application is already going for way too long. Sorry, I always talk too much...","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"But yeah, I would like to officially become a nouns holder and continue working with you guys, and I'm excited to see how this application is received. I will contribute and take this seriously and see what we can all build together! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Have a great day! :)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"JMR","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: a Noun for Nouns | Aklo
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmVJY6zyBBHz7yoi9NLNKNDVRTKX6T6Y3pi6Y5axV9funG","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, all! My name is Dawud, though you might know me better by my tag, Aklo. I have been competing for Nouns Esports in Super Smash Bros Melee since October of 2022, and was ranked #10 in the world on the official rankings.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My role within Nouns goes much further than just competing, however. During my time with Nouns, I have acted as a representative for the organization, attending events on a national and international level to foster community development and engagement.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My onboarding to Nouns Esports introduced Nouns to tens of thousands of Smash Community members. Since then, I have used my ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"platform","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/NotAklo"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" to help my community gain a better understanding not only of Nouns Esports, but of Nouns DAO as a whole.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmWWwBwPm3cBwELFiuzJmxLCUqamp9EtFPWyGyFGoYxmdv","type":"image","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Due to my positive standing/reputation in the Smash Community, I have assigned myself with the responsibility of integrating gamers into the world of Nouns. This has been an extremely fruitful effort, largely in part due to the ease of use and accessibility that is offered by ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"nouns.gg","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"nouns.gg"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":". Having had numerous gamers reach out to me with questions pertaining to Nouns, I have essentially taken the role of a Nouns ambassador to the Smash Community. I have even met with rounds winners from different countries such as England, the Netherlands (pictured above), Canada, etc.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I seek to expand my knowledge of Nouns DAO so that I can help others gain a better understanding of what Nouns represents. I do not own a Noun, and I do not have a strong background in crypto. I have never voted on a proposal before, which is why I think the opportunity of becoming a Delegate would be great stepping stone for me to get more involved. I am already active on ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Warpcast","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://warpcast.com/notaklo"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", meaning that consistent posts will be no problem.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"What I appreciate most about Nouns is that just like the Smash Bros Melee Community, they are a grassroots organization. It is also worth noting that the Nouns being awarded to winners of the Delegate Program are CRT Head Nouns. title: Lemon - I beat Skerzo last week
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A little about Me","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Yo! Greetings from Japan! This is Lemon, some people call me TVD (definitely don’t look that up in Urban Dictionary), and others may even know my alter ego, ShreksWhisper, who was ranked in both Oregon and Arizona once upon a time. Lemon mains Falco, but ShreksWhisper’s Sheik surfaces from time to time for a few matchups. Together, they could prove to be a formidable force at DPotG this year. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Growing up, I spent countless hours beating the crap out of my little brother…in various Smash Bros games, of course. However, after coming home from college one summer ready to hand him another beating, he was schmoovin’ and groovin’ like I’ve never seen in a video game before. It was at that moment my love and passion for Melee began, fueled by the necessity to defeat my little brother once more. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Living in Japan the past few years has been a blast, but I definitely miss my family and friends back home. To help cope, my wife and I bought a puppers. I named him “Kitsune” (Fox) in honor of my brother’s “main” and to remind myself of the joy that competitive scenes like melee bring to my life.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"If you’re ever in the Tokyo area, give me a holler! You can find my Insta @tvd14.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcVH4NyBPiuhg1039SglTS8baasaTIzDkScs2-APkmymNkWULpSjFm9QRgYGoNFMJCbU_zUWsNmEHNOSPticHHPFnZ-aU2G7DAu522ZZy84UUeHXlamAIIf349EeGcu_Zx6lU2IyBOxCTAR_HhmFxMcbvBh?key=OGeAxqAg-W2QbNQTJVkZrg","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Not-so-grainy pic of me and the Boy","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":2},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeYx2RQ2G6v_S_9dXpc9he9vBLmQS0SDXoD3cgZ59mGbtZT8I60iqrjAN8ZJ0R9JWGzlXzcHsXFntZ9VLIQ-v2zIQ042glaavJWbvSMgAPswran6bJHnwrKnx9-oeuBNaCYl9SQAAFa4EG20Q7pBhPzN2YQ?key=OGeAxqAg-W2QbNQTJVkZrg","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Grainy Brothers”","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Competitive Scene / Achievements","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"*Currently Top 10 in Japan*","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ve always been a huge advocate of sports and exercise contributing to general well-being, which I believe in turn has also allowed me success in many aspects of my life, including Melee! I ran track and field at Grand Canyon University (NCAA Division I), where I was blessed with a scholarship to run in ovals. I set a few school records that have probably been broken by now, but no one will ever take away the multiple individual Conference Championships that I won! After college, I went on to run dummy long races, talking 100-mile races, very stupid, and even snagged a few Ws along the way. However, I switched it up once I moved to Japan and I am currently on a semi-pro basketball team, with hopes to make it as a professional here before my youth is up and I become a full-time smasher. I strongly believe these experiences have allotted me the skills necessary to perform in the clutch, including my recent game 5 win over a hung-over and sleep-deprived Skerzo. Check it out here","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XWD7hQ0OCR_t8O_3wbIT0rMC27d4F608?usp=drive_link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XWD7hQ0OCR_t8O_3wbIT0rMC27d4F608?usp=drive_link"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"(Sorry, not the most tech savy! You'll have to navigate towards the bottom to find Skerzo vs Lemon)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf2RDoTRVfqAHmOLLuVUPhC2UGP9c0rWp5OfBdlkRQ5rhUSlDuve9_o7qStnDtD3YQWGyqiJOPL9mr7fb8z7cdSN8mryG725KZcBOC6Ky0JfaxiHBk0lfl4pJzTcUEIl--OYP9QWZ_MeTuFu_pEEraSX17Q?key=OGeAxqAg-W2QbNQTJVkZrg","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I was actually at the last Don't Park back in 2018 where I had a super sweaty set vs Krizski. Everything was a blur during the final moments of the set, but the feeling of winning on DPotG’s Main Stage was euphoric and is something I will never forget. I very much wish to relive that experience again.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Feel free to fast forward to the last stock.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Pj3kNZoavCI","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Pj3kNZoavCI"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Shout-out to Stud on commentary, one of the nicest people I've ever met. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":8},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Other notable wins:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Espi","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"MegaXmas","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Stiv","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"YingLing","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":4},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Matdotzeb","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":5},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Eggs","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":6},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Decoste in the Shell (a lot. Love you David)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":7},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"NezModGod","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":8},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"NMW (He was blasted out of his mind. He then gifted me $20 in a money match after getting even more blasted)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":9},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"YetisExist (several times ;) I didn't know we were counting online stuff though)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":10},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Took a game off Amsa","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":11}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Having been home-brewed in Oregon, I’ve had the pleasure of meeting and playing countless West Coast homies throughout the years, and I resonate with the vision of building positive communities that Lil Nouns holds dear. I also very much enjoy the friendly competitiveness that they bring to the table. There’s nothing quite like the journey to a tournament to compete with incredible friends.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To me, life is all about building awesome relationships with others, and I’m positive Lil Nouns shares a similar mantra. If selected, I definitely look forward to reuniting with old friends, but I am also eager to start meaningful relationships with new, amazing people that make up the Melee community. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The scene here in Japan has been nothing but incredible. Everyone is kind and respectful, I look forward to every tournament that transpires because of how welcoming the community is. The scene here is also very diverse and we often have visitors from all over the world stop by. It’s super fun to share cultures from various parts of the globe while spending time playing the game we all love and enjoy together. So come by and visit sometime! Will gladly house any and all Smash homies. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfUeQ6ULLVkPIRbEEA_pN7xueW_MIAkLgfIbufLo0vMyckCgrqszFvH1Kcwr_1rSsxb3J4siph8uJjVhZHgnS5eEHq78TsHAxIhOE7jCW2dqJeyI3CWSESGlKPuScFOoHvnc-FcNkbsc2VbXTgBl_uAJBbm?key=OGeAxqAg-W2QbNQTJVkZrg","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Closing","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you, Lil Nouns, for such an amazing opportunity. It would truly be a blessing to return home and build on the relationships established throughout the years while simultaneously creating new connections, centered on the affinity that we all share toward Melee. Thank you for considering my proposal and especially to everyone that votes for me. I’m serious about letting you stay at my abode here in Japan, anytime (not a bribe). That’s just what we do as Smashers and is part of what makes our community so amazing.     ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"Image","src":"https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1091342993698590750/1288505769095860375/PXL_20240224_061217587.MP.jpg?ex=66f56e02&is=66f41c82&hm=772da487512bde4f5ce622877d08d9ec0297e5127962b47156f4bf1d78614966&=&format=webp&width=794&height=598","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: King_Keem - Young TO, content creator and competitor in SSBM Middle East
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, I'm a 16 year old competitor, tournament organiser (sometimes) and content creator (also sometimes) for SSBM Middle East who goes by King_Keem.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h2"},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmXJA4E2RdKULuT7TmpWUX9N1rNqDfziFtNki8ypDitoqA","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Smash journey:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I first played Sm4sh at an uncle's house when I was a young child and the entire family collectively hated it. Years later playing Smash 64 I finally understood how special moves worked - or at least more than I did before - which compelled me to get Smash Ultimate when I got my Switch. Fast forward a few years I'm sitting down on the couch and random come across what I believe was a Zain vs. Prometheus VoD. There was no commentary but Melee looked so amazing to me and so fast, so I did what any sane person would do: make my family play Ult on 2x speed and only Melee characters. Better ideas have entered my mind to say the least.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Late 2021 was when I learnt about Slippi - from a DotEsports article of all things - and actually started playing Melee with a friend who was also interested in the game. For the next 2 years I toiled away on unranked waiting up to half an hour to get into a match that would be played on 200-250 ping connections on an Xbox controller. As one can imagine, that did not pan out too well for my improvement and I only ever touched the game every once in a while.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Come July 2022, I happened to be in Australia and had still never played in a tournament. I did some looking around and it turned out an Ultimate weekly was being held in my city. So I did the thing everyone did: got way too disillusioned with visions of grandeur and glory, entered the tournament, got knocked out 0-2, got knocked out 0-2 in the redemption bracket and went home without even some wins in friendlies to my name. 2 weeklies later I actually take the first set I play with my Jigglypuff - and then proceeded to lose the next 2 sets. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"June 27, 2023. That was the date everything changed. I stumbled upon an old Weekly Weekend Melee VoD and ended up finding the Arab Smash League Discord. When I joined, right at the top of the partnered servers sat the SSBM Middle East Discord, which had a ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"lot","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" of skilled players (e.g. Outcrazy, Morhamms, Lems, Steel Rhydon, Icetea, TnR, TruToname and ABR among many others) that deserve way more recognition than they get. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The first tournament I played in was a Ph tournament called The SEA Smash Special #3 (huge shoutout to Yetis and Outcrazy). There I was knocked out of winners round 1 but due to a DQ, I was able to advance to losers semis. There I played the same man who sent me to losers, going down 0-2 in the set but pulling out a reverse sweep with a Sheik I did last minute training to use this tournament to get 3rd.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Since then, I've competed in a ton in P+ (I attended one local), I've organised a tournament series known as No Johns Allowed, ran a bracket that still hasn't finished due to the new format I was experimenting with that unfortunately didn't work out and competed in over 18 tournaments. I haven't placed outside of the top 4 since March 1st, placing 3rd twice and 2nd 3 times. I like to think I have a strong resilience and ability to perform when the pressure is higher, as I've consistently performed in the losers bracket and won 50% if not more of the runbacks against the people I lost to earlier in the bracket (starring my Sheik).","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Content:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"You can find me sometimes uploading videos to my channel ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.youtube.com/@de_keem.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/@de_keem."},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" I always try to do something better than the last video. Sometimes this makes things a little hard despite the bar set by every one of my previous videos being pretty low and not a lot of people upload satire/comedy content for Melee (while still being inoffensive and child-friendly). Trying to come up with the best idea to execute on can get me lost in my imagination. The fact I have the choice between making videos about Melee and actually playing Melee probably is a somewhat notable factor in my endless procrastination as well.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Huge thanks to my parents, SSBM Middle East, Outcrazy, Morhamms, the GOATed TOs that are Space, Nin, Viper, Hex and Yetis for being the reason I'm here now. Also a huge shoutout to the Western Australia scene for being the first scene I attended a local for. Can't forget the friends that hated on my favourite \"the trash noob game\" and indirectly pushed me to always strive to be a better player.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With that all being said, I hope you vote for me to be on the Lil Nouns Asia roster at Don't Park On The Grass and have a good one!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Sincerely, King_Keem","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Putting India on the Melee World Map
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My username is Shinmonke, I’m a 20-year-old University student from Mumbai, and I love Super Smash Brothers Melee with all my heart, body, and soul :)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Unlike many in the scene, my story with Melee doesn’t stretch back to my childhood or span many years. In fact, it was just around September last year when Melee truly piqued my interest. Before that, I’d only vaguely known about it through countless hours spent in gaming communities online. It wasn’t until I saw EmpLemon’s “Hbox” documentary in 2020 that I began to appreciate the game.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"However, it was only in 2023 that I really dove into the scene, and I owe that to the Yard podcast. Yes, I’m a Yard Kid, heralding this new generation! Listening to the podcast regularly, I started hearing about iconic players and moments, but the real turning point came when I watched a documentary by FlameIsLucky about aMsa’s monumental Big House win against Mango.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Immediately after that, I downloaded Slippi, joined the Discord and the Smash India WhatsApp group, and marked my calendar for all the upcoming majors. From that moment, I was officially in the scene as “shinmonke,” aiming to main Captain Falcon. (having played more now I have settled on Samus, Peach and Yoshi). ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The documentary made everything click for me—not just about Melee, but about esports and sports in general. These games aren’t just competitions; they’re riveting narratives that go beyond the players, leaking passion into the hearts of the spectators. From aMsa’s legendary Big House win to Hbox’s iconic EVO win against Armada and even right now as we witness the DK renaissance being ushered in by June’s historic tournament runs this year, these stories among countless others capture the highs, lows, and pure emotion that make Melee, and all sports, so captivating.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As for my career so far as a Melee player, I've got many hours on Slippi but serious high-level practice is hard to get given the lack of a scene for Nintendo, let alone Smash Bros., let alone Melee in India. Having sourced an OEM and adapter though, I've been able to play and hone my skills with some folks online (given Time-zones and Network issues, I've been restricted to parts of Asia and Australia only though), due to which I'd say as of now I possess a familiar-level mastery over the majority of the characters, since I prefer playing as a generalist rather than a main-er. I must declare also that, if I were to be selected for this tourney I will dedicate significant resources into improving as a player, to give my best and to do right by not just Nouns E-sports but my country too.   ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My dream is to see the world celebrate modern competitive Melee. Despite the plethora of challenges the scene faces, I’ll continue striving toward this ideal, driven by my love for this game and especially its community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Given the right tools and avenues I can surely prove to be a valuable contributor to not only Nouns esports but also the Melee scene at large. Representation is important, and this initiative by Nouns is truly commendable as it’ll definitely help jumpstart the Melee scene in India, and I will do whatever I can to aid and do absolute justice to this effort. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"So, I humbly request you all to consider my proposal and provide me this opportunity to journey to the Mecca of modern competitive Melee and represent my Indian brothers & sisters and begin the long process of carving out a space for India in the beautiful, fantastical and stupendously jovial world of modern competitive Melee.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Links to my socials are mentioned below:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"slippi code: SHMK#651","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Discord: title: Outcrazy- #4 Ranked and face of the Middle Eastern Melee scene
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Who am I? ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Outcrazy, and I'm originally a Libyan living in Saudi Arabia. I'm currently 4th ranked in my region, and I like to pride myself as the best Captain Falcon main to ever come out from this continent. I've been climbing the ranks for a very long time, and I'm not stoppin' anytime soon. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Learning and Growth ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I started my journey as a scrub Captain Falcon main, struggling to find my footing in the competitive scene. Through dedication and countless hours of practice, I’ve fought my way out of being your average 0-2er and transformed into a player that the whole scene can be proud of and look up to. Every single time I faced a roadblock, it only fired me up to keep improving and I haven't stopped since.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Playstyle ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I pride myself on being one of the most exciting and creative players to emerge from Asia. My approach to the game is creative and unpredictable to cut it short. I like to play fast paced melee, putting a lot of emphasis on utilizing my smooth and consistent techskill to trick or confuse my opponents in neutral or to string together devastating punishes that wouldn't have been possible otherwise.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Behind the Scenes ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Beyond competing, I’m the main guy involved in my region's Melee scene as a tournament host. I'm often referred to as the backbone of our community, and its not for no reason. In 2022, the melee scene here was completely dead until I decided to come along and get things running. My tournament series, Weekly Weekend Melee or WWM for short had over 30 iterations and was the beginning of a chain reaction which led to many other community members gaining interest in TOing which was basically the start of our self functioning scene. Besides the tournaments, I got our scene involved in many partnerships which lead to the server skyrocketing in members, as we have just recently hit 300 members! I also offer free coaching to beginners, and I interact with the community always to keep the chat fresh 24/7. The last thing of note I've done is farming clips exclusively for community montages due to the low amount of people interested.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Achievements and Highlights","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ve had the opportunity to compete with some of the top players in my region, which gives me the motivation to keep pushing my limits as much as possible. All of this has taken me higher and higher and I've only kept beating people I used to see as my absolute worst nightmares. I'm always topping the local brackets, and at my current spot, I'm definitely one of Asia's best and hopefully ill be able to represent my community abroad for the first time in our history as its very hard for any of us to play abroad due to travel budget.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community Thanks ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’m grateful for the amazing support from my friends and the melee community. Shoutouts to Yetis for all the help with TOing and activities and shoutouts to FaresJM for co-owning WWM with me. Another special thanks to Morhamms357 for helping me write this, and a final thanks to SteelRhydon and especially Lems for giving me advice and coaching me to the spot I'm at today.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"(Ily TnR)","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Combo Video: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://youtu.be/_8E41mgVsA4?si=ams5BAbn34dzFG2z","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://youtu.be/_8E41mgVsA4?si=ams5BAbn34dzFG2z"},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmTdM9xMJNjXLtL8fmHtjuETNb8tcdLvBNnZ4PcUe8rWiZ","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello, ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am MarxistxAthena, a Smash Melee Jigglypuff player who got back into Melee in late 2022 after taking a break from it in January of 2021, which happened one year after my journey with Melee began when I was a Marth main. When I came back to play in 2022, I became a Jigglypuff main, and since then, I have made numerous accomplishments online and offline. Competing in Smash Melee and getting to know the people in the community means a lot to me as it helped me improve on the things I needed to work on, such as self-confidence, which competing in Melee was a big help in and through the offline tourneys I have entered, which are Collision, Creed 3, and Supernova, I have made valuable friendships I otherwise would not have made if not for being part of the community. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"At Supernova this past weekend, from August 8th to the 11th, I managed to place above my seed of 100 by about 35, making it to 65th out of 905, and took an upset off an MDVA Sheik named Egg, who is ranked number 8 in the most recent MDVA rankings. At Matcha Cup: Combined Coasts on June 25th, 2024, I placed 7th out of 90 at the tournament, placing above my seed of 20 and winning against the player Gahtzu, who was ranked 50 in the Smash Melee 2023 rankings. At Matcha Cup: East Coast on June 6th, 2024, I managed a placement of 9th out of 113, with a win on Wevans, a top 100 player in 2023 who was ranked 86. I won Waddle Wednesday 137, beating players like JChu twice in winner's finals, set 2 of grand finals, and beat Salt's Donkey Kong 3-1 in winners semis. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I would be a great representative for Nouns because I am a Melee player, with potential achieve better results and more wins on top players in offline tourneys when given the opportunity and chance to be sponsored by Nouns Esports. This opportunity would make me more involved in the offline Melee scene, especially with majors such as Riptide and Genesis, where I could prove the improvements I have made as a player and the skills I have now and in the future in my Melee career. title: the 24 tree ace
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://drive.google.com/file/d/1obXK4mr1yTVS7ruAWba__6k6D5b_ORgs/view?usp=sharing","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://drive.google.com/file/d/1obXK4mr1yTVS7ruAWba__6k6D5b_ORgs/view?usp=sharing"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Planting 24 trees can have a significant impact on both the environment and the local community. Trees play a crucial role in the ecosystem by absorbing carbon dioxide, a major greenhouse gas, and releasing oxygen. On average, a single mature tree can absorb up to 48 pounds of carbon dioxide per year. Over the years, 24 trees can collectively offset hundreds of pounds of carbon emissions, making a notable contribution to mitigating climate change. This is especially meaningful in urban areas where pollution levels are higher, and trees can help improve air quality by filtering out pollutants like ozone and sulfur dioxide.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Moreover, trees provide critical habitats for wildlife. In a city or suburban setting, planting 24 trees could create a mini-ecosystem that supports birds, insects, and other small animals. These trees can help foster biodiversity, which is essential for maintaining healthy and resilient ecosystems.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Beyond environmental benefits, trees also have positive social and economic effects. They can increase property values by up to 15%, as areas with more greenery tend to be more desirable places to live. In urban environments, trees reduce the urban heat island effect by providing shade and cooling the air through evapotranspiration. This can lower energy costs by reducing the need for air conditioning, especially in hotter climates. Trees also have a psychological impact, promoting well-being and reducing stress levels for people who live and work in green spaces.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Planting 24 trees, therefore, is a small but powerful step toward fostering environmental sustainability, enhancing biodiversity, improving public health, and boosting the economic and aesthetic value of the community. Even such a modest number of trees can ripple outwards, creating long-lasting and far-reaching benefits.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Joshman 4 Nounsvitational!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey everyone, I’m Joshman, currently ranked #11 in the world for Melee and Australia's #1 Player. The second half of this year has been a wild ride for me, with some of the best performances of my season so far: 5th place at Supernova 2024, 7th place at Wavelength and 1st place at The Function 4 (King of New York btw!!!!) ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"These results have pushed me closer to my goal of breaking into the top 10, and I’m more motivated than ever to prove myself. The Nounsvitational represents a rare and incredible opportunity to compete against the best of the best, and is the last high calibur event I would be attending this year in melee. Getting the chance to join this stacked roster would be the perfect way to close out my season and cement my place for this year. Let’s make it happen—vote Joshman for the Nounsvitational! content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, this is Nicki. This has been an unbelievable year of Melee for me, attending my first ever majors using a new character and then beating the SSBMRank2023 #1, #2, and #3 players at the same tournament in order to place 3rd at Don't Park on the Grass 2024. I started the year wanting to be ranked in the top 50, and I'm ending the year knowing that I could win a supermajor - which is a dream of mine that I want to pursue with your help.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I love talking about the game and use my Youtube channel (SSBM Nicki) to get my thoughts out. And next year, I have the opportunity to fulfill a dream of mine that I never thought would be achievable for me, using a character I thought I could never get good with. I appreciate any vote going my way, within just one year of playing against top players more often I managed to make it this far. Help me take that final step, I know I can do it. Thank you :)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

This will allow me to engage more deeply in discussions and proposals, helping to bridge the gap between Nouns and the Smash community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Creating and Engaging on Warpcast: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I will create a Warpcast account to actively participate in the Farcaster protocol and engage directly with the Nouns community. Warpcast is an innovative decentralized social network that reflects the same grassroots values I see in both Nouns and the Melee scene. By sharing updates, insights, and content on Warpcast, I can connect with the community in a meaningful way, spread awareness of Nouns’ initiatives, and introduce Smash players to this exciting platform.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Content Creation and Tournament Coverage: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ll produce engaging, high-quality content that showcases my journey, the tournaments I attend, and Nouns’ role in supporting grassroots communities. From skits to behind-the-scenes footage, this content will be shared on platforms like Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, and Warpcast to maximize visibility.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns-Branded Representation: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ll proudly represent Nouns by featuring their branding on my tournament jerseys, stream overlays, and social media. Additionally, I’m eager to collaborate with the community on creative ways to bring the Nouns aesthetic into my content, helping both brands stand out.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":4},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Elevating Doubles Tournaments: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I will prioritize competing in doubles tournaments at major events, teaming with high-level players like Nouns’ own sponsored Melee player, Aklo, to promote this underappreciated format. Doubles matches are a unique opportunity to showcase teamwork and generate excitement for Nouns at events.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":5},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community Coaching and Engagement: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ll host exclusive coaching sessions for Nouns/Lil Nouns holders. These sessions will help engage the community while building connections between Nouns and the wider Melee audience.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":6}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmb3YQibfpgcQZRHZPGnLz9ZH8VqRuP2pDAwULUb7kpqzn","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h4"},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"WHY YOUR VOTE MATTERS:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Your vote will help me reach tournaments, compete on an international stage and pursue my goal to be ranked within the annual top 100 SSBMRank. I hope to showcase the improvements I've made and the hard work it took for me to get there, whilst also representing my country, character and hopefully, team.Without Nouns’ support in 2025, I will not be financially able to attend all of the wonderful major events the Smash community hosts and pursue my greatest passion. Your support means everything to me and I look forward to a great year in melee as we strive to continue to make the Smash community an inclusive and welcoming place for all. Thank you for taking the time to read my proposal. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Maher","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Stipend Request
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello, I'm j3nni!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm a 23 year old Counter-Strike 2 player playing with Intelligence Gaming. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why put all of this money down anyways? title: Neeks For Launders LAN
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello everyone, My name is Nick but I go by Neeks online! I'm 25 years old and currently reside in Washington state. I started playing video games at a young age when my father let me try out a game he was playing called quake 3, and from that moment I fell in love with gaming. In 2014 one of my first ever online friends purchased me cs:go so we could play together and that really birthed my passion for competing and being the best player that I can be. 10 years later, I've had the opportunity to travel to 3 separate LAN events where I got to compete alongside a few of my best friends; as well as attending many events as a spectator. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For me the funds will be used primarily on getting my flight to and from the event since things are getting pricier the closer we get to the holidays, as well as towards my lodging for the duration that I am there; and anything that may happen to be left over from the fund would go towards food for the weekend! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To me the importance of LAN isn't just the opportunity to get to play in person with my teammates in a highly competitive environment, but more than anything it's about making memories with them and getting to spend time with people I usually only get to while on my computer. I've been playing with this group of guys for 2 seasons of ESEA now and have formed a really special connection with them, so getting to feel their energy in person would be an absolutely amazing experience on top of meeting them all for the first time. On top of that, just getting to put a face to the names of people I've had the chance to play both with, and against; or just those that I have had the chance to meet through this love we share for the game called Counter-Strike is such a nice feeling.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"You can find me on twitter @neekscs where I yap about cs ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you all for reading <3 ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Neeks","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: launders lan IRL stream by craazy?
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey gang.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Craazy, I'm an amateur streamer and new level 10 on FACEIT (2050 elo) and I was going to be a participant of Launders LAN until my IRL friend team crumbled down due to IRL reasons and lack of good teammates.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm still very excited about this event and would love to show up. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Not too many ideas yet but certainly some interviews of spectators and players, maybe some quizzes and small prizes. LANs mean the world to me and I have never been able to attend a proper LAN...","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'll be showing up with a friend or two who will help me with the IRL stream and being camera-man, etc...
