title: A Little Trash Journey: "Payton Goes International?"
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello! My name is Payton, though some may recognize me as LTP or Lil Trash Panda. While I’m still relatively new to the Counter-Strike and Esports community, I am incredibly eager to find my place within this amazing family that has welcomed me so warmly. After celebrating my graduation at ESL Challenger Atlanta 2023, I’m proud to say that my passion for production and events led me to stage manage ESL Impact S5 in Dallas. That experience tested my limits, and just recently, I had the opportunity to further sharpen my skills at Fragadelphia 18. I found myself in a position where I was happy to tackle the challenges put in front of me and to make a difference in the quality of people's experiences. Now, I’m ready to dive headfirst into more North American Counter-Strike opportunities.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Attending Launders LAN is a chance for me to witness firsthand how a fully produced tournament is managed. As someone who dreams of becoming a Production or Product Manager, I know it’s crucial to explore as many homegrown LANs as possible. Above all, I consider myself a manager of people, always ensuring that all parties find common ground and come to a positive resolution. I’m excited to observe this year’s Launders LAN, both as a spectator and an engaged learner, to see how challenges are handled and where improvements can be made to enhance the experience for everyone, especially the fans.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For me, attending Launders LAN is not just about the event itself, but about the opportunity to travel internationally and showcase my ability to contribute to any event, regardless of my role. As a Georgia resident who has never traveled abroad, this opportunity would also help me cover the cost of my plane ticket and further demonstrate my commitment to pursuing a career in the Esports and Counter-Strike scene. I am deeply passionate about the North American Counter-Strike community, and I believe that by being involved, I can help foster its revival.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While I will be traveling solo, I look forward to meeting up with a few friendly faces, and I plan to assist them in any way I can or help others in need. I am extremely grateful to these friends for the invitation, and to Nouns and Launders LAN for creating opportunities like this for those of us who are currently unable to cover travel costs on our own. This is an experience I will cherish, and I can’t wait to contribute in whatever way possible to help make Launders LAN a success.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: STEEL: Far Away From Home
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi Everyone!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Josh aka steel online and I have been competing in FPS games, notably Counter-Strike and Valorant, for the better part of 16 years. My gaming career started online from my home in the Greater Toronto Area until life/games took me around the world and now I'm living in Arizona, USA, far away from home. I've played at multiple local Toronto events through the years but I have not had the opportunity to spec/compete/visit Launders LAN yet despite being a huge fan of the big man himself.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"By winning this travel stipend, not only will I be able to see my family and friends, but I will be able to also see my CS family and friends. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I would travel to compete with my new team/teammates but without assistance, not all of them would be able to make it, so I'd have to come in the capacity as a spectator/content creator/last minute substitute for another team, or hijack the main broadcast!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Normally I would not have an issue buying myself a flight but now with Canada being tariffed 100%, the airline prices are getting a little whack. Also, I generally fly United which has a large amount of Boeing 737-800 MAX planes in their fleet, and we all know what happened with those recently which also increased the cost of these flights. As a result of recent geopolitical changes, traveling to Launders LAN seemed more and more out of the question for me, which made me a sad panda, but now with Nouns offering this amazing opportunity, maybe my dream can actually come true!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: calamity: Skill Exploration
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello Nouns community!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Stanley. \"calamity\" is my in-game alias.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm a Counter-Strike 2 player whose currently competing in the FaceIt Pro League ladder for a permanent spot at the end of March 2025. I have minimal experience in tier 2 level official matches/pick-up games. Launders LAN will be the event to test, expand, and improve skillsets to succeed against opponents higher than myself and assist future official teammates.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I will be flying from Vancouver, BC to attend Launders LAN 2 with a mix team in the tournament and reunite with my past teammate JvXt. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Funds from this stipend will go towards flight fare, portions of accommodations, and event entry fee. Winning the travel stipend ensures the journey be stress-free for myself and teammates.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"At Nouns + Launders LAN, if our matches get streamed, to our best ability, we will ensure these matches will be entertaining for the audience and casters.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Since winning my first minor local LAN at 17 years old, attending LANs, obtaining competitive attributes, diversifying skillsets from tough experiences, and connecting with hungry players has been a pleasure to partake in. As the level of competition intensifies, these reasons are prominent in every LAN event/tournaments.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Every ounce of assistance whether it's in votes or word of mouth will be much appreciated. ❤️","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Stanley \"calamity\" Chiu","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Not-so-local Caster ynoT Travel Support
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey everyone, for those of you who aren't familiar with me my name is Anthony \"ynoT\" Vitale. I'm an aspiring CS2 talent who's been working in the scene for the better part of 4 years now and have attended many US-based events in that time frame primarily on my dime, including the most recent installment of launders LAN.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'd be lying if I said it was easy to come up with the money to afford getting out to some of these events but still, the passion for the game and for bringing people the most enjoyable experiences possible on a personal and professional level is something I've not yet given up on. I intend on using the money given from a proposal like this to make up for my already existing travel fees and take some stress off my shoulders financially post-graduation this semester to enjoy the event and give it my all for spectators, the players, the staff, as well as for myself at the end of the day.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Having gotten the opportunity to attend the last event as a commentator I've hungered for the same chance to showcase myself and what I'm capable of again and want to be at 100% of my abilities without pressure and would be greatly appreciative of an incentive like this helping out. Counter-Strike has been my life for the last 7 years and I will continue to fight for my spot at the top until I can't anymore, so the chance LL1 and now LL2 have given me I want to use as efficiently as I can.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Nouns brand is one I've respected ever since its foundation for the main reason that it allows people to choose what they believe is right and have a voice in their esport through the lenses, pun intended, of Nouns themselves. I'd greatly appreciate that sort of community power coming through for me at this point and hope that whoever gets the rewards uses it well and I can't wait to see everyone at the event. Cheers!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Cover Image Photo Credit: @Atheen_Art","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Tawa: LOCAL CREATOR CAPTURING LOCAL STORIES
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, my name is Alexander Tawa and I am a photographer and videographer from Montreal. I’ve been playing Counter-Strike for over 10 years and making videos about it for just as long. As I’ve explored my love for competitive CS by both playing and watching it, I have always found one thing to be the most striking and interesting; the stories. Without the stories, what do our favourite moments mean? The unthinkable comebacks, the craziest clutches, the least and most likely of championships, none of them mean anything without a greater context. I’ve discovered over the years that part of experiencing competitive Counter-Strike can be helping to tell those stories myself. I recently worked in Kansas City at Fragadelphia 18 taking photos and shooting video and I want to do the same at an event closer to me. Seeing as I am in the beginnings of my career as a creative, having the costs covered for my transportation and other accommodations will help me afford the trip so that I can tell the stories I love in the best way I can with as little stress as possible.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I hope that I can integrate with those working the event to document as much as I can. Whether it be the setup, the tournament itself, or the aftermath, all of those stories are worth telling because without them, the competitions don’t happen in the first place. Gaining work experience and witnessing the ins and outs of various LANs will help me in being able to tell more and more stories from those who deserve it, those that form the foundation of our competitive scene. My work is for everyone, it is my passion to take photos and create compelling visuals but only because sharing them helps others understand why Counter-Strike and competition are both so amazing.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To me, LANs are about connecting as much as they’re about winning. We could play in person tournaments in cold, tight venues with no room simply for the sake of the matches having no ping, but instead we play them with crowds, we stand behind the players, and we hang out for the sake of Counter-Strike. Sharing that love for the game is why LAN is so electric, and I hope to stay with some friends I’ve made along the way at other LANs who share that love. I want to help others form the most vivid of core memories at this event by capturing it both in photo and video.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Below are links to both of my Fragadelphia photo albums, one from Kansas City at Frag 18 and the other at Fragicago 2023:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.flickr.com/photos/tawawawa/albums/72177720322488967/","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.flickr.com/photos/tawawawa/albums/72177720322488967/"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.flickr.com/photos/tawawawa/albums/72177720313379023/","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.flickr.com/photos/tawawawa/albums/72177720313379023/"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for the opportunity! I hope to see you soon.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Help the preservation of esports history
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello my name is Meg, I am based out of North Carolina and I have been a freelance esports photographer for the past two years. Esports and photography have been my two lifelong passions and the opportunity to combine the both has been a dream come true. History is another passion of mine and I have made it my mission to document events through my lens. There are untold events lost to the history of time due to the difficulties in capturing them. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I have cut my teeth in capturing the halo majors and as someone who has followed the rich history that scene has, I want to do it the justice it deserves. I have recently covered Fragadelphia 18 and it was quite meaningful to make sure it was properly captured. Grassroot LANs are the foundation of esports and give people the jump start they need to progress in their esport careers. By getting the funds needed to cover travel I will ensure that Launders LAN gets the coverage it deserves.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Broke guy trying to see my favorite racist <3
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’m a 23 year old guy who lives in North Carolina, USA. The funds will be used exclusively to travel to Toronto as I’m extremely tight on cash.  The furtherest I’ve ever been from North Carolina was New York, so visiting Canada would be a lifelong memory for myself. In terms of integrating Nouns and Launders into my trip it be supporting the roots of the scene. Nouns CS2 roster was one of the few to actually have an American flag and in doing so trying to bring back NA CS. And we know how Launders feel about those national teams. So brand integration with Launders and Nouns comes naturally at Launders LAN 2. Going to Launders LAN 2 would be a lifelong memory for the trip but to also be able to experience my first true lan competition. In terms of LAN Cs events I’ve been to 2017 Atlanta Elague, 2019/23 Dreamhack Atlanta, and 2023 ESL Dallas. I’ve been blessed to go to these events with the best players in the world but going to an old school lan is something I’ve been missing and would love to check off my bucket list. In terms of travel it would be just my girlfriend and I. I’m a lifelong solo q so hopefully the lan would also allow me to connect to other like minded individuals to grind cs with. The experience is something I’ll remember forever and I’m sure Launders will make it all back after I buy all the Boxr merch there. Thank you for thanking the time to read my proposal! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Help bring TXH Esports Melee to Toronto
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello Nouns Community and Launders LAN fans! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Keenan “Slakks” Flamand and I am the co-owner and founder of TXH Esports, a collective esports organization from Winnipeg, MB Canada. I have been in the gaming sphere for quite some time competing semi-professionally in Dota 2 and Hearthstone, but more recently turned my esports direction into building one of the largest esports organizations in Central Canada. We house players in Smash Bros Melee and Smash Ultimate, including some household names in Beezy (SK)  and Silver (AB) , alongside our strong local talent with players such as Amy <3, Fabreeze, Pompkons, K11 and Crembu - all who have travelled throughout North America, or who will be in 2025 (BOBC, GOML, etc.) We have competitive players in 4 provinces and hope to continue our success in 2025.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With the introduction of the Mang0 LAN I’d love to have the opportunity to meet other Melee competitors within the scene and use the stipend to help bring a member of our roster over to Toronto. Having some help with travel would be our specific use for this stipend to help alleviate the always grueling cost of travel even when only traveling a province away.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I have attended LAN events for a long time (BaseLAN for those outside of Manitoba) but consistently attend Smash and FGC monthlies to help support our local scene and grow a community here at TXH, giving opportunities to dedicated competitive players a chance at attending bigger major events within Canada and the United States. LAN’s are a big part of the local scenes, and that’s how our inception of TXH Esports came to be. Launders and Mang0’s LAN would be a great place for us to branch out and meet more people and look to expand our ever growing community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"All the best to everyone, and thank you for reading! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: MattTaylorLoL: The one true Iceclimber? See you on the Pickleball Courts.
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Dear fellow Nouns Esports fans, contributors, friends,","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am here today to beg for your vote to represent Nouns Esports at Genesis.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I began my smash journey during EVO 2014. I played in my Melee locals that entire year before volunteering to run their stream and help host. I learned to Wave Dash on Chillin’s stream. I interviewed Swedish Delight at Nebulous in NYC, and began my career as a commentator. I came in 3rd place, taking games off Salt and Junebug at the Nounsvitational: Lil Noun’s Pro-Am Doubles tournament (as the amateur ofcourse). I've had a strong love for the Melee scene, but a trip to Genesis has always been just a bit out of my price range.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I joined the Nouns Esports Discord in late 2023 as a volunteer, and was eventually awarded the role of Contributor thanks to attending weekly contributor calls, and volunteering where I could for the org, assisting others with their props, and some work in my home town of NYC:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hosted Nouns Dota Bootcamp @ NYC's Crypto Hub, Station3","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Teamed up with Nouns and Community Gaming for NFT NYC Activation","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Took a stock off Aklo at the Nouns FGC Challenge","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Coordinated photographer/photo shoot for Aklo a-nouns-ment.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" As our Nounish Pickleball ambassador I swear to tire out Aklo’s competition on the pickleball courts; representing Nouns thanks to Flows.Wtf. I can run a free clinic for Nouns Esports fans in the nearby area thanks to a pop-up net and pickleball paddles I bring with me everywhere.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Ill be honest, I'll likely go 0-4 in Melee pools. My Icies aren't what they used to be. However I'll train every day, and stream all of it. I'll wear clip on mics, and record footage of my matches. Once I'm eliminated I can also compete in Street Fighter Third Strike, and SSB64 to take me out of my 10 year retirement.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" I'll use my sick interview skills, and journalism position at CryptoWeekly to post articles and coverage to the Web3 community. Most importantly, please let me go to watch Aklo win Genesis. This is his year, and I'm his biggest fan.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Finally, I work in the Education space, and can run activties for local middle + high school students to learn STEM skills and the business of Esports. Social Impact!!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Please gamers I beg of you 👉🏻👈🏻","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With Love,","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Matt Taylor LoL","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUqRo6AM9SLUv4BrGkcRUuD5r2rMvxArr6wWURGLcMCyB","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: bekvin goes to genesis maybe if y'all are chill with that
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"hey there the farthest west i've been is ohio which is kinda embarrassing and genesis is the Big One of all tournaments so it'd be neat to go to Cali.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Been theorizing this one combo for awhile, so if you put nana on side plat of yoshis and stand under her she'll stay on the platform. So I want to intercept a recovery with popo, upthrow to nana, make her grab, and then find a follow up or two to death. Have had an opening or two where she gets the grab but if she doesn't pummel at least once it's incredibly difficult to get any sort of followup. Especially if she's facing towards ledge, because she's on the right side of the platform that forces her to back throw which is way harder to follow up on.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Anyways, vote for me I do a lot of silly options and play tournament sets like it's a friday night with the homies","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

I've been a part of the competitive Smash Bros scene for over 17 years - serving roles as a broadcaster, content creator, commentator, pro player, and general staff at more majors you can possible imagine. Have me send the shots to someone else to post or I'd be more than glad to handle social media for the weekend, and even provide an edited video of everything following the event.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmQyHvKP2DU8Co5s4WgVDEyAHugKnZoV5DSqNUGCUrd7VL","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Still want some competitive action you can post about to get eyes on? I got 3rd at Genesis X and anticipate competing again - hopefully this time under the Nouns banner 👏 (told you I'll get top 8 😋)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcbnkBWzPQg7kUrHZLHD5KXLJ35zDZiPmh3wEHiQbSeFB","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Not only have I competed in Smash for over 17 years, but I'm competed in EVERY Smash title and many platform fighters during this time, to a very high skill. Apart from being globally ranked ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Top 10 in Brawl","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", I've ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"beaten Top 100 Melee players","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"tristate region ranked in Smash 4","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"state ranked in Ultimate","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Top ~100 in Project+","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", an alpha tester of Rivals 1, and much more! Especially if Nouns is ever looking to expand into other games, I'm an excellent talent scout and can report back and get a pulse on the upcoming year of competition at Genesis for everyone at Nouns.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"And last but not least - I have a degree and background in Computer Science so if you want someone additionally understands the world and technology behind crypto, I'm the perfect fit as someone who used to manage web servers as a living and understand the technology we promote.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Get loadspiller Bowser into genesis
content:
{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi guys. I think I want your votes 🤔😈 

Choosing this option is good in that it would reflect a full representation of Melee's vibrant cast--For there to be a Bowser good enough to beat very skilled players in attendance at this year's Genesis. If you want that outcome, then vote! 

Personally I think it would be fun...

I am always excited to get to know my friends better, and to meet new faces  ^_°

My friend Kenny who drives me around like to say he has "infected" a tournament with Bowser. It's kind of true that it's something you'd rather not deal with as a competitor... Any unfamiliarity can be very dangerous, not to mention annoying.

If I go to genesis I'll take it very seriously. Will train hard with professional players and coaches and stream the process. Learn the intricacies of my weaker matchups, and land that finishing blow for an exciting and thrilling tournament run! You can be there every step of the way. I think I have a group I would be going with. 


Winning this contest drastically increases the odds of my attending this year's Genesis. If I don't win I'll try to maybe do some fundraising. The longer I play, the more of an effort I'll be making to 'turn up' at these larger events. For the fans ya know?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I improved my play a lot last year and will be ranked in the Top 15 of Europe, improving my rank from 2023 by at least 5 spots.I would be incredibly grateful to get the chance to represent Nouns, Europe, Germany and my loyal friends in the community who are also my best friends.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Outside of competition I am a very active member of the community, TO-ing the biggest german invitational last year, worked on the EU and German PR for 2 years as a panelist member in a row, created this ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Power Ranking graphic","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/German_Melee/status/1817636019539210311"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", did multiple trailers, including the one for the biggest German tournament of all time “","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"SAPF","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/German_Melee/status/1754145978318258511/video/1"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"” and much more. My second passion among melee are video essays, and I will create one this year about melee, hopefully with footage of Genesis X2 :)","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why YOU?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This is your chance to vote for Europe, potential, flashiness, fun, the community and an underdog. Despite my decent results I am still quite under the radar which I wish to change at Genesis. I will train very hard especially mentally, to not only fulfill, but surpass the expectations. Moreover, there will be rewards for voting for me. The exact rewards will be posted to my twitter, but i would like to give you a sneak peak:1.Controller raffle","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"2.VOD analysis","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"3. Coaching","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"4. Content/Video creation","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"and much more.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why NOUNS?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns has slowly but surely become one of the best organizations for smash last year, with the highlight of the Nounsvitiational 2024. However, I also really like that the organization has so many different active sectors, and on top are working for a better environment. Especially the almost finished Ugandan primary school is a project to be incredibly proud of. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I would be super happy to compete under the banner of an organization that is trying very hard to improve things for the better, on a small scale as helping an individual compete in a children's video game, to a big scale in helping the world become a better place. Please help me compete.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Love, Lukas / astar","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdSUFYrwuMpGbVL_N-zEYaY2VofqAe0zVbxXbcOyihn1oGJd-uzoAxg2ddTkrIpPf-t1nULc13Zbco-LfqtiO9lfonFlNcTjUSdq0VK95XJ48sVgVjkwRa6lLEpc0majgmBVeHFNw?key=PwO6jNiPYw8h8iDoi3vYbwnv","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

My name is Joshua, but you can just call me \"jd\" or \"","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"jdhcdabo","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"i\"! With these skills, I have become the ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"number 1 Melee player in my home country of Jamaica","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"! content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For those who don't know me, my name is Alex \"Shab\" Parsons. title: MattTaylorLol: Nounish Pickleball Ambassador
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Dear Nouns Esports,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am excited to apply for the Let’s Play Nouns Delegate Program and the opportunity to further contribute to the Nounish ecosystem. As an active participant in Nouncil meetings every Thursday, a Flows.wtf Nounish Pickleball ambassador, and a holder of several Nouns derivatives like VRBS and Lil Nouns, I have immersed myself in what it means to live Nounish. My goal is to leverage my experiences to deepen engagement within the Nouns ecosystem while helping bridge the gap between Web3 and new communities.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Understanding of the Nouns Ecosystem","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Nouns ecosystem represents a model of decentralized governance and creative collaboration. I have loved being a part of the ecosystem as a Gnars holder, a Lil Nouns Smash tournament competitor (3rd place), and a Nouns Esports contributor since late 2023, I'm always incredibly moved by how Nouns empowers communities to collab on impactful projects. My experiences have shown me the value of inclusivity, experimentation, and thoughtful governance, principles I aim to ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"champion","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" as a delegate.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"How I Plan to Represent the Community","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Active Governance:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" I will participate in 100% of NounsDAO proposals, providing thoughtful and well-reasoned votes grounded in my diverse experiences in crypto, gaming, and education. I will sponsor props I believe in, and will write my own to continue our path forward.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Community Reporting:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Through daily updates on Warpcast, I’ll share transparent insights and engage the community in meaningful dialogue.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Amplifying IRL Activations:","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" By championing hands-on, engaging activations like Pickleball tournaments, game development workshops, and esports events, I’ll represent the values of inclusivity and innovation that Nouns embodies.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"number","start":1,"tag":"ol"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Vision for Impact","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My vision as a delegate centers on driving efficiency and creativity within the NounsDAO ecosystem. Drawing from my experience at Urban Arts, a nonprofit at the forefront of game design education for underserved youth, I’ve seen how strategic planning and impactful activations can drive real change. Similarly, I want to ensure NounsDAO proposals maximize their potential by offering my expertise to refine ideas, optimize budgets, and advocate for initiatives that onboard educators, gamers, and artists into Web3 spaces.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"IRL activations are often underutilized or misaligned, leaning heavily on passive experiences like panels and mixers.
