title: Prepare for Trouble and Make it Double (DoublA)
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Howdy everyone,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"      My name is Mike and I was the momager (mom/manager) of the Nouns Esports Dota team. And while that title is already all encompassing, I do really feel like I left a reasonable impact on this community that goes beyond that. And now I'll try to list some of my accomplishments without sounding like the musical number that Dwayne Johnson performs in Moana.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmZsgVTMq7XuMf4CfWWQPZtNN8N4rX8U7kk93UoaFVRUfm","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"        Firstly starting with Dota, I was the manager of the team for a little under two years and I really think we managed to accomplish a lot from our humble beginnings. In such a short time period, we were able to reach top 8 at the biggest esports event of the year and then the next year we managed to become a consistent threat in the scene with several top 6 finishes. We were little fish swimming amongst giants and we punched above our weight class. I’ll never forget the Bali Major; teams would send a horde of ten people to every event and the Nouns corner was just Edward, Astini, and I. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmNQAaCQYmdaYUuio7hHHaj2kDz1f9MrK6uFYznEnfEumZ","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We uhm… were very passionate. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It’s kinda hard to explain what led to such a success, but it definitely had something to do with the great people involved. For most people, work feels like a job, but for me it felt like being part of a family.  I am but one person of many that were a part of the team and its support staff, but the passion that everyone showed and the amount of effort that everyone put forth was unparalleled. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It was truly phenomenal. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" If you don’t follow Dota, that’s totally fine, you may have seen my work in many other creative forms. If you’ve had nouns chocolate, whether the original from Seattle or the secondary version at Tipped Off, that product was the baby of my love of Charlie and the Chocolate Factory and the wonderful artistic design work of our graphic designer Gatsby.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmUwCwECVrSomuBGeh1sAZuNZs61tCc5JzwWGrr17PTyxp","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"(fun fact, there was supposed to be a golden ticket included in one of the bars in Seattle to win a signed keyboard, like the keyboard was signed, and the golden ticket slip was written out, but we never got around to putting the plan into action and the winning chocolate bar stayed in my coat pocket until the bar melted from my body heat; a bit gross and sticky)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"If you were one of the lucky few to pick up our version of the iconic nirvana band tee or the electronic sports department shirt, I also had a hand in it. Countless calls with Gatsby about how we should take a gallery department shirt and make our own version or spamming him with loads of Soccer Jerseys to influence our own Adidas ones, I'm certain I caused him many headaches, sorry,sorry.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" The most creative project I worked on was definitely nouns.trout . From sourcing the fish locally in Denmark to working with the printing company to not break EU food regulations to making that corny commercial with Gorgc, this undertaking was a wild one. Picking the cans up from the docks in Copenhagen was such a surreal experience: I work in esports, why am I by the ocean at 6am loading boxes into my bicycle?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmdktCu5VEJuFRr1UtnavTRJ1bJ5poe2zB3ZQ9tJtD5mvq","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To address the more crypto native individuals, some of you may know me from back when I used to host more of the contributor calls. Even though they went off the rails very often, I still think they were a much cooler alternative to the norm (lol). I’ve been to a couple nouncil calls and I’ve had the pleasure of interacting with several members of the greater nouns community, so I definitely wouldn’t be a novice in the ecosystem. I’ll throw in the last photo from EthDenver to really flex the web3 lore. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmbpNj2HVQgNzdDTkpSFFyBKjvMqAzEQiSjzzpaPCB6HEZ","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"(Also if I do win, I plan to align my votes with the Nouns Deli guys, kidding kidding Peter)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks everyone for reading,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"DoublA ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: KREWE - A Melee Mardi Gras Ball
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey everyone, my name is Jack Mulkerne, aka skrat, and I'm a Melee Organizer here in Alabama! Myself and my co-TO Patrick Turner, aka burner, are hosting our first independent regional event in our hometown of Mobile, Alabama. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"About the Event:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Krewe is a 1 day Super Smash Bros Melee event in the heart of Downtown Mobile during the Mardi Gras Season! This event is an opportunity for us to share our love for the rich history of our city while hosting a Melee event featuring some of the Southeast's top talent! During the event there will be multiple parades, live music, food stalls, and more happening right outside the doors of our venue, The Social Experiment, which also doubles as a coffee shop and speakeasy! This location allows for attendees to interact directly with the festivities outside and lets passerby's and shop customers interact with the game we share a love for.  ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmePVM63q2LvpJ7xJth5QEzVPRaHX6ZtsppuL7Y2anYAFG","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmerEjtPXoZaoeotiiRvEmo9sn5J897bbigj6F4tackP5W","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our Proposal: ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While this is our first iteration of the event, myself and Patrick have the experience and know-how to make this event run seamlessly, with multiple monthlies, regionals, and a summit-style event under our belts. At the time of writing we are currently estimating ~100 entrants for Melee singles and ~40 teams for doubles. This event will be the largest Melee tournament we've had in Mobile! We currently have players attending from Alabama, Florida, Mississippi, Georgia, Tennessee, and Louisiana, and some big names such as:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"MOF","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Jsalt ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"POG Epic Gamer ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Rooster ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"and Signify signed up.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With our event and the multiple traditions of Mardi Gras we see plenty of branding and promotional opportunities with Nouns for our event! The most obvious being Noggles designed like a masquerade mask to match the theming of a Mardi Gras ball (or purple, gold, and green normal ones if that's not possible), Nouns-themed beads and other throwables, as well as traditional promotions on our social medias and livestream! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In the 1st and 2nd place tiers we would be able to implement physical branding opportunities (custom beads, etc.) as well as full branding on our livestream including logo placement, commentary shout outs, and social media shout outs.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In the 3rd or 4th place tiers, while we wouldn't be able to implement the physical branding, all other promotion would still be a part of our event. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We look forward to the possibility of working with Nouns to help take our event to the next level and introduce the Melee community to our local community and traditions. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Check out our event at ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://start.gg/KREWE","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://start.gg/KREWE"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" !","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmb5WtvWWjg6nTg3bULVgHF19ppDYUVKzc96ckVfak32K6","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: The Louder Nouner
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmarWX54K3wmfLK3dis9Z6y6iDxUVCaoBQJ8jJiZ6KG24a","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello, I'm Brian \"Floofys\" and I'm a software developer, gamer, and play-by-play shoutcaster! Hailing from Chicago, I participate mostly online, but I've spent the last couple of years venturing outside of my home to meet my fellow gamers. In that time, I have attended Dreamhack Dallas, and casted in person for Fragicago 2023/2024, as well as Fragadelphia 18. While casting and competition has been somewhat new to me, I have followed esports since Season 2 of League of Legends, and have been a lifelong gamer since the original Doom on DOS. Beyond that, I've spent the past 13 years in the professional software development space, learning new technology and pushing myself to grow and evolve.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmRHoNdc13kpE8ai7pgzdHGPcN7WR2yfFoVr67VXAfn7mT","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While I'm a late adopter to the Nouns ecosystem, I have been enjoying the opportunity to meet and work with everyone through weekly esports contributor and Nouncil calls, participating in rounds votes, and contributing to propositions. I've also thoroughly enjoyed casting for Nouns through all of 2024. Starting with casting regular league games for the Nouns Counter-Strike team, to being invited to cast both David's Cup and the Hol1day Cash Cup. I have also joined flows.wtf and have been learning as much as I can about the Nouns ecosystem to help drive engagement from within the esports landscape.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcaebEKjv1Ac2SvHdXUYGNDmLyY3AxhhRNUPaW1aN2zCk","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The ability to delegate a Noun vote will improve my ability to bridge the gap between the connections I'm making in esports and the non-esports side of Nouns. I'll be able to give a voice to my esports connections within the DAO. I'll also be a better representative for the Nouns organization on live streams, as well as at events. I'm also hoping to expand my horizions beyond my one game, and mingle with the other gaming communmities that Nouns plays host to.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmadmjGgvxv35AWCKTcy23vzdU5ZxaMFKWmzthf63UCdD5","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmZNgtJboqK62gDWEZMydsJGAFB548JFPxaHmowtEwRRwr","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm already posting often on Warpcast, sharing information about streams, team results, as well as updates from my own journey. As a delegate, I'll continue to represent Nouns on social media - opening up the window to let everyone get a clear picture of everything going on. I'll continue to be a positive contributor within Nouns calls, whether they're esports team contributor calls, DAO calls, or events out in the real world!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmQ5q2YCXtNqWKWmadxnEq7JETXxiRY62LgkjpvurYu6mT","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A vote for Floofys is a vote for esports! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks for reading my proposal, and I hope I convinced you that I'll be a good delegate!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Brian \"Floofys\"","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmfV9vzjsDbypsC8WiXw6QTLGziZpdqSuHXzkqJtpQUapr","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Starting Tori ⌐◨-◨
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello Nouns Esports and fellow competitors <( •̀ᴖ•́)>","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am Tori from Nouns fe. Gnars and Trippy dino lover here to ask for your votes. Being with Nouns for the past year has been a dream come true, I can already see little me kicking her feet over the fact that I am playing professional Counter Strike. It has been a wild ride this last year with Nouns also being my introduction into Web3.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Getting involved has been a blast as I am now a proud Gnars holder (#6566) as well as Based Dao Holder (#440 thank you Goyabean!). Our team is also lucky enough to be delegated two Nouns (nounslunari.eth) to use for our team governance within Nouns! Throughout the year I have taken pride in voting with reason. Just checking out everything going on in Nouns and being able to provide feedback to projects has such a personal touch to it that I have constantly thought about how to get more involved with voting. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Being delegated my very own Noun would mean the world to me as it lets me get more involved in governance on my own. Being fortunate enough to vote with team delegated nouns is amazing, however it means that we are a majority vote that is all then sourced to one person to put our vote in. Lunari has been amazing and actively participated putting our votes in. However very much like my cs playstyle (lurker) I like to do things on my own and want to participate in governance without having to ask my teammates.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmZXbGYrHwHhkEWKY8J3sB2kP8RAG81QVtVFjir64cMK17","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Now for what I plan to do with my very own delegated Noun. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" -IRL Activation: As a Gnar holder I feel that I must learn to shred (skate for all you non-lingo knowers). Unfortunately I have the balance of a baby on ice. I will be learning from scratch how to skate to be apart of my feller Gnars Holders and hopefully be able to attend a live action sport event (I WILL NOT BE COMPETING)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"That is not all though. I am a professional Counter Strike player at the end of the day, Nouns will be following me through my journey as my team plans to attend lan events quarterly this year. The Noggles joy will be spread starting with 500 paper ⌐◨-◨ to be passed out at Fragadelphia x LVLUPEXPO Las Vegas 2025. We will be catching the hearts of our fans while dominating on stage in our Nouns Attire (I will wear as many glasses as legally allowed). Through every lan event, noggles will be spread to every open pair of eyes in sight.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmaG2WVaqwtxGTh9sYsvVpTMRzVDbNRHtDeUykaZEppDVi","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Governance: If 66% wasn't enough for my 9th grade English teacher then it ain't enough for me. My vote with reason rate will remain at a B- (80%) or higher while I hold my delegated Noun near and dear to my heart.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-Community: I have loved being able to show up to a big group meeting every Friday to report for my team on what we have been up to. I promise to keep maintaining this as I grow my own personal brand on warpcast and becoming a top competitor in Counter Strike. My journey to skate will also be posted on warpcast exclusively.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you so much for reading this far, I hope you have an amazing day/week/month/year, Spread Love!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"nounstori.eth <3 (Photos from @Atheen_art and @JD_fps on X) ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: OtterFodder Pushes the Boulder!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello Nouns GG peeps, my handle is OtterFodder online, my name is Kyle, and the last few months have been a whirlwind of excitement and new experiences for me. After watching Super Smash Brothers Melee for years, the DK renaissance and Junebug’s electric performances finally inspired me to pick up the controller in October 2024 and start grinding. Little did I know that this would start to quickly snowball!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Shortly after, thanks to Junebug and others rocking the Nouns sponsorships, I discovered Nouns. My initial reaction to learning it was ‘crypto’ related was that of leeriness due to seeing instances of celebrity endorsed crypto scams in the news and my own thoughts that crypto missed the mark of decentralizing currency by treating it like another stock. Luckily, I let myself be curious and poured into the resources that Nouns.gg provided.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Lo and behold, Ethereum, Web3, and especially Nouns had my full attention when I learned that Nouns was a Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO), an open-source brand, and a very powerful funding mechanism as a Noun is auctioned off every day. Seeing the discourse on active proposals being voted upon and the professionalism displayed by those executing proposals turned my attention into participation. Unfortunately, I was out of luck as acquiring a Noun appeared to be cost prohibitive…","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A little more reading and I learned that there were several other DAOs under the Nouns umbrella which allowed participation at a much lower cost threshold with different levels of involvement, what a relief!. A few examples being:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Noggles offered direct participation on proposals funded by Nouns by a collection Noggles token holders acting as a voting block. Power of the voting block is due to Noggles being backed by Nouns tokens.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns GG offering participation on the execution of proposals already funded by Nouns by a collection of users that have been onboarded through Nouns.gg website.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Lil Nouns offering direct participation on proposals funded by Lil Nouns which are separate from Nouns. Lil Nouns have a much lower token cost than Nouns","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With this knowledge, I was confident in jumping into the Nouns pool knowing full well that the pool was likely going to be an ocean of challenges, opportunities, and meeting new people (sounds like a game I recently picked up). ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"When compared to other potential delegates, I am definitely the new kid on the block, however, I offer a fresh pair of eyes and a new vector to reach communities that have not yet been exposed to Nouns. This is how I plan to represent the community and the impact I wish to have:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Talk about Nouns at the local fighting game weekly I attend in person and compile the frequently asked questions I get and the answers. All questions are title: The delegates we are missing! The unite squad don't surrender!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"GM FRIENDS! This is ADESu again representing the Pokemon Unite squad. ","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfI3J8SFERKgMnrFIW9iQibvbfT4-2lMwSUbiXmyFmR67wMNI-nPUh-sAePDh8PgbEbTLViKN7lTSH5y3HXkQhQnVPSKaoEdiiUydCEmZc1loqapGE6yzK102pboU3_pbN1ti1E?key=cLN-vtwaghpjg-zH7glRbeDG","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We participated in the two previous Let’s Play rounds and of course we are not gonna miss this one! Also, this time we are already on our way to be engaged in nouns governance, hopefully you can see the effort we are already doing and trust in our plans to be part of this the best way possible. This time we are absolutely committed, so please help us to make this next nounish phase from us even more impactful.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Who are we?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are a team of 6 people in which 4 of them have been in Nouns Esports since 2022 thanks to a favorable vote from proposal 91! That year we managed to reach second place at worlds 2022, we've been trying to pursue being champions since then with nouns holding our backs. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are ambassadors for Nouns for our communities and the Pokemon community as a whole.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We have a new addition in the team Inder, which is a great content creator from Canada, which increases our reach a lot by having someone who is not from Europe. With this addition, our social media networks together have over 35000 followers on X and Youtube and over 65000 on Twitch! ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeO89XD8e-CcX4vDJt-Wbbm7fxKrr9dbvzvBeO3SzjpIPEobxxU7QgnS2jWBX70w2Ub_retcPLLGOlc0HO9EMjJoRRZWm2MsYJMDC7mBJ84gCOoL9qy_oXvC1aY5Z4emBcd_QfTrg?key=cLN-vtwaghpjg-zH7glRbeDG","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why do we propose ourselves?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In previous rounds we were speaking about getting more involved in governance since it was one of our objectives for this upcoming 2025 season! We have a specific section in our team discord to discuss the upcoming DAO proposals already.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I also became a Nouncillor recently, and we'll vote as a team there as well!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The team is more active in the web3 ecosystem and way more dedicated to teach it in their communities! We want to be another reason for the proliferation of nounsGG, and hopefully into the DAO as well. We have video guides and PDFs in mind to share with our communities so they start losing the fear of using on-chain technologies and start taking advantage of all the opportunities there!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"More reasons? We are the longest lasting team from Nouns Esports and we intend to continue to be so!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We also had a blast meeting other nounish persons and we hope we can meet many more in the future. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXe8nOqOWLB4krZhdhd1yofDO3AvcL2J04nFaRsxeswf5ZAhDkvntU4wHvjCd-_qIZfQZpoCpRAurY7N7Kb1h_lbhAYW5pQiKkdRlaYRWyuqUOVzYZUCohjioMfdDHijd5XoUWeMZw?key=cLN-vtwaghpjg-zH7glRbeDG","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"How will the delegate role be managed among the team?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I, ADESu, will be the primary delegate, we will use the same process we are doing for voting on council or for making comments on-chain. Basically I make a brief description and tell the team to read the prop and cast a vote + feedback, then I gather everyone’s opinion and cast a team vote. As simple as that. If someone needs more discussion we'll discuss it after our daily scrims.","type":"text","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXctIxvJE37_vQWNA9_-8jpCuUkBGqr_Rg8cdEqHwUg2MyRSPzxw1i19FdOrV_dj_HnLJwPb2nv8es9Kgb7EUVD6Rgdhrhs94YLZVLPCM0lDkcHfxfBnGRSPws4lNufoUo3XlQ9wNg?key=cLN-vtwaghpjg-zH7glRbeDG","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Here are the reasons why the Pokemon Unite team will be positive contributors as delegates","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The team will vote on over 66% of the proposals, giving not only our feedback as E-sports players but also as people, we have a variety of origins and backgrounds in the team like data science or social works.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are a very sensible team, we like to act logically in order to optimise processes, but always with a good heart.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We are all long term beneficiaries of the DAO so we have an appreciation of its abilities to change lives, and we’re excited to be able to be part of that decision making process going forward!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We will definitely vote by giving proper reasoning and we will make regular posts on Warpcast talking not only about what we do but also about the impact it has on us and how we grow from it.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":4},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We want to share the ideas among our communities, showing them what nouns can achive and encourage to be part of this.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":5}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks for considering our Proposal! We are really looking into being elected, since this round really aligns with what we have planned and what we are going to do.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Nouns Pokemon Unite Team","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Flip/Side: Pinnacle - A bi-annual MD/VA regional
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeYgWSztnH3da-fI8A1-lc4Vt4VlDLGuXnTSFFM_gmsQwcdhm2-iAv_hC8YoljKCi7rpRFPMUx43yzZCxmcgR6nDbacvRtYBJIYZF4Y6w_Ww9Qv-Q0mrLVmj1YlWVKR3JBuIlnDit7Ydz5106PfSLk?key=pwm8qu9nS2dASeGf6Q4Fo63l","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Introduction","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"What's up y'all! MJ here! Known as frames, I'm primarily a Melee player in the MD/VA region, though I also play Project+ and Ultimate! I have experience not only from running my own tournament, but assisting in stream running at the MD/VA 2024 Arcadian, and side-stream at The Cave - Fairfax Finale, which hosted 120+ registered participants.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In the huge MD/VA region, Flip/Side has been a bi-weekly staple for over a year now, with a classic SSBM bracket format. At our Tuesday events we've had top 100 players such as mvlvchi and Kevin Maples, and MD/VA PR talent like Eve, Gibblez, Cbass. We’ve since started hosting Project+ at the same event, featuring top 100 talent Hyperflame and Goode, and introduced Rivals 2 in to the rotation and are really excited to continue growing our local scene for such great games. Our past and upcoming events can be seen on our start.gg hub here","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://www.start.gg/hub/flipside","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.start.gg/hub/flipside"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Pinnacle Overview","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"During the 2023 MD/VA PR season we were selected for our bi-annual event Pinnacle, to receive not one, but two qualifier spots for the region’s MD/VA Summit, with 30+ attendees at our first event. Our promotion featured graphics where we highlighted past attendance and wins, an example can be seen here","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://twitter.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1741585170602336563","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://twitter.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1741585170602336563"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":". Pinnacle #2 on July 20th meanwhile doubled our attendance and featured additional region PR talent Nav, Egg, RapM, Gibblez, Eve, Seven, SypherPhoenix, Bob-omb, and Satoshi, and top 100 competitors ZODD-01, Kevin Maples, and mvlvchi. Pinnacle #3 on January 4th 2025 broke our previous attendance record at 73+ attendees, and featured even more talent like top 100 player Maelstrom, and regional PR RapMonster, Vintage, Seven, and more.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Nouns funding proposal is primarily for our next bi-annual event, several months from now. Pinnacle #4 will take place in July of 2025 featuring Smash Bros. Melee, Project+, and more. However the funding will bolster our tournament series as a whole.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We also implement new ideas at every possible event, including utilizing USB hotswap tech and replay manager by Nicolet/@jmlee337 ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://github.com/jmlee337/replay-manager-for-slippi/releases/tag/1.1.8","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://github.com/jmlee337/replay-manager-for-slippi/releases/tag/1.1.8"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" which allowed our tournament to capture almost every set during bracket, being the first in MD/VA to implement this, alongside larger tournaments across the US like Firestarter.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Funding Proposal","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"While we’ve had great success so far, we’re currently running Flip/Side on grass roots funding. So far the community has pitched in tremendously, however Nouns funding would set us up in a more sustainable way so we can better host these events.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A portion of the funds would go towards adding more setups to our equipment, currently we’ve run off of 10 setups and the rest provided by the community when possible. Likewise with the stream we’re looking to purchase a capture card and splitter configuration so we can consistently and better stream Project+ and highlight the awesome game and community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Specific to Pinnacle #4, we’d like to sponsor carpool drivers to encourage both in and out of region attendance from greater distances and provide out-of-region top players bonuses for attending.  Additionally we’d like to provide Nouns swag to attendees through raffles and pre-registration bonuses. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Another key goal is to commission a few different pieces of promotional material including a custom Twitch overlay for our stream use going forward, a highlight reel for Pinnacle #3, and Pinnacle #4, and a hype trailer for Pinnacle #4. Our Pinnacle #1 and #2 highlight reels by an in-region editor can be found here","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nui2u43AvQk","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nui2u43AvQk"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" and here ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Po1Tl_gJ8k","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-Po1Tl_gJ8k"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns Representation","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns would be featured both on our start.gg and on in-person displays, as well as our stream overlay, and would see shout outs and sponsor posts on our social media. Flip/Side has a strongly recognizable brand in-region and online, our most recent event was stream on twitch.tv//kmltournaments further increasing our audience.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"If sponsored, Pinnacle #4 would feature its main stream on Nouns esports Twitch channel, with KML channel as the side stream. We’d also integrate Nouns into our branding and swag giveaways. Previously we’ve given Flip/Side stickers to attendees at their third time attending an event in our series, and we’d include Nouns merch in this as well","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":8,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" https://x.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1765537271564898650","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://x.com/FlipSideSSB/status/1765537271564898650"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Expected Reach","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our first event just a few months in to hosting had 30+ attendees, and acted as an MD/VA Melee Summit qualifier, just six months later through grassroots work we doubled that to 60, with more top level entrants and 15 teams in Melee doubles, one of the largest doubles events in our region. Most recently, Pinnacle #3 hit 70+ entrants across four brackets, including the first triples (3v3) Melee event in our region. Our relatively new Twitch channel had 150 unique viewers during the course of the event, and KML Tournament’s stream reached 800+ unique viewers, so with Nouns backing and promotion to the Nouns Twitch channel there’s huge potential for viewership due to the quality of the event and gameplay.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Promotion Strategy","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Our first step is a highlight reel from Pinnacle #3, as a quick visual summary of the amazing gameplay and experience that the event was. Next, we will be inviting top level players in our region, as well as neighboring regions to Pinnacle #4. As top players RSVP we’ll post player cards on our social media pages that detail their previous Flip/Side series wins and build hype for the Pinnacle #4 attendance. Between word of mouth and frequent reminders as we approach the event, turnout is estimated to be 60-80+ attendees for our fourth event with capabilities for even more. And lastly we’d close out promotion with a hype trailer for the event.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Conclusion","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With funding from Nouns, we here at Flip/Side can better expand our series to highlight  Smash Melee and Project+. By bolstering our equipment and outreach, enhancing our already strong name recognition, the potential for growth of our scene multiplies greatly, so we can put on better events for the local, regional, and greater Smash community. With potential for better and larger regionals in the future.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Battle of the Brazos 2 - a Texas regional focused on the newest threats to SSBMRank
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmcq9ML9AxNnq4Cp8dsogHLjRQDwWJgVm7jsLjH8nvgK83","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Event History","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Battle of the Brazos took place spring of 2024 in Waco, Texas. The event was one of the most top-heavy brackets in Texas of 2024 with no more than 51 entrants. The tournament drew players several hundred miles within the state of Texas to face out-of-state talent Free Palestine, Balloon Day and Paladin. The bracket concluded with Balloon Day, upsetting Chickenman400, advancing to a Game-5 Grand Final won by Salt. As a TO, this event was a dream to be able to bring together players with little or no record to settle the score in bracket.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Brand Integration","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With the assistance of Nouns, echelon melee would like to expand their roster for Battle of the Brazos 2. The two types of players we would like to recruit are unranked players with wins on the top 100 and high-level players outside of the United States. The intent of the proposal is to help remove the financial barrier of entry to SSBMRank for players.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- With 500 USDC, we would fully fund travel & entry fees for a rising talent in the US. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" - With 750 USDC, we would launch event merch with Nouns branding, fund gas for out-of-state carpools in the neighboring states of Louisiana, Oklahoma, and Colorado, in addition to the 500 USDC tier.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" - With 1000 USDC, we would fully fund travel & entry fees for a North-American International player. In addition, a merch launch with Nouns branding, and a gas fund for out-of-state carpools in neighboring states.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" - With 1500 USDC, we would fully fund travel & entry fees for an EU player. In addition, a merch launch with Nouns branding, and a gas fund for out-of-state carpools in neighboring states. Any remaining funds would go toward funding travel and entry for a rising talent in the US.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" - With any level of support from Nouns, branding will be featured on all stream graphics and Nouns will receive shout-outs on stream regularly. Nouns will also be tagged in any promotional material for the event on social media. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Promotion Plan","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Outside of being promoted on local and state discords, a promotional trailer will be made for the event featuring combos from players sponsored by the Nouns tournament fund and echelon melee. With the assistance of funding, we will promote the trailer on the live streams of a large regional or major. In addition the video will be posted on social media with interactions from sponsored players. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Mock movie-poster graphics will be used on social media to promote the player roster and top 8 results for the tournament featuring Nouns branding. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Expected Reach","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Last year, the event was limited in attendance and viewership by its proximity to Thanksgiving as well as a lackluster and/or non-existent promotional plan. Within these limitations the stream peaked as the top result on the twitch SSBM category with 73 viewers at peak and 285 unique viewers with 53 in-person attendees. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With a new promotional plan, the livestream could easily reach several hundred average viewers with in-person attendance rising above 75+. Following the stream on Nouns Twitch and YouTube, the tournament VOD would be posted on the Nouns YouTube to gain further reach after the conclusion of the tournament with individual matches on the echelon melee YouTube page as an archive of notable matches in the tournament.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- esch","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: UCI Weekly: The Big One
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In celebration of one of SoCal's longest-standing college tournament series as well as my last year as president of the UCI melee club, I would like to commemorate the legacy of UCI melee and those before who ran it to reproduce the summit and apex of its glory days. My tag is GOATcheese, and I am a frequenter and TO for SoCal melee’s tourneys, specifically the Orange County region. With the help of Nouns funding, the UCI melee club will have enough funds to prosper for the next generations and provide funds for future events to incentivize more players outside of the local area to travel. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Event History: ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Without a doubt, the history of UCI melee is quite dense and rich. So much so that even in my ability to reconnect with past alumni and converse about UCI, I have still yet to learn everything. From SoCal Colosseum and its collaborations with SSBM Tutorials, the host of Press Start and its memorable Hungrybox vs. SFAT set, the assistance in opening the first ever Esports Arena at a public university and hosting an opening week tourney, to even the smallest group of UCI smashers posting on SmashBoards to help kickstart an event (shoutout to the 949 Smash Thread), the idea of UCI melee represented so much during each year of its existence. Today, we are running weekly events on Fridays in the same room used in the past years, with the newest inclusion of Rivals 2, where many SoCal Rivals players have found a new standing in their local scene. We have assisted in organizing larger events with Top Shelf Esports such as Socal Arcadian and the regional event Saving Mr. Lombardi series, where they have garnered 200+ attendees previously through the usage of UCI’s spacious and convenient venue spaces and help from UCI’s student center services. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Expected Reach: ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Due to our location between the LA and SD areas, the two major regions of SoCal, we may expect between 50 and 200 melee attendees and 25 to 150 viewers, depending on the matches, time of the stream, etc. Because of the many connections of UCI alumni and their connections, we can spread the word about the event and reunite many retired players to reignite nostalgic memories. Depending on the number of volunteers interested, I will also reach out to the local Rivals 2 community to aid in running our event and further bolstering the attendee count and outreach. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Promotion Plan: ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns will be featured through graphic displays on the stream and short intermission shoutouts between sets to promote. With proper funding, merchandise will be exhibited throughout the venue, worn by broadcasters, and raffled off to spread the Nouns branding. We will also post this event on designated social media platforms and ask notable melee personalities to alleviate this cause. A custom-made graphic of the tourney including Nouns promotion would be integrated into our social media postings as well. Nouns-related content may be filmed on the premise depending on UCI regulations. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Tiered title: FUND SYRACUSE UNIVERSITY MELEE AND START OUR REGIONAL SERIES WITH A BANGER NOUNS EVENT
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Introducing SALT THE ROADS, the new Syracuse University Regional","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This event will be hosted in the Schine Student Center in the heart of SU campus. Thanks to our connection with SU Esports, we have access to a state-of-the-art esports facility which will host all our in person events and will make the Nouns streaming requirement achievable. Entrant cap will be 64.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"History -","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h3"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I started watching Melee in 2016, I was too young to travel, but I would scroll through brackets for hours. I slowly watched great upstate players like iBDW and Jmook gain prominence at Syracuse tournaments. When I became old enough to travel, I was shocked to see that Syracuse Melee had dried up. When I enrolled at SU, I was hoping to host student tournaments like I did in high school. Quickly, I realized I was going to need help.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Syracuse University Melee has a short, yet strong history. I arrived here and there was almost nothing. Just a few students who dreamed of having a campus community as strong as our neighbors across the North East. Efforts to grow were weak; hosting on campus was inconsistent and at the end of the day, we were just a handful of kids with no setups, no advertising, no community. With the only beacons of hope I know graduated and moving away I thought I was doomed to a life of begging for carpools and netplay pings.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Everything changed in 2024 when Upstate NY TOs pushed an effort to unite Upstate Melee. The announcement of the Upstate Melee Circuit Finale and Arcadian inspired everyone to travel across the state and compete. Soon, projects like the Upstate Crews League took off with enormous success and only made players MORE excited to travel and play.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Last October, an SU local TO, nicklebackair, reached out to students to gauge interest in an on campus weekly Melee tournament series. He was flooded with excitement and passion from dozens of hardworking students across all grade levels and aspirations. The unstoppable, fun energy radiating from Upstate Melee reached the University's player base and gave us our community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Only two months have passed since our first local and we already have one of the largest in Upstate. We are ready to show the region what we can do for them and broadcast the depth of Upstate talent to the world. Who will be the next player to gain prominence at a Syracuse regional? Vote for this proposal and find out with us very soon.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Expected Reach - ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Upstate NY tournaments regularly have attendants from every corner of Upstate, Southern Ontario, PA, top players, and more. Being in the center of New York, Syracuse is the perfect place for a regional to invite every sub-community in the Upstate NY Melee Sphere of influence. I have full confidence that we can pack this event and show the region what our regional series is all about.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Promotion Plan - ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This event will be hosted in the Esports room in the Schine Student Center. That room is attached to the same atrium as the campus store and a food court. The amount of foot traffic in front of our space is unimaginable. It is incredibly common for people to table events, fundraisers, drives, clubs, etc. directly in front of the esports room, it has the highest foot traffic of any place on campus. If chosen, we have the opportunity to share Nouns and the idea of an open source company to thousands of people in a single day. Nouns will also be present on our stream, obviously.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Tiered Rewards & Brand Integration -","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"If we receive the highest tier, I would like to have two people run a table in Schine Student center to advertise, hand out noggles, and engage with the community about Nouns opportunities. I cannot oversell the success I have seen from other organizations who have used this method to reach students.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I think this is a great goal because it can easily be scaled up and down depending on which tier we hypothetically receive. Highest tier would mean full day tabling, handing out Nouns merch, and teaching what Nouns is capable of.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With a higher tier we will be able to have a higher prize pool, encouraging skilled players to see how amazing our community is. If the skill pool at SALT THE ROADS is high, our viewership will rise as well.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you -","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With this proposal I ask you to vote for one of the youngest and most passionate micro melee scenes on the planet and let us broadcast one hell of an Upstate Melee Regional, showing the scene they want to come back often for more. Thank you for your time, you are making my dreams come true.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}
