title: GET INKY FROM COAST TO COAST!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\"How would East Coast's best fair if they were catapulted across the barren lands of Canada to British Columbia?\"","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Well let's find out!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My tag is ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Inky","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", and I've been the best player in Atlantic Canada for a number of years now. 2024 was my first real attempt at travelling to majors, going to Collision, GOML, Tipped Off,  and Riptide. I barely lost a good 3-4 sets that kept me out of making it to Sunday brackets, and likely the top 100 (3-1 stock lead game 5 against 2Saint, 3-1 stock lead game 5 against Wally, 2-0 lead against Dr. Lobster, the list goes on...). I'm really hoping for a couple chances this year to prove that I can compete with the best of them!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Right now, my computer/internet isn't good enough to stream and play melee at the same time. But I won't let that stop me. I've come out with a TON of content that I plan on releasing during the voting round. Depending on feedback, I'm happy to continue on with a lot of these things!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"WHY YOU SHOULD VOTE FOR ME:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- I will release a combo video during the voting round!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I had a pretty specific creative vision going into it, and I really like how it's turned out. It made it pretty clear how far I have to go to really satisfy myself with my combo trees. Big ups to Justus for editing.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" I will start a stream series called \"Outside Looking In\" where I do my best to take non-melee things, and contextualize their takeaways in a melee context.","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The first episode of this will relate a book about Memory to the tips/tricks needed to improve in Melee.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- I will start a stream series called \"A Look at the Landscape\" where I check out what material is publicly available on Sheik (discords, websites, smashboards) and review it.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I would be happy to do this for other characters too, if asked :)","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- I will start a stream series called \"Where the Magic Happens\", where I go over my own archive of information, organize it, and talk about how and why it's relevant to particular matchups and game states. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- I will be giving out a couple free VoD analyses to a select few that have voted for me. I'll be posting this giveaway through my twitter. @SSBMInky. Check it out there, after voting has begun!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- While I can't stream myself playing live, I'll still be entering a plethora of online tournaments leading up to this. ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Check out the upcoming Meoweekly Online events, or Waddle Wednesdays to track how I'm performing!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Again, while I can't stream myself playing live, I do want people to be able to watch me play. So I'm going to pick a date of the week to stream a couple good sessions I've had with good players that week.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"BoBC 2025 is a very important event for me, for a couple reasons.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- I had the chance to meet Fauxhebro and Espi back in 2019 at GOML, and really loved their energy. They were casual, open to help learn, and overall really cool guys. I wasn't quite #1 in my region yet, so they really set a standard for how to be as a player and person, and I've always wanted to come back and thank them personally ever since.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- BoBC will be my first in-person event since September, a full half-year break from competition. I've had a lot of time to think of ideas, how I want to fit in the greater sphere of melee, and what I want my play to represent about myself. I'm really hoping to showcase a style that is unique to me, on one of the biggest stages. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- I need a goal. Playing to improve has been fun, and I've embraced the journey, but having a tangible event and timeline to look forward to will give me the extra energy I need to really turn things up a notch.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Expenses are tight for me, so I'm not sure how many, if any, events I'll be able to get to this year. I've put thousands of dollars into this game out of pure love and passion, but as I get older a lot more responsibilities have crept up on me that I need to put first, for my own sake. I had to really think about what event I'd like to get to, if any, and this is the one. But I don't want to feel like a charity case - writing a proposal advocating for myself is hard enough already. Hopefully I've made it feel worth it to vote for me, and if not, feel free to message me other ideas to add value to my campaign. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Love you all either way, thanks for taking the time to read this :)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Help Goodie Get To Battle of BC !!!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi I'm Goodie and I'm the #1 melee player in Australia ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://x.com/Schlocal_Events/status/1870028100584763580","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://x.com/Schlocal_Events/status/1870028100584763580"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In 2024 I was lucky enough to be able to compete in North America entering Genesis, Full Bloom, Collision, Riptide and Wavelength. Although my results weren't what I hoped (except for Genesis I was quite pleased making top 64 :). I took a lot away from these experiences and I have been working incredibly hard and have improved an insane amount. In 2025 I will once again be looking to enter as many North American tournaments as I can and I will be in America from February to April attending Genesis X2 and Full Bloom 2025. I would love to add Battle of BC to this list of events I attend and it would be an incredible privilege to represent Nouns as I prove to the northern hemisphere what I'm really capable of doing in this game. Last year I accumulated several top 100 wins over players like Salami, Bonfire10, Essy, Balloon Day and Dawson and this year I am looking to make it onto the top 100 myself. I am extremely confident in my skills as a melee player, my mentality is as strong as its ever been, I've never been more motivated and most importantly I am gaming harder than ever :B","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/Qmcz3VXiZTF2R8sgKkukPRn3pyamZsZD928qPG4uYVMHdj","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Being able to attend North American tournaments is very difficult for me as I live on the complete opposite side of the world (lol) so I am always incredibly grateful for opportunities like this and I can promise that I will not let it go to waste as I am more than capable of swagging on Americans as much as I swag on Australians :D ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: I want to pet Adesus head
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Adesus head has always been a mistery: Which secrets lie in it? What power does it contain? Maybe it's the source of nouns competitive success. Since Adesu first set foot in the scene, Ghatlue was always very eager to pet the head. Before games, after games, in between games the head had to be touched. Since then I was wondering: why does he do that? Maybe it's just for fun, but maybe the funny facade was only one thing: a distraction. A distraction to make the obvious reason unseen, a distraction to make us laugh and forget what's the purpose of petting the head truly is. It's the source of unlimited mechanics, superb macro and the ability to make clutch plays. That's why I make this proposal, to expose nouns and their unfair advantage: Adesus head. Oh and also I like free food, so there is that.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Kiss kiss,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Yours truly ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"DaddyLe0n ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: One Person Cheer Squad
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“What’s that screaming in the background? This is the TCG stream, and there’s nothing even happening!”","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“Oh, that’s just Kelly!”","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"-actual quotes from our friends watching Pokémon Worlds at home","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi Nouns Voters! I’m Kelly, or Kellyfish636, and I’m a Nouns Superfan through and through! If Nouns is on stage, I’ll be screaming my lungs out at every chance I get! It’s true that some friends managed to hear me cheering in the background of a totally different game’s stream!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"How I got to be a One Person Cheer Squad is also the story of how I became a true Nouns Superfan.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I started by watching Bruv on Twitch. When he joined Nouns, I made a point to follow and watch all the other teammates to get to know them! What I found is that they were all so wholesome, thoughtful, and considerate people, as well as being great players! Seeing their personalities made me know these were people that I could cheer for.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"When I got to Worlds 2022, I gathered up friends to watch Nouns play Day 1 in the Group Stage. While waiting for them to play, I saw another team, Iclen, who had their girlfriends there. Every time Iclen did something good, all the girlfriends cheered, and I could see the cheering was making a difference. So, I convinced all of my friends to cheer with me as loud as we could for Nouns! At first, it was just me, but everyone got into it! My goal then and ever since was to cheer loud enough so that they could hear me on the stage (and they can!)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Things took a rough turn from there, though. Since this was the first year that Unite was at Worlds, the LAN setup wasn’t really smoothed out. Gyz was repeatedly disconnecting, which has a big impact in a 10 minute game, and Bruv was playing on red ping at a LAN event! Bruv had his hand raised for 20 seconds, looking for an admin pause, and the admin was turned around watching Pokken on the big screen. I had to physically tap the admin to get him to turn around and help Bruv out. They lost that game, and their chances of making Day 2 were getting slimmer. I went and stood up for Nouns to the Admin, describing all the technical issues and asking for a remake, but they weren’t given one.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"At this point, everyone’s mood was low, and I knew that something big had to happen if Nouns was going to win the rest of their games. I knew just what to do – go buy a life-sized Slowpoke and make it their mascot! Who could be down when there’s a life-sized Slowpoke named Stewart on your side!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With Sir Stewart the 3","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":64,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"rd","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" joining the cheer squad, everyone was back in good spirits and Nouns won the rest of their games, making it to Day 2 and all the way to 2","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":64,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"nd","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Place at Worlds! I even made Noggles for Stewart in the crowd, and he got lots of camera time on stream because of it!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Since that first event, I’ve gone to cheer on Nouns at as many events as I can – EUIC 2023, Worlds 2023, EUIC 2024, Worlds 2024, and now EUIC 2025. Nouns has given me so many reasons to cheer them on over the past three years, from insane plays to last minute comebacks. I would love a chance to meet the team, chat with them all, and hype them up for this next tournament!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmXKxMLSSJ3LTj13S4FaLXXDrKKYwasmdsa5DoCeCaxzoH","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmawWphZy9YrghqeNRkznaQz1E74LiyUGHPaQZqTvibijT","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSCbALsuoNhTkCXuMLiCfoPqEa3rz2Batnt8S1s6twcg1","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: I Might Be Runt, but A Big Nouns Fan Regardless!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi Nouns Voters! My name is Runt, but I go by Runt or RunTheTrap10 online! Nouns Esports has been my favorite Pokemon Unite team since Bruv joined them in 2022! I watched his streams a lot and was excited when he joined a new team and got signed by Nouns! But the real moment I became a Nouns fan was their pivotal performance at Worlds 2022. We got to see the whole team work together and fight their way out of the group stage to the finals on Day 2. From here, they suffered a crushing blow, getting sent to the loser’s bracket by a team called T2. This team would give all the experience to their star player Mame, who would then always dominate the fights.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"But this is where the legendary “Nouns Run” was born. They kept fighting and pushing through losers, all the way back to Loser’s Finals where they faced T2 again. This time, they knew to all group up and focus Mame, and not let him snowball. Seeing them learn this and apply it in real time to come back and beat T2 was such an incredible thing to see.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"They got an incredible second place finish at Worlds, and my voice was gone from cheering so much! This is them on stage accepting their trophies!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcgJpUGRnzLGbA9AJNVxQkLEBuyP7XwkbY8jM19Nf7yHr","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"After that, Nouns has been my favorite team to cheer for, and I’ve cheered them on at EUIC 2023, Worlds 2023, EUIC 2024, and Worlds 2024! As you can see, I’ve gotten Noggles, ordered a custom jersey, and made signs, all to support and cheer them on! If they’re on stage, I’ll be cheering my heart out! I would love a chance to meet my favorite team and get to know them better as people over some pizza!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"And, from following the players, I’ve gotten to know more about Nouns as an organization itself! I think it’s really cool how Nouns has a community driven voting system to fund so many different awesome ventures. I know there’s a lot of bad actors out there in the crypto and NFT space, but Nouns is a shining example of the good that can be done, and how things can be managed fairly.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Even if I don’t win this vote, I want to say thank you for sponsoring my favorite team and for fostering such a great community!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmbBDTBERyMVVFJCHEhgyStDHWJYmBrnSPWN1mid6d7SCL","type":"image","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmYskfFytqEkQ5WQ53WAi7HfwYjrx5iWNTAxWadoZfubsQ","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Help for Bham Melee to make it to BOBC
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello! My name is Mario and I currently run the tournaments for Bellingham Melee, there is quite a few of us who are interested in going to Bobc but do not have the means to get there. While we wouldn't need flights, we do need help getting some of our humble scene housing for the event. If we were to win first place, we would get the majority of the Power ranked players in our city to Vancouver. This includes Top 100 balloter Graves, Washington #7 Melo, Washington PR balloter Shama, as well as lesser known players like Perfect Sunset! While we understand this is a abnormal request we hope you will take the time to consider sponsoring our humble scene! If you would like to check out what we have to offer please tune in to our weeklies at Twitch.tv/Baileyoshi where you can see all of us compete every friday!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"(I am mostly doing this for the achievement but if we get any traction I will gladly make goals and interact with anyone that supports us.)","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"You can find us on our twitter @BellinghamMelee ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Thank you Nouns
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'm making this proposal solely to support Nouns Unite. We are very lucky to have such a strong stable team in the European Unite community. This meet and greet event is just one example of how they are helping build up the community. I also applaud their efforts on social media to promote this event and get as many votes and proposals as possible. I would like to show their organization that their efforts wont go unnoticed. So alongside the team, I encourage everyone to make an easy proposal and vote afterwards, to show that their efforts into building our Unite community will pay off. Youve seen it a dozen times on twitter: it takes less than 2 minutes to make a proposal. So do it. And when voting phase begins, vote. Who knows maybe you (or I) will win. Also I need 11 more words so if I win: I will somersault into bruv to prove rollout is viable.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Silent cheers, an introvert’s appreciation for the Nouns Team!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello, ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns voter,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"You know how ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Sableye","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" enters Theia Sky Ruins and then just disappears? Yeah… that’s me at Pokémon Unite events. And yes, I know everyone hates Sableye—","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"sorry about that","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’m an introvert who has been to ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"every single London event since Worlds 2022","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", but always hidden in the shadows. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Joining the Nouns Esports team would be an incredible opportunity to help me build my foundation as a commentator in the space. content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am MarxistxAthena, a Smash Melee Jigglypuff player who got back into Melee in late 2022 after taking a break from it in January of 2021, which happened one year after my journey with Melee began when I was a Marth main. Being the underdog doesn't phase me anymore.","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I know how to keep a cool head when I punch up. It's time for me to just let loose on bigger stages and raise hell!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've read books on sports psychology, talked with Bobby Siege, and watched videos of college sports and Olympic sports coaches. ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My love for the game is beyond just competing. I trust in the process I've built over the years. I reflect and analyze my friendlies and even solo practice sessions efficiently and productively like an athlete in a practice journal, only bringing the most important thoughts and ideas into practice.","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":3,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Plus, I really love Melee. I love that after 11 years, I can have an idea, test it, develop it in practice, and then apply it to real matches.","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"That’s the difference between me and anyone known in the community as a “labber.\" I’m the only Falcon I’ve seen able to apply things like aerial RTC and aerial Interrupts from ledge. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I love competition, and when I compete, I put my all into it.","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Even if Melee is not my #1 priority in regular life — I treat it like my #1 priority when I practice or perform.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":3,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Aren’t I just another dude trying to get top 100?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":3},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I think if I’m given the opportunity to travel, I can be a top 10 player.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I love watching high-level melee as much as anyone else. But whenever I watch a Top 8 of a major, I can't help but think to myself, \"Man, if I were up there, I'd be showing people shit they've never seen before.\" I've been thinking this ever since I watched my first Top 8 at Shine 2015. Now, after 10 years of competition and growth, I can confidently say — ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've never been more ready for that moment.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Vote for me! Thanks for reading! <3","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":9,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"OVER 12k VIEWS: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Combo like a Slippi Top 50 GM Falco","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://youtu.be/GLRdMP5NBEc"},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This is not a traditional combo video in the sense that it's not full of flashy movement and unorthodox move choice. This combo video is meant to show practical combo extensions and effective DI mixups that I try to use in all my games. Some combos may seem like the opponent is using bad DI, but really they're just getting mixed up. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" If you pay close attention, you'll notice very similar situations repeat themselves, but whether I choose to read DI in or DI away is made ambiguous until the last moment. For example, you'll see a lot of people choose to DI away then lose their stock instantly to run>crouch>fsmash which might seem like a bad decision on their part. Remember that they've been conditioned to DI away by previous combos that were reading DI in. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" If you can train yourself to combo in a way that forces your opponent to make a decision with their DI that may lose their stock, then your punish game will improve drastically.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Here's an analysis video of the combo video as well: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0XJFSO7nhro","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"autolink","version":1,"rel":"noreferrer","target":"_blank","title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0XJFSO7nhro"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":9}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Sheik Up Smash The Movie
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"300 words?! Jeez, that is a fifth of the essay word count that I still haven't started. Anyways, I said I wanted one vote last time, but this time I want no votes at all. Just wanted to make this combo video for fun so all of my favorite doubles plays are in one place. I have played doubles ever since it came out on Slippi and having to play with a random player has given me a lot of experience.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It is kind of like Blue Lock, but it is hard to explain why. I try to be around my teammate so when they hit someone, I will be in the exact spot they want me in to pass back to them or finish the job. It feels selfish to just charge up smash in a random spot hoping your teammate passes to you. I have gotten to the point in doubles where I know exactly where I need to be to finish the kill depending on the move, even Dr. Mario down tilt. If my teammate is facing both me and one of the opponents who is between us, then all I have to do is hold up smash in a spot where their fair or one of their tilts would hit them to.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This is just some of those moments where I got an up smash hoping my teammate used the exact move I wanted them to use and found that piece of luck I needed. I also put in some other clips where I played with ChuDat, some don't include up smash as the kill move but they were equally as cool. I might put in some extra clips where I got some insane saves, yeah I will probably do that. I still haven't made the video.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Hall of fame fatmouk
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I am Maximillien Rousseau, more commonly known as Fatmaxx, your classic Montréal player. I first started entering Melee tournament back in 2018-2019, choosing red Falcon on the CSS since the very start. Ever since then, my goal has been to innovate and develop my own trademark style. I absolutely love the game and I enjoy seeing my people and sharing moments with them, bringing energy to every venue I attend. I've always wanted to be a part of what Montréal is known for within the scene and I think I accomplished this dream. When I first started playing, a lot of my inspiration came from n0ne, Jeapie and S2J. They were and still are, in my opinion, flashiest and sickest Falcons to watch, and I try to look as cool to the newer players as they did to me. I would say that I am kind of known for getting really good at doing pivot tilts/gentlemen on vanilla GameCube controller, but my trademark move is the \"Toursthicc dumpster dive\": Falcon kick trading with Fox/Falco up-b and living. The pivots tilts and the Touristhicc dumpster dive are pretty unique and require very intricate inputs, especially on an unmodded OEM GCC, which all the combos shown were performed on. I also like to throw in other advanced tech in my combos such as up-b edgecancels, Randall cancels, pivot drops and more. I simply go for what I think would be the flashiest on the spot. I would say that I achieved my goal of having my own unique style of gameplay and combos which I like to show off in my combo videos. That style has already garnered me the respect of the flashiest Falcons such as Salt, S2J, SquidTheCat and bab_o7, so, I think it's needless to say, you will certainly enjoy my style too.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Bringing Swag Back with Attack Attack!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"People often talk about how Melee is unique in its beauty due its expressive capacity. It's become a cliche at this point, but there is more to expression through this game than just the game engine. What drew me to this game, (Ariquenuubs, Esports X2, Freestyle) and other sick ass combo videos is the marriage of Melee and montage culture. This combo video is one I'm most proud of, it's got some of the most advanced editing I've ever done so far, my cinematics were very involved (the character tech skill introductions, the spinning stages, the transitions). What's really fun is that everything was done using the Melee engine and stages.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"But this video stands out to me because its the most I've put into making something that I thought, \"This is some cool shit\". I was in a massive Attack Attack! phase during that time and I couldn't stop listening to Some Day Came Suddenly and that love for the music translated in so many ways to Melee. When I would play I'd hit a nasty combo and be thinking how hard it would look with a certain song, and I think many people do the same when they're thinking about their gameplay. My point being this video came from love for the swag, who else do you know is doing dash attack doraki soft knee nipple spike or double reverse bair falcon punch to some 2010s Metalcore on top 100 players like Louis, Agent and JJM? ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I appreciate anyone reading this far, if you feel like voting I'd really appreciate it, but moreso I hope this video makes you feel something, or reminds you of something you love about Melee. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also I drew that Asking Alexandria parody cover (IK its not AA but it's 2010s metal so w/e) ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: About me-casu!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello,","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I started playing this game back in 2019 when it was first released, and there was a lot of hype surrounding it. After I graduated from university, I took a break for about 3 years. However, I returned to playing in June 2023, and I was really surprised to see that the audience of this game, which invented the auto battler game mode, has decreased significantly. It’s surprising to see such a legendary game lose so many players.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Since then, I’ve been playing at Queen level every season, and the game still brings me a lot of joy. On my streams, I focus on game strategies and engaging with the community, with the aim of spreading the game culture. title: MattTaylorLoL - Automatic Chess Professional
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hit Bishop in February 2019 and never looked back—Auto Chess hooked me instantly. From grinding ranked matches to competing in the World Qualifiers, I’ve loved the strategy and chaos of it all. Now, I’m hyped to join Oliyoun Auto Chess Club’s Event #1 as one of the first 8 competitors. I’d love to rep Nouns, bringing my experience and energy to build hype for this tournament. Between Melee ranked days, I’m itching to sharpen my Auto Chess skills and stream the journey—sharing strats, wild plays, and maybe a few memes. Check my Twitter and Warpcast (@MattTaylorLol) for gaming takes and clips. Let’s make this event the start of something big—Auto Chess deserves a comeback, and I’m ready to help make it happen. title: MODE EU CLOWN XDD
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is CLOWN, and if there’s no clown in a chess tournament, then it’s not a real tournament—it’s just an ordinary game. I’m not just a player; I create the atmosphere, the intensity, the emotions. My goal is not only to win but to make the game unforgettable. How? Easy: I turn the chessboard into an arena, and the pieces into participants in a true spectacle.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Chess is often called a game of cold calculation. But what if you add some color? That’s exactly what I do: I love turning pieces red, leaving my opponents with no chance. If you see your army burning in the fire of attacks, it means CLOWN is already here. My playing style is aggression, unconventional combinations, and unexpected moves.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I don’t need to prove that chess is not just a game but a whole performance where every move can become a spectacle. If I’m in the tournament, boredom is not an option. Without clowns, the chess world would be too gray, and I’m here to add some color to it.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Ready for a match? Then remember: if the pieces start turning red, CLOWN has arrived.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: WOOKIE CAN LEARN DAC AGAIN
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, I've been familiar with Dota Auto Chess since its inception and fell victim to its addictive system of probabilities and board changes. Because of this, I created updates and guides on my channel, and even researched how to play Auto Chess Mobile when the Chinese version of Dragonest was released. Many players from the community appeared on my streams, demonstrating different strategies and even showing me how the rarest synergies could work. Thanks to that dedication, I was able to create a qualifying tournament with prizes in valuable Dota 2 items. It was a very fun time. Something I should highlight is the constant updates Drodo Studio has made to keep the game fresh and to surprise you with the highest-level piece designs. title: GET $40 CHEESE STRING OUT OF CANADA TO HIS FIRST US MAJOR
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi! I'm looking to represent Nouns with my red Marth! My name is Garrett aka $40 Cheese String and I'm from Winnipeg, Manitoba! I have been playing Melee competitively since 2023 and I want to get the most out of the opportunities that I can.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've recently just started college so funds are tight for me to even consider travelling to tournaments. Especially with where I live I have very little options to travel other then fly by plane. The shortest drive to any major is roughly 20 hours in any direction. With the factors of high pricing and the lack of alternative travel options this is the main reason why this campaign is important to me. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I don't have the results to say that I could win the tournament let alone even take a game! What I can say is that since my region is small and has already established players my placing at locals doesn't reflect my potential. But what I can always promise is that I have the competitive spirit to be the best Marth that modern melee will see. The experience of competing at Tipped Off will allow me to grow as a competitor!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've been coached by both Joshman and KirbyKaze and both have expressed seeing that I have the makings of a great competitor. title: GET SEVEN TO TIPPED OFF 16!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, I'm Seven! I'm a Sheik main from MD/VA, and I'm looking to go to Tipped Off 16. At least not for another year~. I love that opportunities like this exist, and a lot of the other players who have already created their proposals when I'm writing this deserve it in their own right. As a fan of the game, myself, I want to see them out there just as much as I want to see myself out there.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I decided to submit a proposal in spite of this for a couple reasons:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Competition - this is one of the most stacked tournaments in a long time, and I think I can make a big upset. This event is two months away, and I think that's enough time for me to make a couple big leaps.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- Friendship :). I thought I wouldn't be motivated to push hard for another major, but at BoBC I was faced with an overwhelming amount of good vibes. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I'll also be working on a 2nd Outside Looking In analysis - this time, I'll be creating it in Youtube form, so I have the opportunity to revise and edit on the fly. I didn't like how unorganized my stream of the first session came across.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"And of course, I'll be entering a lot of online events again this time around. content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"PLEASE TAKE THE TIME TO READ THIS COMPLETELY BEFORE YOU VOTE. THANK YOU!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"What's good? My name is Joshua or jd or jdhcdaboi. I am a Melee player from ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Jamaica and I am the best player by a wide margin. I am creating this round to get Lil Nouns (and you all) to consider sending some top Central America and Caribbean players to Supernova! Supernova was chosen because it is the largest Smash event of the year and it is in a time where people have time to compete (not as much school or work in the summer).","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Goal:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I hope this round gives these players a reason to actively push each other into competing and entering brackets (even online ones). I can't get good practice because the people in my scene have said themselves that the scene in Central America and the Caribbean is dead, which has led me to being the sole TO in my region. I won't just sit and allow my fellow scene members to just give up and not try to compete. That's why I think Nouns should give Central America and Caribbean players a chance!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Prize Distribution:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I think the distribution should work like the recent vote in rounds for the Nouns events, but scaled down due to working with Lil Nouns and being region-locked (it is a small region).","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"1st. $1000 USDC","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"2nd. $500 USDC","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Entrants:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"It's simple. If you are from a country that is located in Central America and the Caribbean, you can enter by making a proposal on why you should be chosen!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Judging:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Once again, it's simple. It should like every other vote in round where voters can choose one or multiple persons to cast their votes on by reading their proposals.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Timeline:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I believe that voting should start 2 months before the event to maximize plans and coverage.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Proposals: May 31-June 7","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Voting: June 8-June 14","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Please consider giving these people a shot to prove themselves!","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you,","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"jd","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Travel prizes for international Melee scenes - Nouns goes to all corners of the world!
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This round would allow organizers of Melee (and possibly PM) tournaments in regions outside the Lower 48, Ontario, and BC to add a special bonus to their prize pots: ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns sponsorship to Regionals+ events in other parts of the world.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Melee scene is a lot more global than we often give credit. From Chile to Brazil, Japan to New Zealand, and South Africa to Eastern Europe - people play, bond, and compete fiercely in our beautiful game.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Goals of the round:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This round would give support to the local organizers and competitors in these lesser-known Melee regions, and put Nouns at the leading edge of the game's long-standing role as a bridge between people, places, and cultures. Specifically, I hope the winners of this round will allow scenes with little or no exposure on the global stage to get attention and show their talent.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A generous funds-matching structure leverages the fundraising and capacity of local scenes, without putting undue burden on poorer regions.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Prize Distribution:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"1st -","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" $900 USDC unconditional","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"2nd -","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" 2:1 matching up to $600 USDC for funds raised by the organizers, players, and/or scene in question","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Who Can Enter?","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Organizers or community members can enter on the following conditions:","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"1. There is a regular or planned tournament/circuit, either LAN or via region-locked Netplay, to which prizing can be applied.","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" This tournament should take place before Q4 2025","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", and should represent a fair opportunity for the entire region's playerbase to compete for the prize if they so wish.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"2. The region in question should be outside the Lower 48 states, Ontario, and BC, as these regions already have reasonable access to high-level competition.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":2,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"\t","type":"tab","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"2.1. Other large regions such as the UK, Germany, Sweden, Alberta, Nova Scotia, and Quebec are permitted to enter, but we encourage applicants and voters from these scenes to account for the merit-based cases of scenes that might have fewer players, and/or less presence on the NounsGG platform.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Bringing Smiles & Stationery: Lil Nouns Exercise Set Initiative
content:
{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"
Many children in orphanages, children’s homes, and underserved communities lack even the basic tools for learning. This project will produce 330–350 Lil Nouns-themed school kits—each with a 60-leaf (120-page) exercise book, a pen, and a pencil—to put in the hands of kids who need them most.

The books will feature bright, joyful Lil Nouns designs to spark imagination, with strong covers and space for names and subjects. Each pen and pencil will be Lil Nouns-inspired to complete the experience.

Budget Breakdown:

Design: $80

Printing (Books): $450

Pen + Pencil Sets: $120

Delivery & Packaging: $30

Contingency: $20

Total: $700

With your support, we can turn paper, ink, and art into hope, pride, and possibility. For a child with nothing, a simple book and pen can mean everything.

content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Summary","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For the past 15 years I have been working towards the massification of the art of puppetry in disadvantaged communities. In Venezuela there is a severe school dropout rate due to the low number of teachers, some schools have classes twice a week, all this product of the progressive migration of education professionals in a country with serious economic problems. One of the plans is to create a story about the beginnings of the web3 through the wonderful art of puppets.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcWU62TvaD5kweG1X5fo6mwMMiet62fCD4fdBqQCg3v7G","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmVkZQmoDiXzNnD9BU5s961AP4DBR7qMRSYiDR2rtBbHep","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Plan","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"start","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"To carry out 4 workshops of Nounish Puppets in different rural communities in a period of 3 months attending to a population of 120 children who will learn from scratch how to design and make their own puppets with recycled materials such as plastic bottles, cardboard, paper, among others. content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Gm, Gm friends,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Obedson Uchenna Nwinyinya, and I’m a dedicated software developer with a deep passion for helping others grow in tech.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I run a free community-based training center where I support beginners in areas like Web3, online courses, and general tech skills. But this center is more than just a learning space — it’s a hub for connection, mentorship, and collaboration.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"We’ve created an environment where learners can not only build their skills, but also connect with others who are willing to guide and support them. {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Across the world, the number of homeless children continues to rise due to economic hardship, displacement, conflict, and family breakdown. These children, often seen on the streets or living in temporary shelters, face daily battles for survival—without food, clean clothes, healthcare, or education.
---

2. Project Overview

Project Title: Hope for the Forgotten
Budget: $700
Duration: 3 months
Target Beneficiaries: 50 homeless or vulnerable children (aged 6–15)

This project will deliver basic humanitarian support to 50 homeless children through the provision of essential supplies, informal learning, basic health care, and psychosocial support.

3. Objectives

Overall Goal:
To provide relief and support for homeless children in a marginalized community by meeting their basic needs and offering informal learning and psychosocial engagement.

Specific Objectives:

Distribute food, hygiene items, and clothing to 50 children.

Facilitate informal learning sessions twice weekly.

Offer basic medical care and health education.

Conduct weekly group activities to improve mental and emotional well-being.

4. Rationale

The image reflects a neglected reality—children growing up without adequate protection or opportunities. Left without intervention, these children risk becoming victims of abuse, disease, malnutrition, and crime. This proposal aims to offer immediate aid and provide a safe space for learning and care.

Even with a limited budget, this project can change lives. By addressing urgent needs and planting seeds of hope, we empower these children to imagine a future beyond survival.


---

5. Key Activities

a. Distribution of Basic Needs

Each child will receive:

Hygiene kit (soap, toothpaste, toothbrush, sanitary pads for girls)

Food pack (rice, beans, oil)

title: Help Fund Hype Waves 100 Prize Poll
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello fellow Nouners, my name is Santiago and my tag is Sibo. For the past year, I have had the pleasure of Tournament Organizing for Binghamton University's Melee scene. I am continually blown away by how inviting, friendly, and talented my peers and the greater Upstate smash scene has been. As a TO, I wish to provide my best for the community. I believe that securing funding for a prize pot for Hype Waves 100, our free bi-weekly tournament, would be a wonderful way to give back. This tournament has continually given everybody a chance to hang out with their homies and make a push for PR for free. Having the 100th tournament give back to thank everyone who has ever showed up for us would be a dream for me and Binghamton University's Video Game Association!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Keep creating pixels
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"All I really want is to keep creating pixels — freely, and without pressure.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’ve always enjoyed mixing themes, jumping from one idea to another, and letting inspiration guide me without overthinking it. That’s how I’ve built my little pixel world, and I’d love to keep doing that for as long as I can.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Over time, I’ve ended up creating several pieces around the ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" theme. It wasn’t something planned — it just happened naturally, because I enjoy the energy and playfulness around the ecosystem.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"And honestly? Why stop now? If something inspires you and you’re having fun, that should be reason enough to keep going.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I know we often tie everything to a purpose — a collection, a sale, a campaign, a deadline. But for me, there’s something really powerful about making art simply ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"for the joy of creating it","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":". No strategy, no roadmap, just vibes and pixels.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"That’s the kind of spirit I think we need to keep alive in web3.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Because at the end of the day, this space was built by people playing, experimenting, pushing buttons to see what happens — and I don’t want to lose that.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Art without a fixed purpose is not a waste — it’s the foundation for discovery.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Most of my favorite pieces didn’t come from planning. They came from sitting down, opening Aseprite, and messing around with an idea just because it ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"felt","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" fun.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"So yeah — I’ll keep creating, I’ll keep mixing styles and themes like I’ve done so far, and if something good comes out of it, amazing. If not, at least I had a good time doing it.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Sometimes the best projects are born from the moments where you’re not trying to make anything at all —","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"just craft.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"And I think that’s something worth protecting.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Also, source of motivation and inspiration.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Everything title: Asset Library, tutorials, artworks, everything cc0 and more by uncle Zylag
content:
{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey!

I'm Zylag, been doing pixel art with Lil Nouns since Prop House round #1.

From the beginning I wanted to give the tools to create and proliferate to those who don't consider themselves pro artists.
I've started a pixel art asset library as close to nounish trait style as possible . Then I produced a whole bunch of example artworks using said assets (check out an example here: ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://zora.co/collect/zora:0x07a64e98634d21e67c348dfe4c87209a10275077/1"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"). Then I started doing tutorials for starting out with pixel art. The nounish style is simple, easy to grasp and super iconic, so creating tools for as many people to jump into it as possible is still the best route for proliferation imo.

My most popular figma community files (","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"figma.com/@zylageth"},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":") ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"are the Asset Library (over 1k users) and Pixel Art UI Kit (over 2.5k users).
