content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Introduction","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"GM Lil Nouners, I'm pixelsbykay, a 3D Artist and Animator from South Africa. I'm no stranger to the Nouns and the impact it has had, not only on the Web3 community but to myself as an artist having created short form content centred around the Nouns brand.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmWUxykLALabzDqBcx9vUXa5saLps2CFDsUeLfYrGX64vC","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"animation created for Nouns Esports contest, where I took 1st Place - ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://prop.house/0x617a72bf73233234a140381129c1e160a182c251"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My Proposal","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I propose creating a two minute animated short film centred around the Lil Nouns characters. The film would bring Lil Nouns characters to life by putting story, personality, experiences and little idiosyncrancies behind each Lil Noun character included in the film. The short film will be humourous, cute, adventurous, exciting and everything else we've come to love about the Lil Nouns and their adventures.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmfRtFCcEWaBAAuxfe9PWkSPfpUXQanCUcCCGA5NzauBXG","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"animation created for Nouns Japans cancelled contest Round 13","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why Vote For Me? - Proliferating Lil Nouns","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Nouns ecosystem has mass appeal, the characters attract both, the young audience and the old, with each piece of content around the Nouns generating millions of views online.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The Lil Nouns short film would serve as an addition to the already viral Nouns content that lives online by being distributed through various social media platforms such as Instagram, X and Youtube. Moments from the film would also be edited and converted to .gif format files and uploaded to GIPHY, tenor and Imgur.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In addition to online audiences, the film would be submitted to submission fee free Short Animation Film Festivals around the world, further proliferating Lil Nouns and the Nouns ecosystem amongst demographics that are not Web3 or social media savvy.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The film would also serve as a source of entertainment for all Nouners gathering at any Nouns IRL events around the world.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmNPESYpSPuUjcLedXCr1ssB4SYexSgzf2nUEDNit7MjBK","type":"image","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":2,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Nouns Artist Program - content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’m proposing a series of 5–7 seamless Lil Nounish animations, combining 2D and 3D motion design, all paired with original music I’ll compose myself. Each loop will follow a shared theme—something bold, surreal, and unmistakably Lil Nounish, with cuter styles ,and will be designed to function as bumpers, visual fillers, or  standalone loops across short and long-form video content.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"These aren’t just animations, they’re Lil Nounish motion capsules, built for maximum shareability. If desired, they can also be minted from Lil Nouns-controlled wallets, with proceeds looping back into more Lil-Nounish creation.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Why It Spreads the Meme:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":" Visual loops are hypnotic, easy to share, and optimized for today’s scroll-happy platforms.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Sound + motion adds an emotional hook, helping the aesthetic and message stick.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"- These can be embedded into other Lil Nounish content, allowing wider reuse and remixing by the community, including the e-sports gang. Proposal Description:
I propose a colorful and playful illustration series that reimagines Lil Nouns in a vibrant, floral world. My artistic aesthetic based on positive vibes, featuring a vibrant rainbow colors, it's highlights naive figures, often surrounded by flowers and infused with a touch of surrealism. Through this project, I want to bring a sense of warmth, playfulness, and beauty to the Lil Nouns universe — blending nature and fantasy into something joyful and unique.

This project will include:

How It Helps Spread Lil Nouns: This series gives Lil Nouns a fresh, nature-inspired visual identity that stands out from more minimal or meme-based representations. The joyful, highly decorative style is instantly eye-catching and made to be shared — perfect for Instagram, X, Farcaster, art drops, and printed media. It also invites new audiences to discover Lil Nouns through a lens of beauty and creativity.

title: I Need a Reset — And Maybe a Little Magic
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey Lil Nouns 🌈","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’m going to be honest: I don’t have a startup to pitch or a world-changing invention up my sleeve. What I do have is the need for a hard reset — and the tiniest spark of an idea that maybe, just maybe, a little help from this weird and wonderful corner of the internet could change everything.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I've been having some pretty dark thoughts the past 2 years. I live alone and not really much going on in my life. ","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Maybe I could use some of this prize to actually do something I used to do. Something that I used to love. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Here’s what I’d do with 0.2 ETH:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’d take a solo trip — not some luxury getaway, just a few days somewhere quiet, maybe with mountains or a messy coastline. A place where I can think clearly, write without interruption, and remember who I am when no one’s watching.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’d bring a notebook, a camera, and zero expectations. Just the hope that something will shift. That I’ll come back with a few pages of something real. Maybe even something beautiful.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"list","version":1,"listType":"bullet","start":1,"tag":"ul"},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I know this might sound self-indulgent. content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Dear Lil Nouns,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I’m seeking your support to improve a vital yet neglected water source in my community. A natural pond that has served generations, including my own family. Though  it has never dried up, the pond is now unsafe due to contamination, lack of maintenance, and absence of protection. Children still drink from it, risking their health because they have no better option.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This project goes beyond water. It’s about preserving a lifeline, preventing illness, and proving that hope and help can come from unexpected places like Lil Nouns.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Access to clean water remains a daily struggle here. But there's a promising opportunity. A respected elder in our village has drilled a functional borehole on his property and, in a generous act, is offering access to this clean water for the benefit of the community. With support from Lil Nouns, we hope to install a Storex tank outside his compound and build the necessary channeling system to make this safe water easily accessible to everyone.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The tank structure would proudly feature the Lil Nouns logo and a QR code to highlight your impact.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I grew up drinking from this pond. Today, I want to change the story for the next generation. I’m ready to coordinate this effort, rally volunteers, and ensure safe water reaches my community.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thank you for considering this proposal. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"With hope,","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Jemimah","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Getting MOF to GOML, running it back
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why did I make this proposal?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"A few weeks back I made a proposal for the nouns GOML round and fell just barely short, and the assistance in getting to the event was rather crucial, so I'm spinning it back, I never surrender.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Why would I deserve your vote?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Being a full-time professional player means ur on the margins, you sacrifice a lot of time and effort for very little monetary gain. Traveling the world and competing all the time at a high level is cool but the reality of it is that it is more akin to the majority of professional boxers who make very little money and practice a ton because they love it and the experience of going around the country/world competing is a thrill, the want to showcase the highest level of gameplay possible is real. This means that except certain titans in the scene (Hbox, mang0 etc.) you require some form of assistance to consistently get to events, especially when they're in another country (sponsorships, TO/Fan assistance, nouns rounds, etc.)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"So if you wish to support someone chasing their dreams and want to see some sick miami ice climbers gameplay consider voting for me.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"What will the Funds be used for?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Currently, 0.2 ETH is in the range of 500 dollars, 350 of which would go towards my flight and 150 towards my hotel room split.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"How I'll be representing LIL Nouns","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"At the event, I will wear the \"LIL\" tag in game on all my broadcasted sets, shout out LIL Nouns for their assistance on multiple social media platforms, post about the event in the LIL Nouns discord, and inform anyone who inquires about the LIL Nouns DAO","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I began building Project Flippi in late 2024 after seeing Junebug rocking a nouns.gg esports jersey and doing big things with Donkey Kong. Inspired, I picked up a GameCube controller and set out to make a system that could auto-upload the community's Melee highlights to YouTube, so we could just play and let the content handle itself.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Thanks to prior work from Project Slippi, Project Clippi, and the Dolphin Emulator, this became possible. Slippi made replay saving and netplay seamless. Clippi enabled instant replay recordings when combos occurred. Dolphin Emulator brought the Wii to the masses. Flippi is a nod to these projects.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I added a new Clippi action: write combo data to a text file. With this data in hand, I created a pipeline that now:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Converts data into readable text (“1” → “Donkey Kong”)","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Uses OpenAI thumbnails","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"listitem","version":1,"value":2},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Uploads But it goes further: using Web3, Flippi will reward players with USDC earned from YouTube for sick clips.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"For this round, the functionality of automatically sending USDC to players landing clips will be developed and consist of the following:","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Planned Dev (July - After all the first step to having a Lil is having a wallet!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Trif 4 Nounsvitational in Tokyo! 👸💅
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey everyone!I’m Trif, a professional Super Smash Bros. title: One individual, one country and delusion: a different proposal for Nounsvitational
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I want to clarify something first: this is not a proposal to go and compete in the Nounsvitational. This is a proposal to try and go to the Nounsvitational in order to make live coverage and make a video regarding the experience of the event, all for one specific Melee community. I actually don't even know if this is something that should go here, but I'm still willing to give it a shot.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Let me introduce myself: hi, I'm SoyAri. I'm 17 and I'm an Argentinian Melee player, but also a commentator and the main administrator of the @MeleeArgentina social media accounts. I stream and commentate our tournaments, and have commentated both Brazilian and Chilean tournaments, and recently the South American major \"Super Smash Bong #100\".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In the Melee Argentina Twitter/X account, I've covered and reported tons of sets minute by minute from lots of majors over the past year, every chance that I could, and it has been my personal dream for a while to go to a major for the first time, in order to both be able to make some cool stuff for the @MeleeArgentina accounts, and also to know what one of this events feels like with my own being. Obviously, because of both the distance to all majors and a lack of funds makes this difficult.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Still, my hope remains alight. It would be really nice to be able to represent my beautiful country, and not only Argentina, but all of South America, either by commentating, or even by simply by attending and covering the tournament. And I'd really appreciate if you were to support this small, noble cause.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Well, I believe this is all that I had and wanted to say. The rest is on your shoulders. Thank you for reading, and have a good day.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: One individual, one country and delusion: a different proposal for Nounsvitational
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I want to clarify something first: this is not a proposal to go and compete in the Nounsvitational. This is a proposal to try and go to the Nounsvitational in order to make live coverage and make a video regarding the experience of the event, all for one specific Melee community. I actually don't even know if this is something that should go here, but I'm still willing to give it a shot.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Let me introduce myself: hi, I'm SoyAri. I'm 17 and I'm an Argentinian Melee player, but also a commentator and the main administrator of the @MeleeArgentina social media accounts. I stream and commentate our tournaments, and have commentated both Brazilian and Chilean tournaments, and recently the South American major \"Super Smash Bong #100\".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In the Melee Argentina Twitter/X account, I've covered and reported tons of sets minute by minute from lots of majors over the past year, every chance that I could, and it has been my personal dream for a while to go to a major for the first time, in order to both be able to make some cool stuff for the @MeleeArgentina accounts, and also to know what one of this events feels like with my own being. Obviously, because of both the distance to all majors and a lack of funds makes this difficult.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Still, my hope remains alight. It would be really nice to be able to represent my beautiful country, and not only Argentina, but all of South America, either by commentating, or even by simply by attending and covering the tournament. And I'd really appreciate if you were to support this small, noble cause.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Well, I believe this is all that I had and wanted to say. The rest is on your shoulders. Thank you for reading, and have a good day.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Stellar Alchemy: The Compound Core

content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Alien Sausages mETH: A Vision of Ethereum’s Boundless Horizon","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"heading","version":1,"tag":"h1"},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In the vibrant, pixelated canvas of Alien Sausages mETH, three otherworldly figures emerge as the protagonists of a narrative that transcends mere art—it is a testament to Ethereum’s transformative power and its promise of a future brimming with possibility. Clad in hues that oscillate between electric blues and cosmic purples, these “Alien Sausages” are far more than whimsical creatures; they are personifications of Ethereum’s core ethos: innovation, accessibility, and the democratization of value. Their sausage-like forms, rounded yet dynamic, evoke a sense of approachability, breaking down the intimidating barriers often associated with blockchain technology and inviting viewers to engage with a world where finance is playful, inclusive, and inherently human.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Chaler and BigMaks! Get The EU Melee Content Dream Team To The Nounsvitational
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello Nouns voters! My name is Maks, but the Melee streets know me as BiGMaks. Joined by my partner in crime, legendary UK youtuber Chaler. In return for your votes, we promise to deliver the ultimate tournament companion experience. Think player interviews, mini-docs, challenges, and fresh content pieces that showcase competitors off-stream like never before. If you want to see the heart of the scene beyond the matches, your vote belongs with us. But who are we?","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"See our Video for the TLDR ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1tUdyPdufOA"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As I said I am BiGMaks and I have been commentating EU tournaments for almost a decade and have leant my voice to almost every EU major top8 since 2019. ","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Recently, I have thrown my efforts in trying to level up the production value of our streams here in EU and for those who watched UK majors ‘Let’s Start the Fire’ and ‘Lets Drink the Pool’ will have seen my mix of short and long form content showcasing our wonderful community outside the context of just winning and losing a set. Those unfortunate enough not to be familiar with Chalers videos have missed out on his amazing ability to tell some of Melee’s best stories and show the humanity behind the game. Together we will bring you the best content this fair isle can! ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/@ChalerYT/videos"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmVLmCE459cLrwJb26Df745RTzRn8xgTXaTMoUGTVpJqXv","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"As mentioned in the beginning our aim if we win would be to provide a tournament companion experience. Those who have seen my content before will know what to expect. Short form gameshow content as well as, longer content pieces that showcase personality rather than skits. ","type":"text","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Link","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"link","version":1,"rel":null,"target":null,"title":null,"url":"https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLvTpAmQKqZYqnthPyxgYCg6OC_tJUy4Ve"}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"An addition to these kinds of pieces audiences have seen from us in the past, with this tournament we will also film some player mini-docs for the lesser known players to have their stories heard, interviews during the tournament to stay up to date with the competitors and a return of my long defunct series ‘Going 0-2’ where I travel to locals to show how fun the melee scene can be even if you’re not a world traveling top 100 ranked player","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmZdP2KgQE9GWQgufU3gLC5rNn1Uy1ahfrWsfGodxGD5qz","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmZMvVUfUgC2CMEkhYvkgRxw92LU2hv5DrYKWfHEHUe7ir","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmWcxUpLmopACy2dD2Fnam2oqrhx7KRnGZPgmUZiZ39ZDv","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: "Visualizing the Future of Staking: My mETH Protocol Design Proposal"
content:
{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hello mETH Protocol Team,

I’m excited to submit my design for the ongoing contest and to contribute creatively to a project that’s shaping the future of Ethereum staking.

My design was created with the intention of capturing the core values of the mETH Protocol — institutional strength, innovation, and accessibility. I aimed to reflect the futuristic potential of liquid staking while maintaining a visual identity that feels clean, bold, and trustworthy.

mETH stands at the intersection of advanced crypto mechanics and real-world utility — built on Mantle, governed by COOK, and now recognized as the first liquid staking token adopted by a public company treasury. That’s not just an achievement — it’s a shift in the narrative of DeFi, and my design seeks to visually echo that milestone.

This project represents more than just a product; it represents a movement. I’m proud to be part of that story and to support a protocol that’s pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in Web3.

Thank you for the opportunity — I’m looking forward to seeing how this ecosystem continues to evolve.

Best regards,

","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"
This piece reimagines a Nouns-style character as a decentralized chemist — pixelated glasses on, hazmat suit zipped, stirring a volatile blend of ETH and COOK tokens inside a bubbling cauldron. The lab? Steampunk. The mood? Experimental. The message? Ethereum is no longer just about protocols — it’s about participation, culture, and creativity.

Inspired by the chaotic brilliance of Breaking Bad, this artwork captures the spirit of mETH Protocol and NounsDAO in one frame. We’re not cooking meth — we’re cooking Met(h): a metaphor for what happens when smart contracts, restaking, governance, and imagination mix in the same digital beaker.

In this lab, ETH transforms into mETH, a token of composability and staking power. Add governance? You get $COOK. Add creativity? You get Nouns identity. Add risk and volatility? That’s the fire beneath the flask. This is the art of transformation — the Met(h)amorphosis.

Every detail is layered with meaning:

The cauldron represents the fluidity of assets in DeFi.

The hazmat suit is a nod to the risks builders take.

The glowing symbols of ETH and COOK remind us what we’re really playing with: value, governance, and evolution.

The Nouns-style aesthetic brings it all home — a tribute to open creativity and identity on-chain.

title: mETHamorphosis: A Nounish Lab Experiment
content:
{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Caption / Proposal Text:
Welcome to the Nounish lab — where ideas bubble, brains spark, and identity gets redefined.

For my #CookingBad submission, I imagined what it would look like if a Noun underwent a total metamorphosis in the middle of a chemical experiment gone wild. Think: rogue chemistry, unstable genius, and a little Nounish mischief.

The piece features a pixel-headed character in a red hood, mid-transformation. Their brain is literally breaking out, sparking with raw energy — surrounded by glowing beakers and tubes filled with unstable compounds.

This is my take on what “mETHamorphosis” really means: change that’s chaotic, creative, and completely unpredictable.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Cooking Bad: My mETH Nouns Metamorphosis
content:
{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This piece is my love letter to the chaos of crypto. When I found Ethereum, I didn’t just find a blockchain — I found a playground where memes and madness collide.

My Cooking Bad entry brings that spirit to life: a rogue chef in Nouns glasses, brewing risky DeFi potions in a bubbling beaker. It’s messy, fun, and open — just like the communities behind mETH Protocol and Nouns DAO.

I chose an illustration style that’s easy to remix. Stickers, memes, a hoodie print — this chef can live anywhere. It’s CC0 energy in a single image: shareable, adaptable, and meant to spread.

But this isn’t just an artwork — it’s an invitation. If this piece gets picked, I want to push it further. I’ll share free remix files, run mini contests, and encourage others to draw their own versions. Imagine a whole crew of mETH chefs cooking up weird traits and stories. That’s the goal: more chaos, more creativity.

Crypto can feel too serious. This piece says: lighten up, break things, remix the rules. It’s what drew me here in the first place — and why I believe Nouns and mETH are so powerful together.

So here’s my pitch: pick this chef if you want to keep this space fun. Let’s get weird, let’s experiment, let’s make sure crypto art stays alive and open.

My wallet is ready, my Discord joined, my X handle follows @mETHProtocol. Now I just need your vote.

Let’s cook — together.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: COOKING BAD: Brewing Up Culture with METH NOUNS
content:
{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hey team,

Here’s my entry for the Meth Nouns contest — a fun, chaotic mashup I’m calling “Cooking Bad.” Inspired by the wild energy of Breaking Bad and the playful vibes of the Nouns ecosystem, this artwork brings crypto culture to life with a wink and a beaker full of memes.

In this scene, two Meth Nouns characters are cooking up more than chemicals — they’re cooking up culture. You’ve got the oversized Nouns glasses, Ethereum symbols floating around, and a whole lot of cartoon madness. It’s Web3 meets Saturday morning cartoons, with a dose of degen energy.

Why this works:

It’s loud, colorful, and instantly recognizable.

It leans into meme culture without losing the Nounish aesthetic.

It invites people in — even those who aren’t deep into crypto — because it’s familiar, funny, and weird in the best way.


At the core of it, this is about remixing — taking something iconic and twisting it into something Nounish. That’s what this whole ecosystem is about anyway, right?

Thanks for checking it out!","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: One individual, one country and delusion: a different proposal for Nounsvitational
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"I want to clarify something first: this is not a proposal to go and compete in the Nounsvitational. This is a proposal to try and go to the Nounsvitational in order to make live coverage and make a video regarding the experience of the event, all for one specific Melee community. I actually don't even know if this is something that should go here, but I'm still willing to give it a shot.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Let me introduce myself: hi, I'm SoyAri. I'm 17 and I'm an Argentinian Melee player, but also a commentator and the main administrator of the @MeleeArgentina social media accounts. I stream and commentate our tournaments, and have commentated both Brazilian and Chilean tournaments, and recently the South American major \"Super Smash Bong #100\".","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In the Melee Argentina Twitter/X account, I've covered and reported tons of sets minute by minute from lots of majors over the past year, every chance that I could, and it has been my personal dream for a while to go to a major for the first time, in order to both be able to make some cool stuff for the @MeleeArgentina accounts, and also to know what one of this events feels like with my own being. Obviously, because of both the distance to all majors and a lack of funds makes this difficult.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Still, my hope remains alight. It would be really nice to be able to represent my beautiful country, and not only Argentina, but all of South America, either by commentating, or even by simply by attending and covering the tournament. And I'd really appreciate if you were to support this small, noble cause.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Well, I believe this is all that I had and wanted to say. The rest is on your shoulders. Thank you for reading, and have a good day.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: The Web3 Tide.

title: A Noun for Andrea founder of Nouns Breakers
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Hi, I'm Andrea a Nouns enthusiast and builder since 2022. In 2023 I joined Nouns Amigos and later on with the support and encouraging of the community founed Nouns Breakers the first blockchain professional team of break dancers. Ever since that I've been dedicated to build bridges between the hip hop and web3 communities as well as between the English and Spanish communities of Nouns. title: Street art is my outlet.
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My name is Lucas Brito da Silva, I am a Brazilian urban artist, working as a graffiti artist, illustrator, and designer. My trajectory is linked to Hip Hop culture, skateboarding, and street art, with works carried out in different cultural contexts, including interventions at Galeria do Rock (São Paulo) and participation in World Creativity Day.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My art is born from the street and urban experience. I develop original characters that dialogue with movement, identity, and contemporary expression, mixing graffiti, digital illustration, and graphic design. I seek to create visual narratives that represent belonging, creativity, and connection between the physical and digital worlds.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This is the first time I have participated with a proposal in this context, and for me it is an honor to be part of this community and to engage artistically with the Nouns universe. I see a direct connection between my visual language and the project's positioning: being in the street, being expression, and occupying spaces with creativity.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"In the illustration presented, I used a soft purple background, alluding to technology, innovation, and the digital environment, maintaining consistency with the brand concept. The character has an urban and original aesthetic, with a direct influence from graffiti, conveying attitude, movement, and cultural identity.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmSKAQWzyYh263unxMH5gJjVxcKRs5R49Yv46JUi7rHiMe","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The composition explores the contrast between warm and cool colors to generate depth and dynamism, ensuring good readability at different scales. The graphic elements and the backpack symbolize creative tools, communication, and collective construction.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"My style seeks to be recognizable, with its own expressive strokes inspired by the language of street art. I believe that art has the power to transform environments and connect people. This proposal represents an extension of my trajectory as an urban artist, bringing to this space the aesthetics of the street, contemporary visual culture, and creative freedom.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: NO COMPLY Game Life
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This work is not a game disguised as art, nor art disguised as a game. It is an ","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"exposed system","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":", where rule and collapse coexist in the same body.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The skateboard deck, an object designed for friction, becomes a surface for thought. On one side, code functions as a technical–existential manifesto: programming as an unstable attempt to organize chaos. There are no promises of efficiency, no endings that compile cleanly. The code does not govern — it confesses failure, instability, and obsolescence.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"On the other side, the game unfolds the way life does: crooked, excessive, improvised. The path twists like an unplanned city, filled with detours, loops, gaps, and irrational decisions. Pixel art here is not nostalgia, but a reminder of the fragility of digital memory — everything solid is already outdated. Hand-drawn marks rupture any illusion of algorithmic perfection. Error is not noise; it is authorship.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"At its core, the work exposes a tension between the desire to build systems — web3, metaverses, contracts, consensus — and the body that plays, fails, and persists. No system survives intact when it meets the body. No virtual world absorbs the weight of a real fall. No blockchain records a scar.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"The game refuses victory. It offers movement, use, and wear instead. Like the street. Like skateboarding. Like time.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"#wolmindahgrota","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}

title: Gnars x Boards.wtf [] Cyber Vision
content: {"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This work starts with an already recognized symbol, the iconic pixelated red glasses of GNARS, but transports them to a new dimension: a universe where the human and the digital merge.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmU2gpoh8Xyo6d42z1iAEWprazJxJANRjef7QjBjeJXENw","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"By giving the glasses a robotic look, I wanted to reinforce the idea that we are living through a transition. We are no longer just physical individuals navigating the internet; we are hybrid extensions, digital identities built on code, community, and technology. The mechanical and almost cybernetic aspect of the glasses represents this evolution: a vision that is not only human, but amplified by technology.","type":"text","version":1},{"type":"linebreak","version":1},{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmcssVf9CkLfDFhPPr2BCtL3qVMwXnN3jvdb32ZaYAFRr3","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"altText":"","src":"https://ipfs.nouns.gg/ipfs/QmVPLPpxk3rMGhZMtXk1hkWRriWbU56AqrMWZY7GEj77ji","type":"image","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"This work seeks to translate its essence: collective vision, digital culture, and a decentralized future.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0}],"direction":"ltr","format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}
